translation: Wëlls du eppes tëscht denger §eToolbar§f an dengem Inventar réckelen? Benotz de Cursor fir en Objet auszewielen an dréck :_gamepad_face_button_down:. Réckel dann däin Cursor op en eidelen Objetslot a dréck nach eng Kéier fir den Objet fale ze loossen.

source_string: Want to move something between your §ehotbar§f and your inventory? Tap the item of your choice, then tap the empty item slot that you'd like to move it to.
translation: Wëlls du eppes tëscht denger §eToolbar§f an dengem Inventar réckelen? Tipp den Objet vun denger Wiel, an tipp dann den eidelen Objetslot, op deen s du en réckele wëlls.

source_string: Want to move something between your §ehotbar§f and your inventory? Use the cursor to select an item and press :_input_key.use:. Then, move your cursor to an empty item slot and press again to drop the item.
translation: Wëlls du eppes tëscht denger §eToolbar§f an dengem Inventar réckelen? Benotz de Cursor fir en Objet auszewielen an dréck :_input_key.use:. Réckel dann däin Cursor op en eidelen Objetslot a dréck nach eng Kéier fir den Objet fale ze loossen.

source_string: Jigsaw Blocks give creators the ability to generate large structures in the world by connecting multiple structure templates.
translation: Puzzleblécker gi Kreatoren d'Fäegkeet, grouss Strukturen an der Welt z'erschafen, andeems si méi Strukturvirlagen verbannen.

source_string: To get a Jigsaw Block you must use the /give slash command. To use a Jigsaw Block, you must have Operator permissions.
translation: Fir e Puzzleblock ze kréien, muss du de /give-Slash-Befeel benotzen. Fir e Puzzleblock ze benotzen, muss du Operator-Rechter hunn.

source_string: Jigsaw Blocks have multiple settings that control how they join together to form a larger structure.
translation: Puzzleblécker hunn méi Einstellungen, déi kontrolléieren, wéi si sech zesummeschléisse, fir eng méi grouss Struktur ze bilden.

source_string: §eTarget Pool§f - The path of the template pool to search for a connecting structure template. The template pool should contain at least one structure that matches the Jigsaw's "Target Name" field.
translation: §eZielpool§f - De Wee vum Virlagpool fir e verbindenden Strukturvirlag ze sichen. De Virlagpool sollt op d'mannst eng Struktur enthalen, déi zum Puzzleblock säin "Zielnumm"-Feld passt.

source_string: §eName§f - The name of the Jigsaw. This is used when connecting from Jigsaws with a matching "Target Name".
translation: §eNumm§f - Den Numm vum Puzzleblock. Dëst gëtt benotzt beim Verbannen vu Puzzleblécker mat engem passenden "Zielnumm".

source_string: §eTurns Into§f - The type of block the Jigsaw Block will turn into when placed in the world during structure generation.
translation: §eWiirdett zu§f - De Blocktyp, zu deem de Puzzleblock ëmgewandelt gëtt, wa hie während der Strukturgeneratioun an d'Welt placéiert gëtt.

source_string: §eSelection Priority§f - When the parent piece is being processed for connections, this is the order in which this Jigsaw block attempts to connect to its target piece. Jigsaws will be processed in descending priority with random ordering breaking ties.
translation: §eAuswiel-Prioritéit§f - Wann d'Eltereleit-Stéck fir Verbindunge verarbecht gëtt, ass dëst d'Uerdnung, an där dëse Puzzleblock probéiert, sech mat sengem Zielstéck ze verbannen. Puzzleblécker ginn a fallender Prioritéit verarbecht, mat zoufälleger Uerdnung fir Bindungen ze brieche.

source_string: §ePlacement Priority§f - When this Jigsaw block connects to a piece, this is the order in which that piece is processed for connections in the wider structure. Pieces will be processed in descending priority with insertion order breaking ties.
translation: §ePlacéierungs-Prioritéit§f - Wann dëse Puzzleblock sech mat engem Stéck verbënnt, ass dëst d'Uerdnung, an där dat Stéck fir Verbindunge an der breeder Struktur verarbecht gëtt. Stécker ginn a fallender Prioritéit verarbecht, mat der Insertiounsuerdnung fir Bindungen ze brieche.

source_string: §eJoint Type§f - A joint can be either Rollable (default) or Aligned. If the joint type is Rollable, the target structure will be rotated randomly around the source Jigsaw Block. If the joint type is Aligned, the target structure will be placed such that the rotation of the target Jigsaw Block aligns with the rotation of the source Jigsaw Block. Note that this only applies when the Jigsaw Block is placed facing up or down.
translation: §eGelenktyp§f - E Gelenk kann entweeder Rollbar (Standard) oder Ausgeriicht sinn. Wann de Gelenktyp Rollbar ass, gëtt d'Zielstruktur zoufälleg ronderëm de Quell-Puzzleblock gedréint. Wann de Gelenktyp Ausgeriicht ass, gëtt d'Zielstruktur sou placéiert, dass d'Rotatioun vum Zil-Puzzleblock mat der Rotatioun vum Quell-Puzzleblock iwwereneen passt. Bedenk, dass dëst just applizéiert, wann de Puzzleblock op oder erof weisend placéiert ass.

source_string: The Jukebox will play Music Discs that you have found.
translation: D'Musekbox spillt Musekplaten, déi du fonnt hues.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: on a Jukebox with a Music Disc in your hand to play it. Press :_input_key.use: the Jukebox again to eject the Music Disc.
translation: Dréck :_input_key.use: op enger Musekbox mat enger Musekplat an denger Hand, fir se ze spillen. Dréck :_input_key.use: op der Musekbox nach eng Kéier fir d'Musekplat auszewerfen.

source_string: Tap a Jukebox with a Music Disc in your hand to play it. Tap the Jukebox again to eject the Music Disc.
translation: Tipp op enger Musekbox mat enger Musekplat an denger Hand, fir se ze spillen. Tipp op der Musekbox nach eng Kéier fir d'Musekplat auszewerfen.

source_string: When a Jukebox is playing a Music Disc, it will power Redstone Dust.
translation: Wann eng Musekbox eng Musekplat spillt, spéist si Redstonestëbs mat Kraaft.

source_string: Try different Music Discs for a different power level.
translation: Probéier verschidde Musekplaten aus fir e verschiddenen Kraaftniveau.

source_string: See what happens when you let it play to the end.
translation: Kuck wat geschitt, wanns du et bis zum Enn spillen léiss.

source_string: A Hopper can put a Music Disc in for you, and take it out when it's done playing.
translation: En Trichter kann eng Musekplat fir dech dranstellen, an si erausnehmen, wa si fäerdeg gespillt huet.

source_string: There are a couple of Music Discs that can be found in Chests around the world.
translation: Et gëtt e puer Musekplaten, déi a Këschten ronderëm d'Welt fonnt kënne ginn.

source_string: Others are more difficult to come by, Creepers secretly appreciate music.
translation: Aner sinn méi schwéier ze kréien, Creeperen apprezéieren geheim Musek.

source_string: The Loom is a fast and efficient way to apply patterns to Banners. The Loom only uses one Dye to apply a pattern. It can also use Loom patterns to apply special patterns.
translation: Den Webstull ass eng séier an effizient Aart, fir Muster op Bannieren unzewenden. Den Webstull benotzt just ee Faarfstoff, fir e Muster unzewenden. Hie kann och Webstullmuster benotzen, fir speziell Muster unzewenden.

source_string: By placing a Banner into the Loom's first slot, and any color dye into the second slot, patterns can be added to the Banner. Once a pattern is selected, take it from the output slot on the right and move it to your inventory.
translation: Andeems een e Bannier an den éischte Slot vum Webstull placéiert, an eng Faarf Faarfstoff an den zweeten Slot, kënnen Muster op de Bannier dobäigesat ginn. Eemol e Muster ausgewielt ass, hol et aus dem Output-Slot riets an réckel et an däin Inventar.

source_string: A Banner can have multiple layers allowing you to experiment with many different banner possibilities. Up to 6 patterns can be applied to a Banner to create a unique design.
translation: E Bannier kann méi Schichten hunn, sou dass s du mat villen verschidde Bannierméiglechkeete experimentéiere kanns. Bis zu 6 Muster kënnen op e Bannier applizéiert ginn, fir en eenzegaarteg Design z'erschafen.

source_string: Adding a Loom Pattern to the Loom's third slot will allow the crafting of special patterns like a creeper face or a flower pattern. You will not lose your Loom Patterns when you apply these patterns to your Banners.
translation: E Webstullmuster an den drëtte Slot vum Webstull dobäizesetzen erlaabt d'Baken vu speziellen Muster wéi e Creeper-Gesiicht oder e Blummemuster. Du verléiers deng Webstullmuster net, wann s du dës Muster op deng Bannieren applizéiers.

source_string: Explore thrilling themed worlds, parceled up with matching skins, textures and more!
translation: Entdeck spannend thematiséiert Welten, verpackt mat passenden Skins, Texturen a méi!

source_string: Explore a world of possibility with Minecoins: Minecraft's in-game currency! Minecoins let you add variety to your gameplat across supported Minecraft games.
translation: Entdeck eng Welt vu Méiglechkeeten mat Minecoinen: Minecraft senger Spillinterner Währung! Minecoinen léisse dech Villfältegkeet zu dengem Gameplay dobäisetzen, iwwer ënnerstëtzte Minecraft-Spiller.

source_string: Once redeemed, your Minecoins are linked to your Microsoft account, so you can access your coins and purchases on other supported devices, too!
translation: Eemol agesat sinn deng Minecoinen mat dengem Microsoft-Kont verbonnen, sou dass du op deng Coinen a Käf op anere ënnerstëtzten Apparater och zougräife kanns!

source_string: *Minecoins require a version of Minecraft: Bedrock Edition with Minecraft Marketplace. Minecoins are not compatible on PlayStation®. For compatibility information see minecraft.net/minecoins
translation: *Minecoinen brauchen eng Versioun vu Minecraft: Bedrock Edition mam Minecraft Marketplace. Minecoinen sinn net kompatibel op PlayStation®. Fir Kompatibilitéitsinformatiounen kuck minecraft.net/minecoins

source_string: Not all crafting materials are on the surface - some may require you to dig underground or into a mountain.
translation: Net all Baumaterialien sinn um Buedem - e puer brauchen vläicht, dass s du ënner der Äerd oder an e Bierg gruusst.

source_string: A §epickaxe§f:wood_pickaxe: helps you uncover all sorts of materials, such as stone, coal, iron, and precious ore - though you may need extra sturdy tools for some rarer materials!
translation: E §eSpëtz§f:wood_pickaxe: hëlleft dir all Zorte vu Materialien z'entdecken, wéi Steen, Kuel, Eisen a wäertvoll Äerz - obwuel du fir e puer méi rare Materialien extra staarke Wierkzeuger brauchs!

source_string: Some raw metals will need to be smelted using a §efurnace§f:furnace: . Place a fuel like coal or wood logs in the fuel slot, then add raw ore to smelt it into something useful.
translation: E puer rou Metaller mussen an engem §eUewen§f:furnace: geschmollt ginn. Placéier e Brennstoff wéi Kuel oder Holzstämm am Brennstoffslot, an setz dann rou Äerz dobäi, fir et an eppes Nëtzlecht ze schmëlzen.

source_string: A player can ride any adult §eHorse§f, §eDonkey§f, §eMule§f, or §eCamel§f. Only Horses can be armored.
translation: E Spiller kann all erwuesse §ePäerd§f, §eEsel§f, §eMull§f oder §eKamel§f reiden. Just Päerd kënnen gerüstungt ginn.

source_string: Mules and Donkeys may be equipped with saddlebags (for transporting items) by attaching a Chest. These saddlebags can then be accessed whilst riding or sneaking.
translation: Mullen an Esele kënnen mat Satteltaschen ausgestatt ginn (fir Objeten ze transportéieren), andeems een eng Këscht befestegt. Dës Satteltasche kënne dann zougegraff ginn während s du reids oder schläichs.

source_string: Horses, Donkeys, and Mules must be §etamed§f before they can be used. A player can tame a horse by riding it and staying on while it tries to buck them off. Press :_input_key.use: with an empty hand to attempt to tame Horses, Donkeys, and Mules.
translation: Päerd, Esele a Mullen mussen §ezamt§f ginn, éier si benotzt ginn. E Spiller kann e Päerd zamen, andeems en et reit a drop bleift, während et probéiert en ofzeworfen. Dréck :_input_key.use: mat leerer Hand, fir Päerd, Esele a Mullen ze zamen.

source_string: Horses, Donkeys, and Mules must be §etamed§f before they can be used. A player can tame a horse by riding it and staying on while it tries to buck them off. Tap the Mount button that appears when near a horse  to attempt to tame Horses, Donkeys, and Mules.
translation: Päerd, Esele a Mullen mussen §ezamt§f ginn, éier si benotzt ginn. E Spiller kann e Päerd zamen, andeems en et reit a drop bleift, während et probéiert en ofzeworfen. Tipp de Reit-Knäppchen, deen erschéngt, wann s du bei engem Päerd bass, fir ze probéieren, Päerd, Esele a Mullen ze zamen.

source_string: When Hearts appear around the horse, it has been tamed and will no longer attempt to throw the player off.
translation: Wann Häerzer ronderëm dat Päerd erschéngen, ass et gezamt an probéiert net méi, den Spiller ofzewerfen.

source_string: To steer horses and camels, the player must equip it with a §eSaddle§f.
translation: Fir Päerd a Kamelen ze steieren, muss den Spiller si mat engem §eSaddel§f ausrüsten.

source_string: Saddles can be bought from villagers, found inside Chests hidden in the world, or acquired by fishing. While riding a horse, open your inventory and put a saddle in the horse's saddle slot.
translation: Sattelen kënnen vun Awunner kaf ginn, an Këschten fonnt ginn, déi an der Welt verstoppt sinn, oder duerch Fëschen kritt ginn. Während s du e Päerd reids, mach däin Inventar op a setz e Saddel an den Sattelslot vum Päerd.

source_string: A camel can carry two players at the same time.
translation: E Kamel kann zwee Spiller zur selwechter Zäit droen.

source_string: Horses and Donkeys can be bred like other animals using Golden Apples or Golden Carrots.
translation: Päerd an Esele kënnen sou wéi aner Déieren gezücht ginn mat Goldenen Ëpfel oder Golde Karotten.

source_string: Foals will grow into adult horses over time, although feeding them Wheat or Hay will speed this up.
translation: Fillen wuessen mat der Zäit zu erwuesse Päerd, obwuel si mat Weess oder Hee méi séier ze fidderen dëst beschleunegt.

source_string: Llamas are another ridable mob which can be tamed and used to transport large shipments of items.
translation: Lamaen sinn en anere reibaren Mob, dee gezamt a benotzt ka ginn, fir grouss Ladunge vun Objeten ze transportéieren.

source_string: Llamas can be tamed the same as horses. However, even when tamed, the player can't control their movements when riding them.
translation: Lamaen kënnen genau wéi Päerd gezamt ginn. Wéi och ëmmer, och wa gezamt, kann den Spiller hir Beweegunge net kontrolléieren, während en si reit.

source_string: A lead can be attached to one, and when this happens, surrounding llamas (both tamed and un-tamed) will follow, making a caravan.
translation: E Léier kann u ee befestegt ginn, a wann dëst geschitt, follegen ëmleiend Lamaen (souwohl gezamt an net gezamt), a bilden eng Karawan.

source_string: Llamas can be equipped with chests, giving it 3-15 slots of inventory space depending on the strength of the Llama. They can also be equipped with carpets. Each carpet color yields a different pattern.
translation: Lamaen kënnen mat Këschten ausgestatt ginn, wat hinnen 3-15 Slot Inventarplaz gëtt, je no Stäerkt vum Lama. Si kënnen och mat Teppecher ausgestatt ginn. All Teppechfaarf gëtt e verschiddent Muster.

source_string: Pigs can be ridden as well, although they won't go where you want without a little incentive.
translation: Schwäin kënne och gereit ginn, obwuel si net dohinner ginn, wou s du wëlls, ouni e bësse Motivatioun.

source_string: Equip a pig with a Saddle and point a Carrot on a Stick in the direction you want to go.
translation: Rüst e Schwäin mat engem Saddel aus a weis eng Karott um Stéckel an d'Richtung, an déi s du wëlls goen.

source_string: When using the D-Pad control scheme, tap :touch_jump: to dismount an animal.
translation: Wann s du d'D-Pad-Steierungsschema benotz, tipp :touch_jump: fir vun engem Déier erofzesetzen.

source_string: When using a Joystick control scheme, tap :tip_virtual_button_dismount: to dismount an animal.
translation: Wann s du e Joystick-Steierungsschema benotz, tipp :tip_virtual_button_dismount: fir vun engem Déier erofzesetzen.

source_string: Welcome to the Overworld, a blocky world full of adventure and possibility!
translation: Wëllkomm an der Overworld, eng blocken Welt voller Aventuren a Méiglechkeeten!

source_string: Look around by touching and dragging the screen.
translation: Kuck ronderëm andeems du de Bildschierm beréiers a zéis.
Beweeg dech an der Welt ronderëm mat :_input_key.forward: :_input_key.left: :_input_key.back: :_input_key.right:.
Beweeg dech an der Welt ronderëm mat :_gamepad_stick_left:.

source_string: Move around the world using the on-screen joystick:tip_virtual_joystick: .
translation: Beweeg dech an der Welt ronderëm mam Joystick um Bildschierm:tip_virtual_joystick: .

source_string: Move around the world using the on-screen buttons.
translation: Beweeg dech an der Welt ronderëm mat de Knäppercher um Bildschierm.

source_string: Move around the world using the on-screen joystick:tip_virtual_joystick: .
translation: Beweeg dech an der Welt ronderëm mam Joystick um Bildschierm:tip_virtual_joystick: .
Beweeg dech an der Welt ronderëm mat :rift_left_stick:.
Beweeg dech an der Welt ronderëm mat :windowsmr_left_stick:.

source_string: The world is full of resources, including §ebuilding blocks§f, §ecrafting materials§f, and §efood§f.
translation: D'Welt ass voller Ressourcen, dorënner §eBaublécker§f, §eBaumaterialien§f, an §eIesswueren§f.

source_string: You can §ebreak blocks§f with your bare hands to gather resources like dirt and wood. Aim at a block, then §epress and hold§f :_input_key.attack:  until it breaks and the resources drop.
translation: Du kanns §eBléck briechen§f mat denger blousser Hand, fir Ressourcen ze sammelen wéi Buedem a Holz. Ziel op e Block, an dréck a §ehalt§f :_input_key.attack:  bis en brécht an d'Ressourcen falen.

source_string: You can §ebreak blocks§f with your bare hands to gather resources like dirt and wood. §eTouch and hold§f on the block until it breaks and the resources drop.
translation: Du kanns §eBléck briechen§f mat denger blousser Hand, fir Ressourcen ze sammelen wéi Buedem a Holz. §eBerréier a halt§f um Block bis en brécht an d'Ressourcen falen.

source_string: You can §ebreak blocks§f with your bare hands to gather resources like dirt and wood. Aim at a block, then §etouch and hold§f :tip_virtual_button_action_attack_or_destroy:  until it breaks and the resources drop.
translation: Du kanns §eBléck briechen§f mat denger blousser Hand, fir Ressourcen ze sammelen wéi Buedem a Holz. Ziel op e Block, an §eberréier a halt§f :tip_virtual_button_action_attack_or_destroy:  bis en brécht an d'Ressourcen falen.

source_string: You can §ebreak blocks§f with your bare hands to gather resources like dirt and wood. Aim at a block, then §eclick and hold§f :_input_key.attack:  until it breaks and the resources drop.
translation: Du kanns §eBléck briechen§f mat denger blousser Hand, fir Ressourcen ze sammelen wéi Buedem a Holz. Ziel op e Block, an §eklick a halt§f :_input_key.attack:  bis en brécht an d'Ressourcen falen.

source_string: Pick up any dropped resources by walking over the floating icons.
translation: Sammel all fale gelooss Ressourcen, andeems du iwwer déi schwiewend Iconen goss.

source_string: Resources you pick up will appear in your §ehotbar§f, which you'll find at the bottom of the screen.
translation: Ressourcen, déi du sammels, erschéngen an denger §eToolbar§f, déi s du um Enn vum Bildschierm fënns.

source_string: To hold an item in your hand, scroll the mouse wheel to select the item. You can also use a number key: 1 is the first hotbar slot and 9 is the last.
translation: Fir en Objet an denger Hand ze halen, scroll d'Maus-Rad fir den Objet auszewielen. Du kanns och eng Zuel-Tast benotzen: 1 ass den éischten Toolbar-Slot a 9 ass de leschten.

source_string: To hold an item in your hand, use :_input_key.cycleItemLeft: and :_input_key.cycleItemRight: to select the item.
translation: Fir en Objet an denger Hand ze halen, benotz :_input_key.cycleItemLeft: an :_input_key.cycleItemRight: fir den Objet auszewielen.

source_string: To hold an item in your hand, simply tap it in the hotbar.
translation: Fir en Objet an denger Hand ze halen, tipp en einfach an der Toolbar.

source_string: To hold an item in your hand, use :rift_left_trigger: and :rift_left_grab: to select the item.
translation: Fir en Objet an denger Hand ze halen, benotz :rift_left_trigger: an :rift_left_grab: fir den Objet auszewielen.

source_string: To hold an item in your hand, use :windowsmr_left_touchpad_horizontal: to select the item.
translation: Fir en Objet an denger Hand ze halen, benotz :windowsmr_left_touchpad_horizontal: fir den Objet auszewielen.

source_string: Some items, like buckets, fishing rods, and bows, can be used by tapping the build/use button :_input_key.use:.
translation: E puer Objeten, wéi Eemer, Aangelen a Bogen, kënnen benotzt gi mam Tippen op de Bau-/Benotzen-Knäppchen :_input_key.use:.

source_string: Some items, like buckets, fishing rods, and bows, can be used by touching and holding anywhere on the screen.
translation: E puer Objeten, wéi Eemer, Aangelen a Bogen, kënnen benotzt gi mam Beréieren a Halen iergendwou um Bildschierm.

source_string: Some items, like buckets, fishing rods, and bows, can be used by tapping the build/use button :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use:.
translation: E puer Objeten, wéi Eemer, Aangelen a Bogen, kënnen benotzt gi mam Tippen op de Bau-/Benotzen-Knäppchen :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use:.

source_string: Any block you've picked up can placed back into the world. This way you can build a cozy §eshelter§f or anything else you can imagine!
translation: All Block, deen s du opgeholl hues, kann zréck an d'Welt placéiert ginn. Sou kanns du e gemittleche §eSchutz§f oder alles anescht, wat s du dir virstelle kanns, baue!

source_string: Choose a block in your hotbar, then press :_input_key.use: to place it.
translation: Wiel e Block an denger Toolbar aus, dréck dann :_input_key.use: fir en ze placéieren.

source_string: Tap a block in your hotbar to select it, then tap somewhere in the world to place it.
translation: Tipp e Block an denger Toolbar fir en auszewielen, tipp dann iergendwou an der Welt fir en ze placéieren.

source_string: Tap a block in your hotbar to select it, then tap :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use: to place it.
translation: Tipp e Block an denger Toolbar fir en auszewielen, tipp dann :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use: fir en ze placéieren.

source_string: Don't worry if you place something in the wrong spot - simply break it again, then pick it back up!
translation: Keng Suerg, wanns du eppes an der falscher Plaz placéiers - brécht et einfach nach eng Kéier a huel et nach eng Kéier op!

source_string: Navigation is an important skill that you will learn in Minecraft as it's not always easy to find your way home.
translation: Navigatioun ass eng wichteg Fäegkeet, déi du a Minecraft léiers, well et net ëmmer einfach ass, deen Wee heem zréck ze fannen.

source_string: First of all, there are some basic tools that you should know about.
translation: Als éischt gëtt et e puer Basisinstrumenter, déi du solls kennen.

source_string: A Compass will point in the direction of the first place you spawned into the world, an easy way to find where you started.
translation: E Kompass weist an d'Richtung vun der éischter Plaz, an där s du gespawnt bass, eng einfach Aart fir ze fannen, wou du ugefaang hues.

source_string: A Map lets you see the area you've explored. Put it in your offhand slot to use it like a mini-map. You can increase its size by adding more paper to the edges in a Crafting Table.
translation: Eng Kaart léisst dech d'Beräich gesinn, dat s du entdeckt hues. Setz si an däin Nebenhandslot, fir si wéi eng Mini-Kaart ze benotzen. Du kanns hir Gréisst erhéijen, andeems du méi Pabeier op d'Ränner op enger Wierkbänk dobäisetz.

source_string: A Locator Map will show you where you are and what direction you are facing in relation to the Locator Map's origin. It will also show you the location of other players in the same world.
translation: Eng Ortungskaart weist dir wou du bass a wat fir eng Richtung s du gerichtst bass, am Verhältnis zum Urspronk vun der Ortungskaart. Si weist dir och d'Positioun vun anere Spiller an der selwechter Welt.

source_string: A Cartography Table can help you create, expand, copy and even name maps.
translation: E Kartografiedësch kann hëllefen, Kaarten z'erschafen, z'erweideren, ze kopéieren a souguer ze benennen.

source_string: Place paper into the first slot to craft a Map. If you add a compass into the second slot you can craft a Locator Map. Adding Paper or a blank Map will let you expand or copy your Map.
translation: Placéier Pabeier an den éischte Slot, fir eng Kaart ze baken. Wanns du e Kompass an den zweeten Slot dobäisetz, kanns du eng Ortungskaart baken. D'Dobäisetze vu Pabeier oder enger eideler Kaart léisst dech deng Kaart erweideren oder kopéieren.

source_string: Try to watch for landmarks as you explore. The more you play on a world, the more you will be able to remember where you are. Another good trick is to place Torches as you go so that you may find your way back home.
translation: Probéier op Landmarken opzepassen, während s du entdecks. Wat méi du op enger Welt spills, wat méi du dech erënnere kanns, wou s de bass. En anere gudden Trick ass, Fakelen ze placéieren, während s du geets, sou dass du deen Wee heem zréck fannen kanns.

source_string: The sun can also tell you what direction you are facing. Remember: the sun rises in the east and sets in the west!
translation: D'Sonn kann dir och seeën, wat fir eng Richtung s du gerichtst bass. Denk drun: D'Sonn geet am Osten op a geet am Weste ënner!

source_string: There are several places for you to explore. Find a village and look for a Cartographer. He will trade you Explorer Maps that will lead you to strange places very far away.
translation: Et gëtt verschidde Plazen fir dech ze entdecken. Fann e Duerf a kuck no engem Kartograf. En handelt dir Entdecker-Kaarten of, déi dech zu komeschen Plazen wäit ewech féieren.

source_string: A Nether Portal allows you to travel to a different dimension.
translation: En Netherportal erlaabt dir an eng aner Dimensioun ze reesen.

source_string: If constructed correctly the Nether Portal can be lit and activated.
translation: Wann richteg konstruéiert, kann d'Netherportal ugelooss an aktivéiert ginn.

source_string: Example of a portal construction shown here:
translation: Beispill vun enger Portalkonstruktioun hei ugewisen:

source_string: In Minecraft, the sun rises and sets as you adventure in your world. As the sun sets, you must take precautions. There are many dangers at night!
translation: A Minecraft geet d'Sonn op an ënner, während s du deng Welt entdecks. Wa d'Sonn ënnergeet, muss du Vorkéier huelen. Et gëtt vill Geforen an der Nuecht!

source_string: If you have not already, you will need a place to take shelter from the dark and what lurks within it. This can be as simple as a hole in the side of a hill or a small cabin in the forest.
translation: Wanns du et net scho gemaach hues, wäers du eng Plaz brauchen, fir dech vun der Däischtert an deem, wat dran lauert, ze schützen. Dëst kann esou einfach sinn wéi e Lach an der Säit vun engem Hiwwel oder eng kleng Kaboun am Bësch.

source_string: Be sure to block off all entrances, you may want to use a door so you can go in and out. If you have made a bed this is a good place to put it along with your Crafting Table and Furnace.
translation: Sief sécher, all Entréeën zouzemaachen, du wëlls vläicht eng Dier benotzen, sou dass s du eran an eraus kanns. Wanns du e Bett gemaach hues, ass dëst eng gutt Plaz fir en ze placéieren, zesumme mat denger Wierkbänk an Uewen.

source_string: Also be sure to light up the area with torches, it may save your life.
translation: Sief och sécher, d'Beräich mat Fakelen z'erliichten, et kéint däi Liewe retten.

source_string: When the sun starts to set, it's time to get ready.
translation: Wann d'Sonn ufänkt ënnerzegoen, ass et Zäit sech prett ze maachen.

source_string: At night, the Overworld is home to zombies, spiders, skeletons, and other dangerous creatures we call §ehostile mobs§f.
translation: An der Nuecht ass d'Overworld d'Heemecht vu Zombien, Spannen, Skeletter an aner geféierlech Kreaturen, déi mir §efeindlech Mobs§f nennen.

source_string: Crafting some §etorches§f can help you see in the dark, while also keeping mobs from spawning too close.
translation: D'Baken vun e puer §eFakelen§f kann dir hëllefen, an der Däischtert ze gesinn, a haalt Mobs och dorunner, ze no ze spawnen.

source_string: While holding a torch, place it into the world by right-clicking a nearby free surface.
translation: Während s du eng Fakel hälls, placéier si an d'Welt duerch e Rietsklick op eng noolauschten fräi Uewerfläch.

source_string: While holding a torch, place it into the world by pressing :_input_key.use:.
translation: Wärend s du eng Fakel hälls, placéier si an d'Welt andeems s du dréckst op :_input_key.use:.

source_string: While holding a torch, place it into the world by tapping a nearby free surface.
translation: Während s du eng Fakel hälls, placéier si an d'Welt andeems du op eng noolauschten fräi Uewerfläch tippss.

source_string: While holding a torch, place it into the world by aiming at a nearby block and tapping :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use:.
translation: Wärend s du eng Fakel hälls, placéier si an d'Welt andeems s du op en no Block ziels an tipps op :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use:.

source_string: There are several mobs in Minecraft that you can tame and make your pet. Each can be tamed by giving them an item that they like. Once tamed you can have them stay by pressing :_input_key.use: while looking at them.
translation: Et gëtt verschidde Mobs a Minecraft, déi s du zamen a zu dengem Haustéier maache kanns. All ee ka gezamt ginn, andeems een him en Objet gëtt, deen hie gefällt. Eemol gezamt kanns du si bleiwe loossen, andeems du :_input_key.use: dréckss während s du si ukucks.

source_string: There are several mobs in Minecraft that you can tame and make your pet. Each can be tamed by giving them an item that they like. Once tamed you can have them stay by tapping the Sit Button.
translation: Et gëtt verschidde Mobs a Minecraft, déi s du zamen a zu dengem Haustéier maache kanns. All ee ka gezamt ginn, andeems een him en Objet gëtt, deen hie gefällt. Eemol gezamt kanns du si bleiwe loossen, andeems du op de Sëtz-Knäppchen tippss.

source_string: Wolves are a neutral mob that hunt in the colder climates. They will attack Rabbits, Skeletons, and Sheep but run away from Llamas. They won't attack you unless you provoke them. You can tame them by giving them Bones.
translation: Wëllef sinn e neutrale Mob, dee an de méi kale Klimazonen jaacht. Si attackéieren Kanéngercher, Skeletter a Schof, mä flüchten vu Lamaen. Si attackéieren dech net, ausser du provokéiers si. Du kanns si zamen, andeems du hinne Been gëss.

source_string: Cats are a neutral mob that can be found in villages. They will attack Rabbits and Baby Turtles. They will also keep Phantoms and Creepers away. They will try to run from you so taming them can be tough. They like fish so give them Raw Cod or Salmon to tame them.
translation: Kazen sinn e neutrale Mob, deen an Duerfer fonnt ka ginn. Si attackéieren Kanéngercher a Puppelen Schëldkröten. Si halen och Phantoms a Creeper wäit. Si probéieren, vun dir ze flüchten, sou dass si zamen schwiereg ka sinn. Si mëllen Fesch, also gëf hinnen Rou Kabeljau oder Somoun, fir si ze zamen.

source_string: Parrots are a passive mob that live in the Jungle. They will imitate any other mob in the area. Seeds are their favorite, give them a few to tame them. Parrots will also sit on your shoulder... Yes, you can have more than one up there.
translation: Papageien sinn e passive Mob, dee an der Jongel lieft. Si iwwerhuelen all aneren Mob an der Nähe. Somen sinn hiert Léifsten, gëf hinnen e puer, fir si ze zamen. Papageien sëtzen och op denger Schëller... Jo, du kanns méi wéi ee do uewen hunn.

source_string: While exploring the world you may encounter a Pillager encampment or patrol. Pillagers are always looking for villages to raid. Taking their Banners will get their attention, and they may choose to attack a nearby village.
translation: Während s du d'Welt entdecks, kéins du op e Plëndererlager oder eng Patrouill trëffen. Plënnerer sichen ëmmer no Duerfer fir z'iwwerfalen. Hir Bannieren wegzehuelen kritt hir Opmierksamkeet, a si kéinte wielen, en no Duerf z'attackéieren.

source_string: Be sure to defend your village, the attack will stop if you defeat all the raiders.
translation: Sief sécher, däin Duerf ze verdeedegen, den Attack hält op, wa du all Räuber gefaall hues.

source_string: Villagers will most likely be very grateful that you have saved them from the raiders. Be sure to check back with them, you might get a good deal.
translation: Awunner ginn wahrscheinlech ganz dankbar sinn, dass s du si vun de Räuber gerett hues. Sief sécher, méi spéit nach eng Kéier nozekucken, du kéins e gudden Deal kréien.

source_string: In Minecraft, you can have your own ranch filled with livestock! Ranching provides lots of resources such as wool, eggs, and raw meat.
translation: A Minecraft kanns du deng eege Ferm hunn, gefëllt mat Vieh! D'Zucht bitt vill Ressourcen wéi Woll, Ee a rou Fleesch.

source_string: In order to keep your livestock growing, you have to make baby animals. Adult animals must enter Love Mode for this to happen. Feed the animals their preferred food to get them to enter Love Mode.
translation: Fir däi Vieh weiderwuesse ze loossen, muss du Puppelendéieren maachen. Erwuesse Déieren mussen an den Léifsmodus komm, fir dass dëst geschitt. Fidder d'Déieren mat hiert Léifsten Iesswuer, fir si an den Léifsmodus ze bréngen.

source_string: When two like animals are nearby and in Love Mode, they will kiss for a moment and then a baby animal will appear! The baby animal will stay with their parents until they grow into an adult. After having a baby, adult animals must wait 1 minute before entering Love Mode.
translation: Wa zwee gläich Déieren an der Nähe sinn an am Léifsmodus, kussen si sech fir e Moment an dann erschéngt e Puppelendéier! D'Puppelendéier bleift mat senge Elteren, bis et zu engem erwuesse Déier wiisst. No engem Puppelendéier musse erwuess Déieren 1 Minutt waarden, éier si nees an den Léifsmodus komm.

source_string: Cows, mooshrooms, and sheep all eat Wheat. Pigs can eat Carrots or Beetroot. Chickens love Seeds of any kinds. Rabbits will eat Carrots, Golden Carrots, or Dandelions. Ocelots enjoy Raw Cod or Salmon. Wolves like to eat any kind of meat.
translation: Kéi, Mooshroomen a Schof iessen all Weess. Schwäin kënnen Karotten oder Biedermuer iessen. Hénger iesse gär Somen vun all Zort. Kanéngercher iessen Karotten, Golde Karotten, oder Léiwenzahn. Ozelotte gefällt Rou Kabeljau oder Somoun. Wëllef iesse gär all Zort Fleesch.

source_string: Animals will follow you when you hold their desired food item. This will help you lead them to your ranch or another animal.
translation: Déieren follegen dir, wanns du hiert gewënschten Iesswuer hälls. Dëst hëlleft dir si zu denger Ferm oder engem anerem Déier ze féieren.

source_string: Don't worry, you don't need to remember every recipe by heart. The §erecipe book§f in your inventory keeps track of blocks and items you can craft - simply click a recipe to see what you need to craft it.
translation: Keng Suerg, du muss net all Rezept aus dem Kapp behalen. Den §eRezeptbuch§f a dengem Inventar hält Kont vu Blécker an Objeten, déi s du baken kanns - klick einfach op e Rezept fir ze gesinn, wat s du fir en baken brauchs.

source_string: Don't worry, you don't need to remember every recipe by heart. The §erecipe book§f in your inventory keeps track of blocks and items you can craft - simply select a recipe to see what you need to craft it.
translation: Keng Suerg, du muss net all Rezept aus dem Kapp behalen. Den §eRezeptbuch§f a dengem Inventar hält Kont vu Blécker an Objeten, déi s du baken kanns - wiel einfach e Rezept fir ze gesinn, wat s du fir en baken brauchs.

source_string: Don't worry, you don't need to remember every recipe by heart. The §erecipe book§f in your inventory keeps track of blocks and items you can craft - simply tap a recipe to see what you need to craft it.
translation: Keng Suerg, du muss net all Rezept aus dem Kapp behalen. Den §eRezeptbuch§f a dengem Inventar hält Kont vu Blécker an Objeten, déi s du baken kanns - tipp einfach op e Rezept fir ze gesinn, wat s du fir en baken brauchs.

source_string: Once you've gathered the required crafting ingredients, click the recipe once more, then move it from the output slot to your hotbar or inventory.
translation: Eemol s du déi néideg Baumaterialien gesammelt hues, klick nach eng Kéier op de Rezept, an réckel en dann vum Output-Slot an deng Toolbar oder Inventar.

source_string: Once you've gathered the required crafting ingredients, select the recipe once more, then move it from the output slot to your hotbar or inventory.
translation: Eemol s du déi néideg Baumaterialien gesammelt hues, wiel nach eng Kéier de Rezept, an réckel en dann vum Output-Slot an deng Toolbar oder Inventar.

source_string: Once you've gathered the required crafting ingredients, tap the recipe once more, then move it from the output slot to your hotbar or inventory.
translation: Eemol s du déi néideg Baumaterialien gesammelt hues, tipp nach eng Kéier de Rezept, an réckel en dann vum Output-Slot an deng Toolbar oder Inventar.

source_string: Redstone Dust comes from Redstone Ore. This dust transmits an electrical signal. When it has power it lights up and transmits its signal to other Redstone items that are next to it.
translation: Redstonestëbs kënnt vu Redstone-Äerz. Dëse Stëbs iwwerdréit e elektreschen Signal. Wann en Kraaft huet, gleeft en op an iwwerdréit säin Signal un aner Redstone-Objeten, déi bei him sinn.

source_string: In order for one of these items to be powered, it needs a power source such as a Lever, Button, or Pressure Plate. Experiment to find them all!
translation: Fir eent vun dëse Objeten mat Kraaft ze speisen, brauch et eng Kraaftquell wéi e Léier, e Knäppchen oder eng Drockplack. Experimentéier fir all ze fannen!

source_string: Place some Redstone Dust next to a power source and turn it on to power it.
translation: Placéier e puer Redstonestëbs niewent enger Kraaftquell an schalt si un, fir hie mat Kraaft ze speisen.

source_string: There are many items that use a Redstone signal to do something, such as a Hopper or a Piston.
translation: Et gëtt vill Objeten, déi e Redstone-Signal benotzen, fir eppes ze maachen, wéi e Trichter oder e Kolben.

source_string: Redstone allows for endless possibilities! Try creating something useful for yourself like an automatic farm!
translation: Redstone erlaabt onendlech Méiglechkeeten! Probéier eppes Nëtzlecht fir dech selwer z'erschafen, wéi eng automatesch Ferm!

source_string: A social hub for you and all the members of the Realm. Share your adventures and creations by posting stories to the Story Feed, like and comment to celebrate stories posted by other members.
translation: E soziale Knuetepunkt fir dech an all Memberen vum Realm. Deel deng Aventuren a Kreatiounen, andeems du Geschichten am Story-Feed posts, gëff a kommentéier fir Geschichten vun aneren Memberen ze feieren.

source_string: Clicking the ADD STORY button on the Story Feed will let you write a story of your own. You can choose to include a screenshot or text (or both!). Clicking the POST button will post your text/screenshot to the Story Feed for all the Realm's members to enjoy. If you don't have any screenshots to post, use the §ecamera§f:camera: on the game menu to capture the moment.
translation: Wann s du op de ADD STORY-Knäppchen um Story-Feed klicks, kanns du eng Geschicht vun dir selwer schreiwen. Du kanns wielen, e Screenshot oder Text (oder béides!) dobäizesetzen. Wann s du op de POST-Knäppchen klicks, gëtt däin Text/Screenshot am Story-Feed posted fir all Memberen vum Realm ze genéissen. Wanns du keng Screenshots hues fir ze posten, benotz d'§eKamera§f:camera: um Spillmenü, fir den Moment festzehalen.

source_string: Whenever there is a new story in the Feed that you haven't read yet, a number will appear on the REALMS STORIES button. You'll always know when there is something new to read from your Realm's community. If you like what someone shared, go ahead and leave them a like or comment on their story!
translation: Wann et eng nei Geschicht am Feed gëtt, déi s du nach net gelies hues, erschéngt eng Zuel um Knäppchen REALMS STORIES. Du weess ëmmer, wann et eppes Neies gëtt, dat s du aus der Gemeinschaft vun dengem Realm liese kanns. Wann dir gefält, wat een gedeelt huet, looss hinnen gär e Gefält oder e Kommentar op senger Geschicht!

source_string: See who's playing and when in the Timeline. Scroll through the members of the Realm to see when they played last and who they played with. Use this information to set up times when you can all play together.
translation: Kuck, wien spillt a wéini, an der Zäitlinn. Scroll duerch d'Memberen vum Realm, fir ze gesinn, wéini si zulescht gespillt hunn a mat wiem si gespillt hunn. Benotz dës Informatioun, fir Zäiten ze plangen, wou dir all zesumme spille kanns.

source_string: Know who is on the Realm

Get to know who is part of the Realm by using the Members tab. It's a list of all the players who can play here. You can see who the Realm owner is, who the operators are, and who has joined Realms Stories for this Realm. There are search, sort, and filter options to help you find exactly who you're looking for.
translation: Léier kennen, wien Deel vum Realm ass, andeems du de Members-Reider benotz. Et ass eng Lëscht vun all de Spiller, déi hei spillen kënnen. Du kanns gesinn, wien den Besëtzer vum Realm ass, wien d'Operatore sinn, a wien Realms Stories fir dëse Realm bäigetruden ass. Et gëtt Such-, Sortéiere- a Filter-Optiounen, déi dir hëllefen, exakt ze fannen, wien du sichs.

source_string: Realms Stories is available in the game menu when you're playing in the Realm and on the Realms Tab. You can keep up to date and tell your story from anywhere you are, even when you aren't playing. From your console, computer, and mobile device, Realms Stories is available everywhere.
translation: Realms Stories ass am Spillmenü verfügbar, wann s du am Realm spills, an um Realms-Reider. Du kanns um leschte Stand bleiwen an deng Geschicht erzielen vun iwwerall, wou du bass, och wann s du net spills. Vun dengem Kansel, Computer a Mobilapparat, Realms Stories ass iwwerall verfügbar.

source_string: Scaffolding can help you create huge structures safely! You can walk inside scaffolding and stand on it. If you have a column of scaffolding you can go upward by standing in the scaffolding and pressing :_input_key.jump:. If you want to travel downward you can press :_input_key.sneak:.
translation: Gerüst kann dir hëllefen, riesege Strukturen sécher opzebauen! Du kanns an d'Gerüst goen a drop stoen. Wanns du eng Kolonn Gerüst hues, kanns du erop goen, andeems du am Gerüst stees an dréckst op :_input_key.jump:. Wanns du erof wëlls, kanns du drécken op :_input_key.sneak:.

source_string: Scaffolding can help you create huge structures safely! You can walk inside scaffolding and stand on it. If you have a column of scaffolding you can go upward by standing in the scaffolding and pressing :_input_key.jump:. If you want to travel downward you can press and hold :_input_key.sneak:.
translation: Gerüst kann dir hëllefen, riesege Strukturen sécher opzebauen! Du kanns an d'Gerüst goen a drop stoen. Wanns du eng Kolonn Gerüst hues, kanns du erop goen, andeems du am Gerüst stees an dréckst op :_input_key.jump:. Wanns du erof wëlls, kanns du dréck an halen op :_input_key.sneak:.

source_string: Scaffolding can help with building large structures by offering a way to reach higher places and safely descend without taking fall damage.
translation: Gerüst kann beim Bau vu groussen Strukturen hëllefen, andeems et eng Aart bitt fir méi héich Plazen z'erreechen a sécher erofzegoen ouni Fallschued ze kréien.

source_string: When using the D-Pad control scheme, tap :touch_jump: to climb up a column of scaffolding. Tap :touch_fly_down: to climb down.
translation: Wann s du d'D-Pad-Steierungsschema benotz, tipp :touch_jump: fir eng Kolonn vu Gerüst eropzeklammen. Tipp :touch_fly_down: fir erofzeklammen.

source_string: When using a Joystick control scheme, press :tip_virtual_button_jump: to climb up a column of scaffolding. Tap :tip_virtual_button_sneak: to climb down.
translation: Wann s du e Joystick-Steierungsschema benotz, dréck :tip_virtual_button_jump: fir eng Kolonn vu Gerüst eropzeklammen. Tipp :tip_virtual_button_sneak: fir erofzeklammen.

source_string: Scaffolding can help you create huge structures safely! You can walk inside scaffolding and stand on it. If you have a column of scaffolding you can go upward by standing in the scaffolding and pressing :rift_A:. If you want to travel downward you can press and hold :rift_X:.
translation: Gerüst kann dir hëllefen, riesege Strukturen sécher opzebauen! Du kanns an d'Gerüst goen a drop stoen. Wanns du eng Kolonn Gerüst hues, kanns du erop goen, andeems du am Gerüst stees an dréckst op :rift_A:. Wanns du erof wëlls, kanns du dréck an halen op :rift_X:.

source_string: Scaffolding can help you create huge structures safely! You can walk inside scaffolding and stand on it. If you have a column of scaffolding you can go upward by standing in the scaffolding and pressing :windowsmr_right_touchpad:. If you want to travel downward you can press and hold :windowsmr_right_stick:.
translation: Gerüst kann dir hëllefen, riesege Strukturen sécher opzebauen! Du kanns an d'Gerüst goen a drop stoen. Wanns du eng Kolonn Gerüst hues, kanns du erop goen, andeems du am Gerüst stees an dréckst op :windowsmr_right_touchpad:. Wanns du erof wëlls, kanns du dréck an halen op :windowsmr_right_stick:.

source_string: Scaffolding needs support. You can only place so many scaffolding horizontally without touching a different block. When you attempt to place too many scaffolding blocks without proper support, it will fall. Scaffolding can be placed like normal blocks, but it can also be placed on its own foundation to quickly build a tall tower.
translation: Gerüst brauch Ënnerstëtzung. Du kanns just sou vill Gerüst horizontal placéieren, ouni en anere Block ze beréieren. Wanns du probéiers ze vill Gerüstblécker ouni riichteg Ënnerstëtzung ze placéieren, fällt et erof. Gerüst kann wéi normal Bléck placéiert ginn, mä kann och op senger eegener Fondatioun placéiert ginn, fir séier en héije Tuerm ze bauen.

source_string: When Scaffolding is broken it will also break every Scaffolding block that was being supported by it. This will let you quickly clean up your scaffolding by breaking the supporting blocks!
translation: Wann Gerüst futti gemaach gëtt, brécht et och all Gerüstblock, deen vun him ënnerstëtzt gouf. Dëst léisst dech séier däin Gerüst opraumen, andeems du d'Ënnerstëtzungsblécker briechs!

source_string: Put on some fresh pixels and express yourself with a huge variety of inspired looks.
translation: Zéi frëschen Pixel un an dréck dech aus mat enger riesegen Villzuel u inspiréierten Looks.

source_string: Structure Blocks give creators the ability to copy and save out sections of their world into structures. Saved structures can then be pasted back into the world.
translation: Konstruktiounsblécker gi Kreatoren d'Fäegkeet, Deeler vun hirer Welt an Strukturen ze kopéieren an erauszespäicheren. Gespäichert Strukturen kënnen dann zréck an d'Welt agepäscht ginn.

source_string: To get a Structure Block you must use the /give slash command. To use a Structure Block, you must have Operator permissions.
translation: Fir e Konstruktiounsblock ze kréien, muss du de /give-Slash-Befeel benotzen. Fir e Konstruktiounsblock ze benotzen, muss du Operator-Rechter hunn.

source_string: Structure Blocks have 4 modes that can be switched between with the Mode dropdown: Save, Load, Corner, and 3D Export.
translation: Konstruktiounsblécker hunn 4 Modi, tëscht deenen ëmmer geschalt ka ginn mam Modus-Dropdown: Späicheren, Lueden, Eck, an 3D-Export.

source_string: Save mode saves an area of the world as a structure.
translation: De Späicher-Modus späichert e Beräich vun der Welt als eng Struktur.

source_string: Load mode loads a structure into the world. Only structures saved to the world or included in a behavior pack that is applied to the world can be loaded.
translation: De Lued-Modus lued eng Struktur an d'Welt. Just Strukturen, déi op der Welt gespäichert sinn oder an engem Behavior-Pack enthalen sinn, dee op d'Welt applizéiert ass, kënne geluede ginn.

source_string: Corner mode is used with save mode's detect button to automatically set the area you want to save. See the Corner Mode section below for more details.
translation: Den Eck-Modus gëtt mam Ernennungs-Knäppchen vum Späicher-Modus benotzt, fir automatesch dat Beräich, dat du wëlls späicheren, z'setzen. Kuck de Eck-Modus-Abschnitt hei ënnendrënner fir méi Detailer.

source_string: 3D Export exports a 3D model file on supported platforms.
On the right side of the Structure Block screen, a preview of the area you have selected or the structure to load will appear depending on the mode the block is in.
translation: Op der rietser Säit vum Konstruktiounsblock-Bildschierm gëtt eng Preview vum Beräich, dat s du ausgewielt hues, oder der Struktur, déi ze lueden ass, ugewisen, je no dem Modus vum Block.

source_string: Press :_input_key.attack: and drag, to rotate the 3D preview.
translation: Dréck :_input_key.attack: an zéi, fir d'3D-Preview ze rotéieren.

source_string: Touch and drag on the preview to rotate the 3D preview.
translation: Beréier a zéi op der Preview, fir d'3D-Preview ze rotéieren.

source_string: Redstone can be used to activate a Structure Block. This will cause it to either save a structure out or load a structure into the world, depending on the mode of the block and its settings.
translation: Redstone kann benotzt gi fir e Konstruktiounsblock z'aktivéieren. Dëst féiert dozou, dass en entweeder eng Struktur eraus späichert oder eng Struktur an d'Welt lued, je no dem Modus vum Block a senge Einstellungen.

source_string: You can change how much of a structure is loaded in by changing the values for Integrity and Seed.
translation: Du kanns änneren, wéivill vun enger Struktur geluede gëtt, andeems du d'Wäerter fir Integritéit a Seed änners.

source_string: Integrity - the percentage of blocks to load in from the structure, accepted values are 0 to 100. Blocks will be chosen randomly if a Seed is not specified.
translation: Integritéit - de Prozentsaz vu Blécker fir aus der Struktur ze lueden, akzeptéiert Wäerter sinn 0 bis 100. Bléck ginn zoufälleg ausgewielt, wann eng Seed net spezifizéiert ass.

source_string: Seed - the value entered here will determine which blocks to remove when using Integrity. Leave this field blank if you want the blocks to be chosen randomly.
translation: Seed - de Wäert, deen hei agin gëtt, bestëmmt, wéi eng Bléck ewechgeholl ginn beim Benotze vun Integritéit. Loosss dëst Feld eidel, wanns du wëlls, dass d'Bléck zoufälleg ausgewielt ginn.

source_string: When a structure with Structure Void blocks is loaded into the world, any block that would have been removed where the structure void block is loading into, will instead stay in the world.
translation: Wann eng Struktur mat Struktur-Void-Blécker an d'Welt geluede gëtt, bleift all Block, deen ewechgeholl gouf, wou de Struktur-Void-Block agelueden gëtt, amplaz an der Welt.

source_string: Example: loading an empty shipwreck into the bottom of the ocean will normally copy air over the water blocks. If the shipwreck was filled with structure void, then the water will stay, and you will have a shipwreck filled with water.
translation: Beispill: Eng eidel Schëffswrack an de Buedem vum Ozean ze lueden, kopéiert normalerweis Loft iwwer d'Waasserblécker. Wann d'Schëffswrack mat Struktur-Void gefëllt gouf, bleift d'Waasser, an du hues eng Schëffswrack gefëllt mat Waasser.

source_string: To automatically select the area you want to save, you can place Corner Mode blocks around your structure and name them with the same name as the structure you want to save.
translation: Fir automatesch dat Beräich auszewielen, dat s du wëlls späicheren, kanns du Eck-Modus-Blécker ronderëm deng Struktur placéieren a si mam selwechten Numm benennen wéi d'Struktur, déi s du wëlls späicheren.

source_string: Pressing the Detect button in Save mode will find all of the Corner Blocks with the same name and create a selection area so that it will save everything inside of the volume those Corner Blocks make.
translation: D'Drécke vum Detektéier-Knäppchen am Späicher-Modus fënnt all d'Eck-Blécker mam selwechten Numm an erschaaft e Selektiounsberäich, sou dass et alles bannent dem Volumen späichert, dat déi Eck-Blécker maachen.

source_string: Combine two Shulker Shells with a Chest to create a Shulker Box. Shulker Shells are dropped by Shulkers found in End Cities. Unlike other containers, Shulker Boxes keep their items when broken. Shulker Boxes will break and drop as an item if pushed by Pistons, and can be placed using Dispensers.
translation: Kombinéier zwou Shulker-Muschelen mat enger Këscht, fir eng Shulker-Këscht z'erschafen. Shulker-Muschelen ginn vu Shulkeren fale gelooss, déi an End-Stied fonnt ginn. Am Géigesaz zu anere Behälter halen Shulker-Këschten hir Objeten, wa si futti gemaach ginn. Shulker-Këschten briechen a fale wéi en Objet, wa si vu Kolben gepucht ginn, a kënnen mat Werfer placéiert ginn.

source_string: How to Play: The Crafting Table
Ready to take your crafting to the next level? Place four planks in a square in your crafting grid, and you'll get a §ecrafting table§f :crafting_table: - a whole new way to craft.
translation: Prett fir däi Baken op déi nächst Stufe ze bréngen? Placéier vir Bräider an engem Quadrat a dengem Baugitter, an du kriss eng §eWierkbänk§f :crafting_table: - eng ganz nei Aart fir ze baken.

source_string: Place your crafting table in the world, then right-click it to open it. The larger crafting grid will let you make bigger and better things, including tools, beds, and doors.
translation: Placéier deng Wierkbänk an der Welt, Rietsklick dann drop, fir se opzemaachen. Dat méi grousst Baugitter léisst dech méi grouss a méi gutt Saache maachen, dorënner Wierkzeuger, Better a Diren.

source_string: Place your crafting table in the world, then walk up to it and press :_input_key.use: to open it. The larger crafting grid will let you make bigger and better things, including tools, beds, and doors.
translation: Placéier deng Wierkbänk an der Welt, geh dann drop a dréck :_input_key.use: fir si opzemaachen. Dat méi grousst Baugitter léisst dech méi grouss a méi gutt Saache maachen, dorënner Wierkzeuger, Better a Diren.

source_string: Place your crafting table in the world, then tap it to open it. The larger crafting grid will let you make bigger and better things, including tools, beds, and doors.
translation: Placéier deng Wierkbänk an der Welt, tipp dann drop, fir si opzemaachen. Dat méi grousst Baugitter léisst dech méi grouss a méi gutt Saache maachen, dorënner Wierkzeuger, Better a Diren.

source_string: The End is another dimension which can be accessed through an active End Portal. The End Portal can be found in a Stronghold, which is deep underground in the Overworld.
translation: The End ass eng aner Dimensioun, déi duerch en aktiivt End-Portal zougänglech ass. Den End-Portal kann an enger Festung fonnt ginn, déi déif ënner der Äerd an der Overworld ass.

source_string: Every End Portal Frame block is missing something mysterious to bring out the power within.
translation: All End-Portal-Rahme-Block feelt eppes mysteriéist, fir déi Kraaft dran ze bréngen.

source_string: Once the portal is active, jump into it to go to The End.
translation: Eemol dat Portal aktiv ass, sprang eran, fir zu The End ze goen.

source_string: The End is home to the dreaded Ender Dragon. She is a fierce and powerful enemy and seems to draw power from strange crystals. Her breath and fireball attacks leave lingering acid across the battlefield. Bring some friends to ensure your victory!
translation: The End ass d'Heemecht vum gefaartenen Ender-Dragon. Si ass en gefaarten a mächtegen Géigner a scheint Kraaft aus komeschen Kristaller z'zéien. Hiren Otem an Feierballattacken loossen verweilenden Säur iwwer d'Kampffeld. Bréng e puer Frënn mat, fir däin Victoire ze sécheren!

source_string: If once wasn't enough, add four End Crystals to the exit portal corners to reawaken the Ender Dragon.
translation: Wann eng Kéier net genuch war, setz vir End-Kristaller an d'Auslossportal-Eckplazen dobäi, fir den Ender-Dragon nees ze erwächen.

source_string: Texture packs visually transform the game's appearance, applying a fresh coat of paint to your Minecraft world.
translation: Texture Packs verwandelen visuell d'Erscheinungsbild vum Spill, andeems si eng frësche Faarfschicht op deng Minecraft-Welt applizéieren.

source_string: There are many tools in Minecraft that will allow you mine blocks faster than your fist. Tools can be crafted from Wood, Stone, Iron, Gold, Diamond, or Netherite.
translation: Et gëtt vill Wierkzeuger a Minecraft, déi dech Bléck méi séier ofbauen léissen wéi mat dengem Fauscht. Wierkzeuger kënnen aus Holz, Steen, Eisen, Gold, Diamant oder Netherit gebakt ginn.

source_string: Using the right tool for the job will not only mine that block faster, but will also lose less durability. More complex tools must be created in order to mine rarer resources.
translation: D'richteg Wierkzeug fir den Job benotzen brécht net just dee Block méi séier, mä verléiert och manner Dauerhaftegkeet. Méi komplexe Wierkzeuger mussen erschaaft ginn, fir méi rare Ressourcen ofzebauen.

source_string: The Pickaxe is good at breaking hard blocks like Cobblestone, Iron, or Furnaces.
translation: D'Spëtz ass gutt zum Briechen vu haarde Blécker wéi Kobelsteen, Eisen oder Uewen.

source_string: The Axe is good at breaking wooden blocks like Logs, Planks, or Crafting Tables.
translation: D'Axt ass gutt zum Briechen vu Holzblécker wéi Stämm, Bräider oder Wierkbänken.

source_string: The Shovel is good at breaking loose blocks like Dirt, Sand, and Gravel. Shovels can also create a path by pressing :_input_key.use: on grass blocks.
translation: D'Schëpp ass gutt zum Briechen vu lockere Blécker wéi Buedem, Sand a Kis. Schëppen kënnen och e Wee erschafen, andeems een :_input_key.use: op Rueseblécker dréckt.

source_string: The Shovel is good at breaking loose blocks like Dirt, Sand, and Gravel. Shovels can also create a path by tapping on grass blocks.
translation: D'Schëpp ass gutt zum Briechen vu lockere Blécker wéi Buedem, Sand a Kis. Schëppen kënnen och e Wee erschafen, andeems een op Rueseblécker tippt.

source_string: The Hoe is required for tilling Dirt to plant crops. Press :_input_key.use: on Dirt or Grass blocks to turn them into Farmland.
translation: D'Hak ass erfuerderlech fir Buedem z'ackeren, fir Ernte ze planzen. Dréck :_input_key.use: op Buedem- oder Rueseblécker, fir si zu Ackerland ëmzewandelen.

source_string: The Hoe is required for tilling Dirt to plant crops. Tap Dirt or Grass blocks to turn them into Farmland.
translation: D'Hak ass erfuerderlech fir Buedem z'ackeren, fir Ernte ze planzen. Tipp op Buedem- oder Rueseblécker, fir si zu Ackerland ëmzewandelen.

source_string: All of these tools can accept enchantments, either from the Enchanting Table or Anvil.
translation: All dës Wierkzeuger kënnen Verzauerungen akzeptéieren, entweeder vum Verzauerungstesch oder Ambass.

source_string: There are even more tools to aid you on your adventure:
translation: Et gëtt nach méi Wierkzeuger, déi dir bei denger Aventure hëllefen:

source_string: A Bucket will allow you to collect things like Water, Milk, Lava, and even Fish.
translation: En Eemer léisst dech Saache wéi Waasser, Mëllech, Lava, a souguer Fesch sammelen.

source_string: Flint & Steel allows you to light fires... be careful in densely wooded areas!
translation: Feierstein & Eisen léisst dech Feier maachen... sief virsiichteg an dicht bewaldene Beräicher!

source_string: A Fishing Rod lets you catch fish and other loot from water blocks. It can also be used to pull other players and mobs. Fishing Rods can also be enchanted!
translation: Eng Aangel léisst dech Fesch an aner Beutt aus Waasserblécker fänken. Si kann och benotzt gi fir aner Spiller a Mobs erunzezéien. Aangelen kënnen och verzauert ginn!

source_string: Shears are very handy for collecting items like Wool, Leaves, and Cobwebs.
translation: Scheer sinn ganz nëtzlech fir Objeten wéi Woll, Blieder a Spannewebs ze sammelen.

source_string: Trading can be done in villages. Each villager has a profession; they can be Farmers, Butchers, Blacksmiths, Cartographers, Librarians, or Priests. Some professions will trade for items that other professions cannot. Explore and trade with many villagers to find all the trades.
translation: Handel kann an Duerfer gemaach ginn. All Awunner huet e Beruff; si kënnen Ackerbaueren, Fleeschhaner, Schmieder, Kartografen, Bibliothekaren oder Priesteren sinn. E puer Beruffer handelen fir Objeten, déi aner Beruffer net kënnen. Entdeck a handel mat villen Awunner, fir all d'Handeler ze fannen.

source_string: You can find out what a villager is offering as trade by interacting with them. A villager may adjust the price of a trade whenever a player trades with it. A villager may run out of stock, temporarily disabling the trade if it is used too frequently. Trades usually involve buying or selling items for emeralds.
translation: Du kanns eraushuelen, wat en Awunner als Handel offréiert, andeems du mat him interagéiers. En Awunner kéint den Präis vun engem Handel upassen, wann ëmmer e Spiller mat him handelt. En Awunner kéint aus dem Stock kommen, wat den Handel temporär desaktivéiert, wann en ze oft benotzt gëtt. Handel bezitt sech normalerweis op de Kaf oder Verkaf vun Objeten fir Emerald.

source_string: As you trade with villagers, they will get better at their profession and start to offer better and more valuable trades.
translation: Während s du mat Awunner handels, ginn si besser a hirem Beruff a fänken un, méi gutt a méi wäertvoll Handeler unzebidden.

source_string: Take care of your villagers, they need to rest, work, and eat to thrive.
translation: Pass op deng Awunner op, si musse ruen, schaffen an iessen, fir ze gedeien.

source_string: There are many ways to get around other than walking or riding a mount or flying.
translation: Et gëtt vill Weeër fir vun A op B ze kommen, anescht wéi ze goen oder e Réider ze reiden oder ze fléien.

source_string: Minecarts are ridable carts that roll on Rails. You can make the Rails go wherever you want by placing them next to each other. Place a Minecart on the Rails and you are ready to ride.
translation: Minesgleeser sinn reibar Gleeser, déi op Rails rullen. Du kanns d'Rails goen loossen, wouhinner s du wëlls, andeems du si niewentenee placéiers. Placéier e Minesgleen op de Rails, a du bass prett fir ze reiden.

source_string: Minecarts are ridable carts that roll on Rails, which you can build to go anywhere. Just place multiple Rails next to each other, place a Minecart on it, and you're ready to ride.
translation: Minesgleeser sinn reibar Gleeser, déi op Rails rullen, déi s du bauen kanns, fir iergendwou hinzegoen. Placéier einfach méi Rails niewentenee, placéier e Minesgleen dropp, a du bass prett fir ze reiden.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: while looking at a Minecart to hop in and ride. Press :_input_key.forward: to roll forward. Press :_input_key.jump: or :_input_key.sneak: to get out.
translation: Dréck :_input_key.use: während s du e Minesgleen ukucks, fir eranzespréngen a ze reiden. Dréck :_input_key.forward: fir no vir ze rullen. Dréck :_input_key.jump: oder :_input_key.sneak: fir erauszekommen.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: while looking at a Minecart to hop in and ride. Push :_gamepad_stick_left: forward to roll forward. Press :_input_key.jump: or :_input_key.sneak: to get out.
translation: Dréck :_input_key.use: während s du e Minesgleen ukucks, fir eranzespréngen a ze reiden. Dréck :_gamepad_stick_left: no vir fir no vir ze rullen. Dréck :_input_key.jump: oder :_input_key.sneak: fir erauszekommen.

source_string: Look at a Minecart and tap "Ride" to hop in.
translation: Kuck e Minesgleen un a tipp "Reiden" fir eranzespréngen.

source_string: When using the D-Pad control scheme, tap and hold :touch_forward: to start moving forward and build momentum, and tap :touch_jump: to get out.
translation: Wann s du d'D-Pad-Steierungsschema benotz, tipp a halt :touch_forward: fir unzefänken no vir ze goen a Momentum opzebauen, an tipp :touch_jump: fir erauszekommen.

source_string: When using a Joystick control scheme, drag :tip_virtual_joystick: up to start moving forward and build momentum, and tap :tip_virtual_button_dismount: to get out.
translation: Wann s du e Joystick-Steierungsschema benotz, zéi :tip_virtual_joystick: erop fir unzefänken no vir ze goen a Momentum opzebauen, an tipp :tip_virtual_button_dismount: fir erauszekommen.

source_string: Boats let you travel across water. Place one on a water block and you are ready to go.
translation: Booter léisse dech iwwer d'Waasser reesen. Placéier ee op e Waasserblock a du bass prett fir ze goen.

source_string: Boats let you travel across water. Just place one on a water block and you're ready to go.
translation: Booter léisse dech iwwer d'Waasser reesen. Placéier einfach ee op e Waasserblock a du bass prett fir ze goen.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: while looking at a Boat to board it. Press :_input_key.left: or :_input_key.right: to turn left or right. Press :_input_key.forward: to move forward. Press :_input_key.jump: or :_input_key.sneak: to get out.
translation: Dréck :_input_key.use: während s du en Boot ukucks, fir dran ze klammen. Dréck :_input_key.left: oder :_input_key.right: fir lénks oder riets ze dréinen. Dréck :_input_key.forward: fir no vir ze goen. Dréck :_input_key.jump: oder :_input_key.sneak: fir erauszekommen.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: while looking at a Boat to board it. Push :_gamepad_stick_left: left or right to turn. Push :_gamepad_stick_left: forward to move forward. Press :_input_key.jump: or :_input_key.sneak: to get out.
translation: Dréck :_input_key.use: während s du en Boot ukucks, fir dran ze klammen. Dréck :_gamepad_stick_left: lénks oder riets fir ze dréinen. Dréck :_gamepad_stick_left: no vir fir no vir ze goen. Dréck :_input_key.jump: oder :_input_key.sneak: fir erauszekommen.

source_string: Look at a Boat and tap "Board" to board it.
translation: Kuck op e Boot a tipp op "Aboarden", fir un Bord ze goen.

source_string: When using the D-Pad control scheme, tap :touch_left: or :touch_right: to turn left or right, or tap and hold both to move forward. Tap "Leave Boat" to get out.
translation: Wann s du d'D-Pad-Steuerung benotzt, tipp op :touch_left: oder :touch_right:, fir lénks oder riets ze dréinen, oder tipp a halt béid, fir no vir ze goen. Tipp op "Boot verloossen", fir erauszekommen.

source_string: When using a Joystick control scheme, drag :tip_virtual_joystick: up to move forward and tap :tip_virtual_button_dismount: to get out.
translation: Wann s du eng Joystick-Steuerung benotzt, zéi :tip_virtual_joystick: no uewen, fir no vir ze goen, an tipp op :tip_virtual_button_dismount:, fir erauszekommen.

source_string: The Sword is the primary melee weapon in Minecraft. It can be made from Wood, Stone, Iron, Gold, Diamond, or Netherite. Jump attacks do critical damage!
translation: D'Schwäert ass déi wichtegst Nokampfwaff a Minecraft. Et kann aus Holz, Steen, Eisen, Gold, Diamant oder Netherite gemaach ginn. Sprangattacke maachen kritesche Schued!

source_string: Press :_input_key.attack: with a Sword in your hand to attack.
translation: Dréck :_input_key.attack: mat engem Schwäert an der Hand, fir unzegräifen.
Tipp op Mobs, fir se unzegräifen.

source_string: The Bow is the primary ranged weapon in Minecraft. Press and hold :_input_key.use: to draw the bow back. Release :_input_key.use: to fire an arrow. The bow requires arrows to fire.
translation: De Bou ass déi wichtegst Distanzwaff a Minecraft. Dréck a halt :_input_key.use:, fir de Bou zeréckzezéien. Looss :_input_key.use: lass, fir e Feil ofzeschéissen. De Bou brauch Feilen, fir ze schéissen.

source_string: The Bow is the primary ranged weapon in Minecraft. Press and hold the Screen to draw the bow back. Release the press to fire an arrow. The bow requires arrows to fire.
translation: De Bou ass déi wichtegst Distanzwaff a Minecraft. Dréck a halt de Bildschierm, fir de Bou zeréckzezéien. Looss lass, fir e Feil ofzeschéissen. De Bou brauch Feilen, fir ze schéissen.

source_string: Bows do more damage the further they are pulled back, make sure to pull it all the way back.
translation: De Bou mécht méi Schued, wann e méi wäit zeréckgezunn gëtt; zéi en ëmmer ganz zeréck.

source_string: The Crossbow is an alternate ranged weapon. Press and hold :_input_key.use: to load the crossbow. Once the Crossbow is loaded, it will stay loaded until it is fired. Press :_input_key.use: to fire an arrow. The Crossbow requires arrows to load.
translation: D'Armbrust ass eng alternativ Distanzwaff. Dréck a halt :_input_key.use:, fir d'Armbrust opzelueden. Wann d'Armbrust gelueden ass, bleift si gelueden, bis se ofgeschoss gëtt. Dréck :_input_key.use:, fir e Feil ofzeschéissen. D'Armbrust brauch Feilen, fir opgelueden ze ginn.

source_string: The crossbow is a ranged weapon which requires an arrow to be loaded. Tap and hold anywhere on the screen to load the crossbow with an arrow.
translation: D'Armbrust ass eng Distanzwaff, déi mat engem Feil opgelueden ginn muss. Tipp a halt iergendwou op de Bildschierm, fir d'Armbrust mat engem Feil opzelueden.

source_string: Once you've loaded the crossbow it'll stay loaded until fired, even when you put it in your inventory.
translation: Wann s du d'Armbrust opgelueden hues, bleift si gelueden, bis se ofgeschoss gëtt, och wann s du si an den Inventar leets.

source_string: Tap anywhere on the screen to fire a loaded crossbow.
translation: Tipp iergendwou op de Bildschierm, fir eng opgeluedene Armbrust ofzeschéissen.

source_string: If you're using Action Buttons, tap :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use: to fire a loaded crossbow.
translation: Wann s du Aktiounsknäppercher benotzt, tipp op :tip_virtual_button_action_build_or_use:, fir eng opgeluedene Armbrust ofzeschéissen.

source_string: The Trident is a dual-purpose melee and ranged weapon. Press :_input_key.attack: to attack. Press and hold :_input_key.use: to draw the trident back. Release :_input_key.use: to throw the trident. The Trident is the best weapon underwater.
translation: Den Dräizack ass eng Waff, déi souwuel am Nokampf wéi och op Distanz benotzt ka ginn. Dréck :_input_key.attack:, fir unzegräifen. Dréck a halt :_input_key.use:, fir den Dräizack zeréckzezéien. Looss :_input_key.use: lass, fir den Dräizack ze geheien. Den Dräizack ass déi bescht Waff ënner Waasser.

source_string: The Trident is a dual-purpose melee and ranged weapon. Tap mobs to attack them. Press and hold the Screen to draw the trident back. Release the press to throw the trident. The Trident is the best weapon underwater.
translation: Den Dräizack ass eng Waff, déi souwuel am Nokampf wéi och op Distanz benotzt ka ginn. Tipp op Mobs, fir se unzegräifen. Dréck a halt de Bildschierm, fir den Dräizack zeréckzezéien. Looss lass, fir den Dräizack ze geheien. Den Dräizack ass déi bescht Waff ënner Waasser.

source_string: The Sword, Bow, Crossbow, and Trident have specific enchantments that you can get from the Enchanting Table or Anvil that will improve damage, durability and even light mobs on fire!
translation: D'Schwäert, de Bou, d'Armbrust an den Dräizack hunn spezifesch Verzauberungen, déi s du vum Verzauberungstësch oder Amboss kriss, déi de Schued a d'Haltbarkeet verbesseren an souguer Mobs a Brand setzen!

source_string: Worlds in the Minecraft Marketplace Minecraft levels where our partners have altered the terrain and placed new blocks to create amazing structures and terrain for you to explore and enjoy.
translation: Welten am Minecraft Marketplace sinn Minecraft-Welten, an deenen eis Partner d'Terrain geännert an nei Bléck gesat hunn, fir erstaunlech Bauwierker a Landschaften ze schafen, déi s du entdecke a genéissen kanns.

source_string: Worlds can also include new items, mobs, blocks and even custom gameplay.
translation: Welten kënnen och nei Géigestänn, Kreaturen, Bléck a souguer eegent Gameplay enthalen.

source_string: All of the content in the Marketplace is created by our professional commiunity creators.
translation: Den ganzen Inhalt am Marketplace gëtt vun eisen professionelle Community-Creators erstallt.

source_string: Worlds can do so much, we've created several Sub-Categories to help describe what they can do:
translation: Welten kënnen esou vill, dofir hu mir verschidde Ënnerkategorien erstallt, déi beschreiwen, wat si kënne maachen:

source_string: Mini-Games are smaller worlds that include new game mechanics, challenges, or rules.
translation: Mini-Spiller si méi kleng Welten mat neie Spillmechanike, Erausfuerderungen oder Regelen.

source_string: These games are made with multiplayer in mind, letting you test your skills and have fun with your friends.
translation: Dës Spiller si fir Multiplayer gemaach, sou datt s du deng Fäegkeeten testen a mat dengen Frënn Spaass hu kanns.

source_string: Survival Spawns let you start playing in a custom-built world, while still enjoying the classic survival mechanics of Minecraft.
translation: Mat Iwwerliewens-Spawns kanns du an enger selwer gebauter Welt spillen an trotzdeem d'klassesch Iwwerliewensmechanike vu Minecraft genéissen.

source_string: Just like in Survival mode you will have health and hunger, and need to fight dangerous mobs.
translation: Genau wéi am Iwwerliewensmodus hues du Liewenspunkten a Honger a muss géint geféierlech Kreaturen kämpfen.

source_string: Adventure Maps let you use Minecraft to play a totally different kind of game.
translation: Mat Aventurekaarten kanns du Minecraft benotzen, fir eng ganz aner Zort Spill ze spillen.

source_string: You can not break blocks or place new blocks in these worlds.
translation: An dëse Welten kanns du keng Bléck ofbriechen oder nei placéieren.

source_string: Dynamic Worlds allow you to explore the creative designs of our marketplace creators in a randomly generated map.
translation: Mat dynamesche Welten kanns du d'kreativ Designs vun eisen Marketplace-Creators an enger zoufälleg generéierter Kaart entdecken.

source_string: Worlds can have new biomes, customized structures (randomly generated buildings), new blocks, textures, and mobs.
translation: Welten kënnen nei Biomen, ugepasste Strukturen (zoufälleg generéiert Gebaier), nei Bléck, Texturen a Kreaturen hunn.

source_string: How to Play: Your First Craft
translation: Wéi spillt een: Däin éischte Crafting

source_string: Many blocks, like wood, can be turned into useful items by crafting. To do this, you'll find a simple §ecrafting grid§f on the right-hand side of your inventory screen.
translation: Vill Bléck, wéi Holz, kënne duerch Crafting a nëtzlech Géigestänn ëmgewandelt ginn. Dofir fënns du en einfacht §eCrafting-Gitter§f riets am Inventarbildschierm.

source_string: For example, put a single wood log anywhere on the crafting grid, and several planks will appear in the §eoutput slot§f.
translation: Setz zum Beispill e Stamm iergendwou op d'Crafting-Gitter, a méi Brieder erschéngen am §eOutput-Slot§f.

source_string: Simply tap your shiny new planks and they will appear in your hotbar. Now you're ready to place them into the world!
translation: Tippt einfach op deng blénkend nei Brieder, a si erschéngen an denger Hotbar. Elo kanns du si an d'Welt placéieren!

source_string: Simply drag your shiny new planks to your hotbar. Now you're ready to place them into the world!
translation: Zéi einfach deng blénkend nei Brieder an deng Hotbar. Elo kanns du si an d'Welt placéieren!

source_string: Simply select your shiny new planks and they will appear in your hotbar. Now you're ready to place them into the world!
translation: Wiel einfach deng blénkend nei Brieder aus, a si erschéngen an denger Hotbar. Elo kanns du si an d'Welt placéieren!

source_string: Some items require you to place your crafting ingredients in a certain shape - also called a §erecipe§f.
translation: Fir munch Géigestänn musst du deng Crafting-Zutaten a bestëmmter Form placéieren - dat nennt een e §eRezept§f.

source_string: Try placing two planks above each other to create some sticks. Useful for all sorts of things!
translation: Probéier zwee Brieder iwwerteneen ze placéieren, fir Stécker ze maachen. Nëtzlech fir alles méigleches!

source_string: There was a problem connecting to Immersive Reader.
translation: Et gouf e Problem beim Verbannen mam Immersive Reader.

source_string: There was a problem connecting to Immersive Reader. Please restart Minecraft Education and try again.
translation: Et gouf e Problem beim Verbannen mam Immersive Reader. Start Minecraft Education nei a probéier nach eng Kéier.

source_string: World import failed: Unsupported file format
Project import failed: Unsupported file format
Invite Members to your Realm Server
Some of your invites may have failed to send.
translation: Verschidde vun dengen Invitatiounen konnten eventuell net geschéckt ginn.

source_string: You haven't added anyone to your friend's list!
translation: Du hues nach kee bei deng Frëndeslëscht bäigefüügt!

source_string: You haven't added anyone to your Realm!
translation: Du hues nach kee bei däi Realm bäigefüügt!

source_string: Something went wrong. We couldn't load your friends list.
translation: Iergendeppes ass falsch gaang. Mir konnten deng Frëndeslëscht net lueden.

source_string: Something went wrong. We couldn't load some of your friends details.
translation: Iergendeppes ass falsch gaang. Mir konnten d'Detailer vu verschiddene vun dengen Frënn net lueden.

source_string: Double tap the invite at the top of the screen to accept
translation: Duebel tippen op d'Invitatioun uewen um Bildschierm fir unzehuelen

source_string: %s has invited you to play Minecraft
translation: %s huet dech agelueden, fir Minecraft ze spillen

source_string: %s has invited you to play Minecraft
translation: %s huet dech agelueden, fir Minecraft ze spillen
