Light Gray Per Bend Sinister Inverted

translation: :hollow_star: Net fale looss Géigestänn kënnen net:

source_string: This item is not lost on death
translation: Dëse Géigestand geet bei sengem Doud net verluer

source_string: :hollow_star: Can't Drop Items can't be: dropped, removed, crafted with
translation: :hollow_star: Net fale looss Géigestänn kënnen net: fale gelooss, geläscht, gecraft ginn mat

source_string: :solid_star: Can't Move Items can't be: moved, dropped, removed, crafted with
translation: :solid_star: Net réckelbar Géigestänn kënnen net: geréckelt, fale gelooss, geläscht, gecraft ginn mat

source_string: You need Creative + Operator to spawn an NPC
translation: Du brauchs Kreativ + Operator, fir en NPC ze spawnen

source_string: You need Creative + Operator to place this block
translation: Du brauchs Kreativ + Operator, fir dëse Block ze placéieren

source_string: Can hold a mixed stack of items
translation: Kann e gemëschte Stack u Géigestänn halen

context: Example: Apple join code entry 2 of 5

source_string: The join code you entered does not match any worlds that are currently available.
translation: Den Bäitrëttscode, deen s du agitt hues, entsprécht kenger vun de verfügbare Welten.

source_string: There was a problem connecting to the join code service. Please try again.

source_string: This device is no longer supported.
translation: Dëst Gerät gëtt net méi ënnerstëtzt.

source_string: Our ability to support this device is coming to an end. You will continue to receive updates until March of 2025, when you will receive your final update for this device.%sAfter you receive the final update, you will still be able to play on your worlds, and access Marketplace purchases (including Minecoins). Realms managed with this device will continue to work for 6 months unless they are updated by the Realm owner on a different device.%sTo cancel your Realm subscription, you will need to do so in the Settings menu for Subscriptions on the device the Realm was created with.%sYou will no longer receive the latest updates and will be unable to play multiplayer with devices or Realms which are continuing to receive updates. You will also not be able to connect to certain servers.%sClick on the button for more information.
translation: Eis Fäegkeet fir dëst Gerät z'ënnerstëtzen geet dem Enn zou. Du kriss weider Aktualiséierungen bis Mäerz 2025, wann s de deng lescht Aktualiséierung fir dëst Gerät kriss.%sNodeems du déi lescht Aktualiséierung kritts, kanns du weiderhin op dengen Welten spillen an op Marketplace-Käf zougräifen (och Minecoins). Realms, déi mat dësem Gerät verwalt ginn, funktionéieren nach 6 Méint, ausser wa se vum Realm-Besëtzer op engem anere Gerät aktualiséiert ginn.%sFir däin Realm-Abonnement ofzebriechen, muss s de dat am Astellungsmenü fir Abonnementer op dem Gerät maachen, mat deem de Realm erstallt gouf.%sDu kriss keng weider aktuell Aktualiséierungen a kanns net méi mat Geräter oder Realms Multispiller spillen, déi weider Aktualiséierungen kréien. Du kanns och net méi op bestëmmte Serveren zougräifen.%sKlick op de Knäppchen fir méi Infos.

source_string: Our ability to support this device has come to an end. You will no longer receive updates as of March of 2025, and this is your final update for this device.%sYou will still be able to play on your worlds, and access Marketplace purchases (including Minecoins). Realms managed with this device will continue to work for 6 months from March of 2025 unless they are updated by the Realm owner on a different device.%sTo cancel your Realm subscription, you will need to do so in the Settings menu for Subscriptions on the device the Realm was created with.%sYou will no longer receive the latest updates and will be unable to play multiplayer with devices or Realms which are continuing to receive updates. You will also not be able to connect to certain servers.%sClick on the button for more information.
translation: Eis Fäegkeet fir dëst Gerät z'ënnerstëtzen ass ofgeschloss. Du kriss ab Mäerz 2025 keng Aktualiséierungen méi, an dëst ass deng lescht Aktualiséierung fir dëst Gerät.%sDu kanns weiderhin op dengen Welten spillen an op Marketplace-Käf zougräifen (och Minecoins). Realms, déi mat dësem Gerät verwalt ginn, funktionéieren nach 6 Méint ab Mäerz 2025, ausser wa se vum Realm-Besëtzer op engem anere Gerät aktualiséiert ginn.%sFir däin Realm-Abonnement ofzebriechen, muss s de dat am Astellungsmenü fir Abonnementer op dem Gerät maachen, mat deem de Realm erstallt gouf.%sDu kriss keng weider aktuell Aktualiséierungen a kanns net méi mat Geräter oder Realms Multispiller spillen, déi weider Aktualiséierungen kréien. Du kanns och net méi op bestëmmte Serveren zougräifen.%sKlick op de Knäppchen fir méi Infos.

source_string: Our ability to support this VR/MR graphic device has come to an end. This device will no longer be supported in updates after March of 2025, when you will receive your final update supporting this device.%sAfter you receive the final update, you will still receive updates on your PC and be able to play without a VR/MR device. From this point on you can keep building in your worlds, and your Marketplace purchases (including Minecoins) will continue to be available on a non-VR/MR graphics devices such as a computer monitor. You will no longer be able to use your VR/MR device with Minecraft as it will no longer be supported in the latest updates.%sClick on the button for more information.
translation: Eis Fäegkeet fir dëst VR/MR-Grafikgerät z'ënnerstëtzen geet dem Enn zou. Dëst Gerät gëtt no Mäerz 2025 an Aktualiséierungen net méi ënnerstëtzt, wann s de deng lescht Aktualiséierung fir dëst Gerät kriss.%sNodeems du déi lescht Aktualiséierung kritts, kriss du weiderhin Aktualiséierungen op dengem PC a kanns ouni VR/MR-Gerät spillen. Vun dësem Zäitpunkt un kanns du weider a dengen Welten bauen, an deng Marketplace-Käf (och Minecoins) bleiwen op net-VR/MR-Grafikgeräter verfügbar wéi zum Beispill engem Computerbildschierm. Du kanns däi VR/MR-Gerät net méi mat Minecraft benotzen, well et an de leschten Aktualiséierungen net méi ënnerstëtzt gëtt.%sKlick op de Knäppchen fir méi Infos.

source_string: Our ability to support this VR/MR graphic device has come to an end. This VR/MR device is no longer supported. You have received the final update supporting this graphics device, and you will still receive updates on your PC and be able to play without a VR/MR device. From this point on you can keep building in your worlds, and your Marketplace purchases (including Minecoins) will continue to be available on a non-VR/MR graphics devices such as a computer monitor. You will no longer be able to use your VR/MR device with Minecraft as it will no longer be supported in the latest updates.%sClick on the button for more information. We know this is an inconvenience, and deeply appreciate the time you spent with our game, and your support.
translation: Eis Fäegkeet fir dëst VR/MR-Grafikgerät z'ënnerstëtzen ass ofgeschloss. Dëst VR/MR-Gerät gëtt net méi ënnerstëtzt. Du hues déi lescht Aktualiséierung fir dëst Grafikgerät kritt, a kriss weiderhin Aktualiséierungen op dengem PC a kanns ouni VR/MR-Gerät spillen. Vun dësem Zäitpunkt un kanns du weider a dengen Welten bauen, an deng Marketplace-Käf (och Minecoins) bleiwen op net-VR/MR-Grafikgeräter verfügbar wéi zum Beispill engem Computerbildschierm. Du kanns däi VR/MR-Gerät net méi mat Minecraft benotzen, well et an de leschten Aktualiséierungen net méi ënnerstëtzt gëtt.%sKlick op de Knäppchen fir méi Infos. Mir wëssen, dass dëst onbequem ass, a schätzen deng Zäit mat eisem Spill an deng Ënnerstëtzung ganz héich.

source_string: Add Diamond armor, weapon, or tool
Want to get the most out of your equipment? You'll need a Smithing Table.
translation: Wëlls du dat Bescht aus dengem Zeug erausbréngen? Du brauchs en Schmidtsdësch.

source_string: Use it to make all kinds of changes, for example by upgrading Diamond equipment to Netherite, or by making cosmetic changes with Armor Trims.
translation: Benotz en fir alles méigleches z'änneren, zum Beispill andeems s de Diamant-Zeug op Netherite opgradéiers, oder andeems s de kosmetesch Ännerungen mat Rüstungsverziärungen mëchs.

source_string: In order to upgrade your equipment, you'll need a Smithing Template. You can find a large variety throughout the world, which can be used for all kinds of upgrades.
translation: Fir däi Zeug opzegradéieren, brauchs du eng Schmidtschabloun. Du fënns eng grouss Varietéit iwwerall an der Welt, déi fir allméiglech Opgradéierungen benotzt ka ginn.

source_string: Place a Template into the leftmost slot of a Smithing Table to see which items you need for the upgrade.
translation: Setz eng Schabloun an de lénksten Plaz vun engem Schmidtsdësch fir ze gesinn, wéi eng Géigestänn s de fir d'Opgradéierung brauchs.

source_string: For example, to upgrade Diamond equipment to Netherite, you need a Netherite Upgrade Smithing Template, which you can find in Bastion Remnants. Then, place the Diamond equipment in the equipment slot and a Netherite ingot in the ingredient slot, and you're done!
translation: Zum Beispill, fir Diamant-Zeug op Netherite opzegradéieren, brauchs du eng Netherite-Opgradéierungs-Schmidtschabloun, déi s de a Bastionsreschter fanns. Setz duerno d'Diamant-Zeug an d'Zeugplaz an e Netherite-Barren an d'Zutatplaz, an du bass fäerdeg!

source_string: Item properties such as enchantments and armor trims will be retained, but the Smithing Template will be consumed when you upgrade your equipment. Don't worry - you can craft copies of them with your Crafting Table.
translation: Géigestandeegeschaften wéi Verzauberungen a Rüstungsverziärungen bleiwen erhalen, awer d'Schmidtschabloun gëtt verbraucht, wann s de däi Zeug opgradéiers. Keng Suerg - du kanns Kopien dovun mat dengem Bastelldësch craften.

source_string: Get creative and customize the look of your armor with Armor Trims. You'll need an Armor Trim Smithing Template to get started, which you can find throughout the world.
translation: Gëff kreativ a personaliséier de Look vun denger Rüstung mat Rüstungsverziärungen. Du brauchs eng Rüstungsverziärung-Schmidtschabloun fir unzefänken, déi s de iwwerall an der Welt fanns.

source_string: Place a Template into the leftmost slot of a Smithing Table to see which items you need for the upgrade. Then place a piece of armor in the equipment slot and a crystal or ingot in the ingredient slot. Done!
translation: Setz eng Schabloun an de lénksten Plaz vun engem Schmidtsdësch fir ze gesinn, wéi eng Géigestänn s de fir d'Opgradéierung brauchs. Setz duerno e Stéck Rüstung an d'Zeugplaz an e Kristall oder Barren an d'Zutatplaz. Fäerdeg!

source_string: Only certain crystals and ingots can be used for Armor Trims. Try different kinds like Iron, Gold, or Lapis to create unique designs!
translation: Nëmme bestëmmte Kristallen a Barren kënnen fir Rüstungsverziärungen benotzt ginn. Probéier verschidde Zorten wéi Eisen, Gold oder Lapis fir eenzegaarteg Designen z'erstellen!

source_string: In addition to the full Minecraft experience with Creative mode, Multiplayer, and more, you'll earn achievements and a Gamerscore to mark your Minecraft progress and show your Microsoft account friends your accomplishments.
translation: Zousätzlech zur Minecraft-Vollversioun mam Kreativmodus, Multispiller a méi, wäers du Erfolleger an en Gamerscore verdéngen fir däin Minecraft-Fortschrëtt ze markéieren an dengen Microsoft-Kont-Frënn deng Leeschtungen ze weisen.

source_string: The full Minecraft experience lets you enjoy Creative mode, achievements and Multiplayer with your friends across Minecraft devices! Play with friends on console, PC and mobile to create, explore and survive together.
translation: D'Minecraft-Vollversioun léisst dech de Kreativmodus, Erfolleger a Multispiller mat dengen Frënn iwwer Minecraft-Apparater genéissen! Spill mat Frënn op Konsole, PC a Mobil fir zesumme z'erstellen, z'entdecken an z'iwwerliewen.

source_string: As a part of the full Minecraft experience, Servers offer some of the most creative ways to enjoy Minecraft! Play great mini-games, meet the Minecraft community and make new friends.
translation: Als Deel vun der Minecraft-Vollversioun offréieren Serveren e puer vun de kreativsten Weeër fir Minecraft ze genéissen! Spill super Mini-Spiller, treff d'Minecraft-Communautéit a mach nei Frënn.

source_string: The full game allows access to Minecraft Marketplace, our in-game store. Switch up your look with new skins, change your world, or explore incredible new maps from the best community creators!
translation: D'Vollversioun erlaabt Zougang zum Minecraft Marketplace, eise Spillinterne Store. Änner däi Look mat neien Skins, änner deng Welt, oder entdeck onheemlech nei Kaarte vun de beschte Communautéitserstellter!

source_string: A beloved part of the full Minecraft experience: Creative mode! Access the entire inventory - the only limit to what you can build is your imagination! Fly around your world, make your dream home out of anything and everything, or just blow up a mountain with unlimited TNT!
translation: E gär gesinn Deel vun der Minecraft-Vollversioun: de Kreativmodus! Kréich Zougang zum ganzen Inventar - déi eenzeg Grenz fir wat s du bauen kanns ass deng Imaginatioun! Fliech ronderëm deng Welt, mach däin Dram-Doheem aus allem an alles, oder blos e Bierg mat onbegrenztem TNT of!

source_string: Want to make wolves act like bunnies? Turn all the trees into cotton candy? You can alter everything in the full Minecraft experience with add-ons! Plus get access to Multiplayer, Creative mode, achievements and more!
translation: Wëlls du datt Wëllef sech wéi Kanéngercher verhalen? All d'Bëscher a Wattemelodie verwandelen? Du kanns alles an der Minecraft-Vollversioun mat Add-Ons änneren! Plus kréich Zougang zu Multispiller, Kreativmodus, Erfolleger a méi!

source_string: The full Minecraft experience unlocks access to Seeds! Seeds help you discover new biomes - survive on ice plains, ascend extreme hills, or trek across deserts. Start with unique templates or explore random new worlds!
translation: D'Minecraft-Vollversioun schalt Zougang zu Seeds fräi! Seeds hëllefen dir nei Biomen z'entdecken - iwwerlief op Äisplaine, klamm iwwer extreem Bierger, oder duerchqueer Wüsten. Fänk mat eenzegaartege Schablounen un oder entdeck zoufälleg nei Welten!

source_string: You'll also have access to Inspiration Island, a tutorial world and introduction to Creative mode that'll teach you how to be a master builder in no time! You can find more great worlds like this in Minecraft Marketplace.

source_string: Show hints for commonly-used keyboard and mouse controls by pressing "H" on your keyboard.
translation: Weis Hiweiser fir dacks benotzte Tastatur- a Mausbedéngungen, andeem s du "H" op denger Tastatur dréckss.

source_string: You can toggle Auto Jump on or off in the Settings menu under Controls.
translation: Du kanns den Auto Jump an den Astellungen ënner Kontrollen un- oder ausmaachen.

source_string: While in Creative Mode, quickly press jump twice to fly.
translation: Am Creative-Modus dréck séier zweemol op de Sprungknäppchen, fir ze fléien.

source_string: Choose a Default Game Mode when creating a world to specify the type of gameplay you want.
translation: Wiel e Standard-Spillmodus beim Erstelle vun enger Welt aus, fir den Typ vum Gameplay festzeleeën, dee s du wëlls.

source_string: Use the command "/setworldspawn" to have new players begin playing where you are standing.
translation: Benotz de Kommando "/setworldspawn", fir nei Spiller do spillen ze loossen, wou du grad stees.

source_string: Choose a default player permission when creating your world to specify the permissions you want your classmates to have when they join.
translation: Wiel eng Standard-Spillerberechtegung beim Erstelle vun denger Welt aus, fir d'Berechtegunge festzeleeën, déi deng Klassekomeroden hunn sollen, wa se bäitrieden.

source_string: Press "I" on your keyboard or touch the Immersive Reader icon to read or translate in-game text.
translation: Dréck "I" op denger Tastatur oder tapp op d'Immersive-Reader-Symbol, fir Text am Spill ze liesen oder ze iwwersetzen.

source_string: To add or change an NPC in your world, first make yourself a world builder with "/wb".
translation: Fir en NPC an denger Welt bäizefügen oder ze änneren, maach dech als éischt mat "/wb" zu engem Weltbauer.

source_string: There's a brand new build challenge every month! Find them all in the Library under Monthly Build Challenges.
translation: All Mount gëtt et eng brandnei Bauchallenge! Fann se all an der Bibliothéik ënner Monatlechen Baucaravaner.

source_string: Find related lessons by clicking on tags in the Library.
translation: Fann verbonnen Lektiounen, andeem s du op Tags an der Bibliothéik klickst.

source_string: Game moving slowly? Try turning down the render distance in Settings.
translation: Spill lafeg lues? Probéier d'Renderdistanz an den Astellungen erofzesetzen.

source_string: Want to use Code Builder? Make sure cheats are toggled on.
translation: Wëlls du den Code Builder benotzen? Vergewëssert dech, dass Cheats aktivéiert sinn.

source_string: Press F5 to change player perspective.
Use "/spawnpoint" to change your spawn point. It's just like you slept in a bed!
translation: Benotz "/spawnpoint", fir däi Spawnpunkt z'änneren. Et ass grad wéi wann du an engem Bett geschlof hätts!

source_string: Most monsters only come out at night. During the day you're safe... probably.
translation: Déi meescht Monsteren kommen nëmme nuets eraus. Wärend dem Dag bass du sécher... wuel.

source_string: Break blocks, pick up resources. Use the crafting grid to make helpful items. Now you're crafting!
translation: Bréich Bléck, sammel Ressourcen. Benotz d'Handwierksgëtter, fir hëllefräich Géigestänn ze maachen. Elo bass du am Handwierken!

source_string: You have endless lives, but your items drop to the ground when you die. Hurry back to pick them up!
translation: Du hues onendlech Liewen, mä deng Géigestänn falen op de Buedem, wann du stiers. Kom séier zréck, fir se opzehiewen!

source_string: It's a good idea to build a place where you can safely spend the night.
translation: Et ass eng gutt Iddi, en Uert ze bauen, wou du sécher d'Nuecht verbréngen kanns.

source_string: Use the right tool for the job! Chopping wood with an axe is much faster than using your hands.
translation: Benotz dat richteg Tool fir d'Aarbecht! Holz mat enger Axt schneiden ass vill méi séier wéi mat de Hänn.

source_string: Even in Minecraft you'll get hungry, so try to find something to eat before that happens.
translation: Och a Minecraft gëss du hongereg, dofir probéier eppes ze iessen ze fannen, ier dat geschitt.

source_string: Digging straight down or straight up might not be a great idea.
translation: Direkt eropwäerts oder ronderteropwäerts ze graven ass vläicht keng gutt Iddi.

source_string: Monsters spawn in the dark. Craft a torch to brighten up any space.
translation: Monsteren spawnen am Däischteren. Craft eng Fakel, fir all Plaz opzehellen.

source_string: Beds are great! Craft one to quickly pass the night and set your respawn point.
translation: Bett sinn super! Craft ee, fir séier duerch d'Nuecht ze kommen a däi Respawnpunkt festzeleeën.

source_string: Be careful when you swim. Stay under water for too long and you'll run out of air.
translation: Sief virsiichteg beim Schwammen. Bleif net ze laang ënner Waasser, soss geet dir d'Loft aus.

source_string: Survival mode has 4 different difficulty levels - Peaceful, Easy, Normal, and Hard. Or play Creative mode and get endless resources!
translation: De Survival-Modus huet 4 verschidde Schwieregkeetsniveauen - Fridd, Einfach, Normal a Schwéier. Oder spill de Creative-Modus a kritt onendlech Ressourcen!

source_string: The world of Minecraft is endlessly surprising. You'll find lots of different animals, plants, and even §f§k§a§b§r §f§k§a§b§r
translation: D'Welt vu Minecraft ass onendlech iwwerraschend. Du fenns vill verschidde Déieren, Planzen, a souguer §f§k§a§b§r §f§k§a§b§r

source_string: Iron golems will fight for you!
Feed a bone to a wolf to tame it. You can then make it sit or follow you.
translation: Fidder engem Wollef e Been, fir en zoumzamen. Du kanns en dann sëtzen oder dir follegen loossen.

source_string: Wearing a pumpkin on your head will keep Endermen from attacking you.
translation: E Kürbis um Kapp ze droen hält Endermen dovun of, dech ze attackéieren.

source_string: Harvest leather from cows, and use it to make armor and books.
translation: Sammel Ledder vu Kéien, an benotz et fir Rüstung a Bicher ze maachen.

source_string: You can fill an empty bucket with water, lava, milk, powdered snow... and even some mobs.
translation: Du kanns en eidele Kessel mat Waasser, Lava, Mëllech, Puddersnéi... a souguer e puer Kreaturen fëllen.

source_string: Feeding an animal will keep it from despawning. Build a pen to keep your animals safe.
translation: En Déier ze fidderen hält et dovun of ze despawnen. Bau eng Ëmzeinung, fir deng Déieren sécher ze halen.

source_string: Get to your destination faster with a minecart and some rails!
translation: Kom méi séier op deng Destinatioun mat enger Minelor a Schinnen!

source_string: Building a portal will allow you to travel to another dimension called the Nether.
translation: E Portal ze bauen erlaabt dir a eng aner Dimensioun ze reesen, déi den Nether heescht.

source_string: Bonemeal (crafted from a skeleton bone) can be used as a fertilizer and can make things grow instantly!
translation: Knacheschmier (aus engem Skelettbeen gemaach) kann als Dünger benotzt ginn a Saachen direkt wuessen loossen!

source_string: Obsidian is created when water hits a lava source block.
translation: Obsidian entsteet, wann Waasser op e Lava-Quellblock trëfft.

source_string: If the source block for water or lava is removed, it will stop the flow completely.
translation: Wann den Quellblock fir Waasser oder Lava fortgeholl gëtt, stoppt de Floss komplett.

source_string: Blocks that can be used as a light source will melt snow and ice.
translation: Bléck, déi als Liichtquell benotzt ginn, schmëlzen Schnéi an Äis.

source_string: Take caution when building structures made of wool out in the open, as lightning from thunderstorms can set wool on fire.
translation: Sief virsiichteg beim Bauen vu Wollstrukturen am Fräien, well Blëtz vun Donnerwiedder d'Woll a Brand setze kann.

source_string: A single bucket of lava can be used in a furnace to smelt 100 blocks.
translation: Ee Kessel Lava kann an engem Uewen benotzt ginn, fir 100 Bléck ze schmëlzen.

source_string: The instrument played by a note block depends on the material beneath it.
translation: D'Instrument, dat vun engem Notenblock gespillt gëtt, hänkt vum Material dodrënner of.

source_string: Attacking a wolf will cause any wolves nearby to turn hostile and attack you.
translation: E Wollef ze attackéieren mécht all Wëllef an der Géigend feindlech a se attackéieren dech.

source_string: Wolves and iron golems won't attack creepers.
translation: Wëllef an Eisegolemen attackéieren keng Creeper.

source_string: Chickens lay an egg every 5 to 10 minutes.
translation: Hénger leeë all 5 bis 10 Minutten en Ee.

source_string: Obsidian can be mined with a diamond pickaxe.
translation: Obsidian kann mat engem Diamantspëtzhaken ofgebaut ginn.

source_string: Creepers are the easiest obtainable source of gunpowder.
translation: Creeper sinn déi einfachst erreechbar Quell vu Schosspudder.

source_string: Tame wolves show their health with the position of their tail. Feed them meat to heal them.
translation: Zoumgemaachte Wëllef weisen hir Gesondheet duerch d'Positioun vun hirem Schwanz. Fidder si mat Fleesch, fir se ze heelen.

source_string: Different colored dyes can be made from a variety of materials, cook cactus in a furnace to get green dye!
translation: Verschidde faarweg Fuerfstoffer kënne aus verschiddene Materialien gemaach ginn, kach Kaktus an engem Uewen, fir gréngen Fuerfstoff ze kréien!

source_string: Pigs that are struck by lightning become zombified piglins.
translation: Puppelchen, déi vum Blëtz getraff ginn, ginn zombifizéiert Piglin.

source_string: Sometimes iron golems give flowers to the villager children!
translation: Heiansdo ginn Eisegolemen de Villagerkanner Blumme!
Ozelotten weisen de Creeper, wien de Chef ass!

source_string: Use seagrass to attract and breed sea turtles.
translation: Benotz Séigras, fir Séischildkröten unzezéien a ze zeien.

source_string: Protect baby turtles from hostile mobs!
Baby turtles will drop scutes when they grow - these can be crafted into turtle shells.
translation: Puppelchenschildkröten falen Scutes, wa se wuessen - déi kënnen zu Schildkrötepanzer verschafft ginn.

source_string: Brew some water breathing potions for underwater exploration!
translation: Braut e puer Waasseratmungspottiounen fir Ënnerwaassererfuerschung!

source_string: Dolphins can lead you to shipwrecks and underwater ruins, feed them cod and follow their trail!
translation: Delfiner kënnen dech zu Schëffswracken an Ënnerwaasserrouinen féieren, fidder si mat Kabeljau a verfollegen hir Spuer!

source_string: Use shears to carve a pumpkin.
translation: Benotz Scheer, fir e Kürbis ze schneiden.

source_string: There are 3587 types of tropical fish!
translation: Et ginn 3587 Zorte vun tropesche Fëschen!

source_string: Sea pickles can be smelted into lime green dye.
translation: Séigurken kënnen zu limettengréngem Fuerfstoff geschmolt ginn.

source_string: Use hay bales to breed Llamas!
translation: Benotz Hee-Ballen, fir Lamaen ze zeien!

source_string: Compasses always point to the world spawn - craft one to find your way!
translation: Bousselen weisen ëmmer op de Weltspawn - crafft eng, fir däin Wee ze fannen!

source_string: Trade with villagers to obtain food, tools, and even explorer maps!
translation: Handel mat Villagers, fir Iessen, Tools, a souguer Entdeckerkaarten ze kréien!

source_string: Did you know you can hold a map in your off-hand?
translation: Wousst du, dass du eng Kaart an denger Nebenhand droe kanns?

source_string: Leads can be used on boats.
translation: Leschen kënnen op Booter benotzt ginn.

source_string: Sneak to walk safely on magma blocks.
translation: Schleech, fir sécher op Magmabléck ze goen.

source_string: You can gather cobwebs using shears.
translation: Du kanns Spannwiedernetzer mat Scheer sammelen.

source_string: Tridents are dropped by the Drowned, and can be held or thrown.
translation: Dräizäcker falen vum Drowned an kënnen gehal oder geheit ginn.

source_string: You can smelt 20 items in a furnace by using a block of dried kelp as fuel.
translation: Du kanns 20 Géigestänn an engem Uewen schmëlzen, andeem s du e Block aus gedréchentem Kelp als Brennstoff benotz.

source_string: Taming a skeleton horse doesn't require a saddle.
translation: E Skelettpäerd zomzamen erfuerdert kee Sattel.

source_string: Phantoms are dangerous mobs that appear during the night. Make sure to sleep regularly!
translation: Phantomen sinn geféierlech Kreaturen, déi nuets erschéngen. Vergewëssert dech, regelméisseg ze schlofen!

source_string: Zombies turn into drowned if they sink underwater.
translation: Zombien ginn zu Drowned, wa si ënner Waasser sanken.
Renn am Waasser, fir ze schwammen!

source_string: When digging straight up, place a torch at your feet to break any sand or gravel that could potentially fall down on you.
translation: Wann s du direkt eropwäerts gréifs, plazéier eng Fakel bei denger Féiss, fir Sand oder Kies ze briechen, deen op dech falen kéint.

source_string: Shear a Beehive or nest to get Honeycomb, use a Bottle to get honey.
translation: Scheer e Beienhaus oder Nascht, fir Honnegwabe ze kréien, benotz eng Fläsch, fir Hunneg ze kréien.

source_string: Place a campfire under a beehive or nest to harvest honey.
translation: Plazéier e Camping-Feier ënner engem Beienhaus oder Nascht, fir Hunneg ze sammelen.

source_string: Emerald ores are the rarest ores in Minecraft! They can only be found in mountains and meadows.
translation: Emerald-Äerz ass dat rarsten Äerz a Minecraft! Et kann nëmmen a Bierger a Wisen fonnt ginn.

source_string: Need diamonds? They get more common as you go deeper.
translation: Brauchs du Diamanten? Si ginn méi heefeg, wa s du méi déif gees.

source_string: Frogs eat small and blocky mobs.
translation: Fräschen iesse kleng a klotzeg Kreaturen.

source_string: The Allay loves to collect items! If you give it a certain item it will try to collect more of it.
translation: Den Allay sammelt gär Géigestänn! Wa s du him e bestëmmten Géigestand gëss, probéiert en méi dovun ze sammelen.

source_string: Frogs pick a variant based on the temperature of the biome the tadpole grow up in.
translation: Fräschen wielen eng Variant baséiert op der Temperatur vum Biome, an deem de Kaulqualp opwiisst.

source_string: You can collect tadpoles in buckets.
translation: Du kanns Kaulqualp a Kessele sammelen.

source_string: Ancient cities can be found under mountain ranges.
translation: Antike Stied kënnen ënner Biergketten fonnt ginn.

source_string: Allays love music and therefore interact with noteblocks!
translation: Allays gefällt Musek, dofir interagéiere se mat Notenbléck!

source_string: Use a water bottle on a dirt block to get mud!
translation: Benotz eng Waasserfläsch op engem Äerdblock, fir Schlamm ze kréien!

source_string: When wandering in the deep dark, silence is key.
translation: Beim Wandelen an der Deep Dark ass Rou de Schlëssel.

source_string: Some animals will follow you if you have wheat in your hand.
translation: E puer Déieren follegen dir, wa s du Weess an der Hand hues.

source_string: Before you mine diamonds, redstone, or gold, make sure you're using an iron or diamond pickaxe or it won't work.
translation: Ier s du Diamanten, Redstone oder Gold ofbaus, vergewëssert dech, dass s du en Eisen- oder Diamantspëtzhaken benotz, soss funktionéiert et net.

source_string: Placing two chests side by side will make one large chest.
translation: Zwee Këschte niewenteneen ze plazéieren mécht eng grouss Këscht.

source_string: Can't find any coal for your torches? Try putting some logs in a furnace.
translation: Fenns du keng Kuel fir deng Fakelen? Probéier e puer Stämm an engem Uewen ze plazéieren.

source_string: Plant some saplings and they'll grow into trees.
translation: Planz e puer Setzlingen, an si wuessen zu Beem.

source_string: Use a hoe to prepare areas of ground for planting.
translation: Benotz eng Hak, fir Flächen fir d'Planzen vir ze preparéieren.

source_string: Zombified piglins won't attack you - unless you make them angry.
translation: Zombifizéiert Piglinen attackéieren dech net - ausser du méchs si rosen.

source_string: Hit those fireballs back at the Ghast!
translation: Schleeg déi Feierbälle géint den Ghast zréck!

source_string: Cobblestone is resistant to Ghast fireballs, making it useful for guarding portals.
translation: Kuelblock ass resistent géint Feierbäll vum Ghast, dofir nëtzlech fir Portalen ze bewaachen.

source_string: Our music is by C418, Lena Raine, Aaron Cherof, and Kumi Tanioka.
translation: Eis Musek ass vu C418, Lena Raine, Aaron Cherof a Kumi Tanioka.

source_string: There will be an update to this game eventually!
translation: Et wäert schlussendlech en Update fir dëst Spill kommen!

source_string: Creepers were born from a coding bug.
translation: Creeper si vun engem Coding-Bug entstan.

source_string: The first version of Minecraft was created in just 6 days!
translation: D'éischt Versioun vu Minecraft gouf a just 6 Deeg erstallt!

source_string: The Enderman language is actually English in reverse.
The original name for Minecraft was Cave Game.
translation: Den ursprénglechen Numm fir Minecraft war Cave Game.

source_string: A Spider Jockey is the rare appearance of a spider being ridden by a skeleton!
translation: E Spider Jockey ass déi seelen Erscheinung vun enger Spann, déi vun engem Skelett gereit gëtt!

source_string: Traveling one block in the Nether is equal to traveling eight blocks in the Overworld.
translation: Ee Block am Nether ze reesen entsprécht aacht Bléck an der Overworld.

source_string: Use phantom membranes to repair your elytra.
translation: Benotz Phantommembranen, fir deng Elytra ze reparéieren.

source_string: Elytra can be used to glide, find them in End city ships!
translation: Elytra kënnen zum Fléien benotzt ginn, fann si an End-Stad-Schëffer!

source_string: Test out some new features by turning on Experimental Gameplay in the settings menu!
translation: Probéier e puer nei Funktiounen aus, andeem s du Experimental Gameplay an den Astellungen unschaltst!

source_string: Monsters that are killed by skeletons arrows have a chance of dropping music discs.
translation: Monsteren, déi vu Skelettpiller ëmbruecht ginn, hunn eng Chance, Museksdisketten falen ze loossen.

source_string: Texture packs change the way that blocks, items, and even the menus look in game. Try them out!
translation: Texturpäck änneren, wéi Bléck, Géigestänn a souguer d'Menüen am Spill ausgesinn. Probéier si aus!

source_string: Using firework rockets boosts elytra speed in mid air. Just... make sure they don't explode, otherwise it'll hurt BADLY!
translation: D'Benotzen vu Feierwierksraketten erhëcht d'Elytra-Vitess an der Loft. Just... vergewëssert dech, dass si net explodéieren, soss deet et RIICHTEG wéi!

source_string: Riptide enchantment will propel you through the air in the rain.
translation: D'Riptide-Verzauberung propuls dech duerch d'Loft am Reen.

source_string: The Beacon is a powerful item that can only be crafted with a Nether star from the Wither!
translation: D'Beacon ass e mächtege Géigestand, deen nëmmen mat engem Nether-Stär vum Wither gecraft ka ginn!

source_string: Nether stars can't be destroyed by explosions.
translation: Nether-Stären kënnen net duerch Explosiounen zerstéiert ginn.

source_string: Respawning in the Nether requires a charged respawn anchor.
translation: Am Nether ze respawnen erfuerdert en opgeluede Respawn-Anker.

source_string: You can charge a respawn anchor with glowstone.
translation: Du kanns en Respawn-Anker mat Liichtsteen opluede.

source_string: You can breed hoglins with crimson fungus, but be careful.
translation: Du kanns Hoglinen mat rosarotem Pilz zeien, mä sief virsiichteg.

source_string: Gold is most common in the Nether and in the badlands biome.
translation: Gold ass am heefegsten am Nether an am Badlands-Biome.

source_string: Diorite, you either love it or hate it.
translation: Diorit, entweeder du gefällt en oder du hasse en.

source_string: Take a screenshot using the Game menu.
A Realm is always online, so you and your friends can play here whenever you want.
translation: E Realm ass ëmmer online, esou kënnt du an deng Frënn heihinner spillen, wann dir wëllt.

source_string: Keep up to date with what's going on in your Realm by checking the Story Feed in Realms Stories.
translation: Bleif iwwer wat an dengem Realm geschitt op dem Rande, andeem s du de Story Feed a Realms Stories kontrolléiers.

source_string: Share your great moments with the other players on this Realm by adding a story to the Story Feed.
translation: Deel deng gutt Momenter mat den anere Spiller op dësem Realm, andeem s du eng Story zum Story Feed derbäisetz.

source_string: Check the Timeline in Realms Stories to find out when others are playing.
translation: Kontrolléier d'Timeline a Realms Stories, fir erauszefannen, wann anerer spillen.

source_string: Access Realms Stories from the game menu while playing on the Realm.
translation: Zougrëff op Realms Stories vum Spill-Menü, wärend s du op dem Realm spills.

source_string: Get to know your Realm's community on the Members tab in Realms Stories.
translation: Léier deng Realm-Communautéit op dem Members-Tab a Realms Stories kennen.

source_string: Use Realms Stories to get social, keep up with your friends' progress, and organize playtime.
translation: Benotz Realms Stories, fir sozial ze sinn, mat de Fortschrëtter vun dengen Frënn Schrëtt ze halen, a d'Spillzäit ze organiséieren.

source_string: Bored of gravity? Jump twice to fly!
translation: Genuch vun der Schwéierkraaft? Sprang zweemol fir ze fléien!
context: A fun way to tell players that they can fly if they press the jump button twice.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Summon mobs in an instant with spawn eggs.
context: Players can use an item called Sawn Egg to summon animals and monsters.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Collect goat horns and fill the world with music.
translation: Sammel Geesshäre a fëll d'Welt mat Musek.
context: Goat horn is an object players can use to play loud sounds.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Combine flint and steel with a TNT block for explosive results.
translation: Kombinéier Steen a Feier mat engem TNT-Block fir explosiv Resultater.
context: Flint and steel is a tool used to create fire or to ignite certain blocks, structures and mobs. TNT will explode when you light it.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Try blinking around the map with an ender pearl. Don't get dizzy!
translation: Probéier ronderteropp op der Kaart mat enger Enderperl ze blénken. Gëff net schwëndeleg!
context: An ender pearl is an item that can be thrown and teleports the thrower to where it lands.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Use rails and a minecart to build the perfect transport system. Or rollercoaster!
translation: Benotz Schinnen an eng Minelor, fir dat perfekt Transportsystem ze bauen. Oder eng Achterbunn!
context: To  encourage players to build railroads{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Seeking a little more danger? Survival mode has plenty.
translation: Sichs du e bësse méi Gefor? De Survival-Modus huet vill.
context: In the Game mode Survival mode you can die. In Creative you can’t.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Crossbows need ammo. Add some arrows to your inventory before going hunting.
translation: Aarmbrëschte brauchen Munitioun. Setz e puer Pillen an däin Inventar ier s du op d'Juegd gees.
context: Crossbows need ammo. Add some arrows to your inventory before going hunting.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: You can't die, but villagers can. Use that information... wisely.
translation: Du kanns net stierwen, mä Villagers kënnen. Benotz déi Info... virsiichteg.
context: This means you can do things that will get villagers killed. Like attracting monsters to the village.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Villagers are great at building villages. Think you can do better?
translation: Villagers sinn super am Bauen vun Dierfer. Mengs du, du kanns et besser?
context: This is a prompt to encourage players to build things.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Wolves will attack skeletons to chew on their tasty bones.
translation: Wëllef attackéieren Skeletter, fir op hire lecken Bénger ze knäppen.
context: Wolves will attack skeletons. It’s also a discrete hint that you should feel wolves with bones to tame them.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Tame wild horses by sitting on them until they're calm, then saddle up and ride off. (Note: Horses do not work like that outside of Minecraft.)
translation: Zoumzamen wëll Päerd, andeem s du dropsëtz, bis si roueg sinn, dann setz de Sattel drop a ritt fort. (Notiz: Päerd funktionéieren esou net baussent Minecraft.)
context: It’s a bit unintuitive how you tame horses. Most other animals are tamed by feeding them. Not Horses. {MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Eat as much as you want, you'll never get full! And you'll never starve.
translation: Ess esou vill de wëlls, du gëss ni voll! An du wäers ni hongereg.
context: In Creative Mode you don’t get hungry. Eating the food it just for fun.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Move through solid objects using spectator mode.
translation: Beweeg dech duerch feste Géigestänn mam Spectator-Modus.
context: There is a Game mode called Spectator Mode. It allows you to fly through walls and blocks and everything.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Who needs tools? Punch your way to success and remove blocks instantly in creative mode.
translation: Wien brauch Tools? Schléich dech zum Erfolleg an entfär direkt Bléck am Creative-Modus.
context: Block breaking happens very fast when you’re in Creative Mode.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Like what you see? Use the pick block button to start building with whatever you're looking at. Yes, even mobs!
translation: Gefällt dir wat de gesäis? Benotz de Block-Auswiel-Knäppchen, fir mat wat s du grad ukucks ze bauen. Jo, souguer Kreaturen!

source_string: Get there now with the /tp command.
context: You can teleport yourself in Creative. You use the /tp command in the chat.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Mobs won't notice you in creative mode, but they'll still notice each other…
translation:
Kreaturen bemierken dech net am Creative-Modus, mä si bemierken sech nach ëmmer géigesäiteg
…
context: Mobs(animals & monsters) won’t notice you in creative mode, but they’ll still notice each other… meaning that they can still kill each other.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: A warden a day keeps the… well, everything away.
translation:
E Warden den Dag hält
… nun, alles fort.
context: The Warden is a scary monster that live in underground cities.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Why not build an underwater base? It's not like you can drown.
translation: Firwat net eng Ënnerwaasserbasis bauen? Et ass jo net wéi wann s du kéints erdrenken.
context: You can’t drown in creative mode. So it’s possible to build underwater without danger.{MaxLength="200"}

context: Players have endless resources in Creative mode. They get all the building blocks from their inventory.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Phantoms can't hurt you, but you can still shoo them off by using a bed. Just...not literally. You sleep in it.

context: Phantoms are flying mobs(monsters) that spawn when you havn't slept for a few days. They won't hurt you in Creative Mode. To get rid of them you sleep in a bed.{MaxLength="200"}

source_string: Have you tried swimming in lava? It's like sinking into a warm bath. Just don't try it in survival mode...

context: Lava doesn't hurt you in creative mode.{MaxLength="200"}

Am Géigesaz zu engem grousse ëffentlechen Minecraft-Server sinn Realms nëmmen op Invitatioun, sou dass s du kontrolléiers wien eran kënnt.

translation: Super! source_string: The hotbar sets the block for Fill operations, brushes, and more.[*newLine]Switch slots with 1-9 keys or the mouse.[*newLine]To change the block, reselect the active slot.
translation: D'Schnellzougrëffer setzt de Block fir Fëllungsoperatiounen, Pinselen a méi.[*newLine]Wiessel Plazen mat den Tasten 1-9 oder mat der Maus.[*newLine]Fir de Block z'änneren, wiel déi aktiv Plaz nach eng Kéier aus.

source_string: Movement[*%s]Use the mouse while holding Right Click to move the camera around the world.[*%s]Use %s, %s, %s, and %s to move forward, backward, left and right.[*%s]Use %s and %s to move up and down.[*%s]Use Middle Mouse scroll to zoom.[*%s]Use the mouse while holding Middle Mouse Button to pan the camera.

source_string: Movement[*%s]Use the mouse while holding Right Click to move the camera around the world.[*%s]Use %s, %s, %s, and %s to move forward, backward, left and right.[*%s]Use %s and %s to move up and down.

source_string: Let’s explore the Selection tool.[*newLine]Activate the Selection tool by clicking %1$s on the toolrail or pressing %2$s.
translation: Elo entdecke mir de Auswielwierkzeug.[*newLine]Aktivéier den Auswielwierkzeug andeem s du %1$s um Toolreider klicks oder %2$s dréckst.

source_string: Left-click to set the selection start, then drag to adjust its size.
translation: Lénks-Klick fir d'Ufankspunkt vun der Auswiel z'setzen, da zéien fir d'Gréisst unzepassen.

source_string: Click the Fill button on the Action Bar or press %s to fill the selection with blocks.
translation: Klick op de Fëllknäppchen op der Aktiounsbar oder dréck %s fir d'Auswiel mat Bléck ze fëllen.

source_string: The Selection tool lets you move, copy, and build with precision.
translation: Den Auswielwierkzeug erlaabt dir mat Präzisioun ze beweegen, ze kopéieren an ze bauen.

source_string: Welcome to Minecraft Editor, a powerful tool for creating stunning Bedrock worlds with ease.[*newLine]Things work differently in Editor and it's important that you understand a few basics first or you might get lost.[*newLine]Let's dive into the basics.
translation: Wëllkomm bei Minecraft Editor, engem mächtege Wierkzeug fir bemierkenswäerte Bedrock-Welten mat Liichtegkeet z'erschafen.[*newLine]Saachen fonktionéieren am Editor anescht a et ass wichteg dass s du fir d'éischt e puer Basics verstees, soss kéints du dech verléieren.[*newLine]Loosst eis an d'Basics androen.

source_string: Set the font size for text in the Editor.
translation: Setz d'Schrëftgréisst fir Text am Editor.

source_string: Set the theme for the UI in Editor.
translation: Setz d'Thema fir d'UI am Editor.

source_string: Set the size of the UI elements.
We are so excited you're here and about to build with Minecraft's Bedrock Editor, where we want to empower Creators of all skillsets to easily create high-quality experiences.
translation: Mir si sou frou dass s du hei bass a mat Minecraft's Bedrock Editor bauen wëlls, wou mir Kreateuren vun allen Erfarunge wëllen ermächtegen liicht qualitativ héichwäerteg Erfarunge z'erschafen.

source_string: - There are two modes within the Editor: Tool or Crosshair. Tool is focused on using the multi-block editing tools as available via the UI and free-moving cursor, and Crosshair is for more precise, single-block edits using a crosshair in 1st person.
translation: - Et gëtt zwee Modi am Editor: Tool oder Fadekräiz. Tool ass fokusséiert op d'Benotzen vun de Multi-Block-Bearbechtungswierkzeuger déi iwwer d'UI a fräi beweegleche Cursor verfügbar sinn, an Fadekräiz ass fir méi präzis, Eenzelblock-Ännerungen mat engem Fadekräiz an der 1. Persoun.

source_string: - UI orientation: The left array of tools is referred to as the "toolrail", the top array is the "action bar" (eg. undo/redo), and the very top is the "menu" (eg. File).
translation: - UI-Orientéierung: D'lénks Rei vun Tools gëtt de "Toolrail" genannt, déi uewescht Rei ass d'"Aktiounsbar" (zum Beispill Réckgängeg/Widderhuelen), a ganz uewen ass de "Menü" (zum Beispill Datei).

source_string: - For most UI actions and tools, there is a corresponding hotkey and sometimes a slash cmd.
translation: - Fir déi meescht UI-Aktiounen a Tools gëtt et eng entspriechend Hotkey a heiansdo e Slash-Kommando.

source_string: - Rotate camera / unlock movement: In Tool, hold down right mouse button. In Crosshair, you do not need to hold down the right mouse button.
translation: - Kamera dréinen / Beweegung fräischalten: Am Tool, hal de rietsen Maustast gedréckt. Am Fadekräiz musst du de rietsen Maustast net halen.

source_string: - Move on the XZ axis: WASD
- Move on the Y axis: E (up), Q (down)
translation: - Op der Y-Achs beweegen: E (op), Q (of)

source_string: - Toggle between Tool and Crosshair Modes: (CTRL+TAB) or the UI button at the bottom of the viewport. When in Crosshair, you will need to use the hotkeys, though -- (CTRL+TAB) or ESC.
translation: - Wiessel tëscht Tool- a Fadekräiz-Modi: (CTRL+TAB) oder de UI-Knäppchen um Buedem vum Viewport. Am Fadekräiz musst du awer d'Hotkeys benotzen -- (CTRL+TAB) oder ESC.

source_string: View the detailed directory of controls:
translation: Kuck den detailléierten Verzeechnes vun de Kontrollen:

source_string: Actions are shortcuts that live at the top of your screen. Hit the “+” button in the Action Bar to customize which are displayed.
translation: Aktiounen sinn Ofkierzungen déi um Rand vun dengem Écran leien. Klick de "+"-Knäppchen an der Aktiounsbar fir auszewielen wéi eng ugewisen ginn.

source_string: At the top center of your screen is the Hotbar. Click once to change the active block, click twice to open the Block Picker to customize the Hotbar.
translation: Um mëttleren uewenen Rand vun dengem Écran ass de Schnellzougrëffer. Klick eemol fir de aktiven Block z'änneren, klick zweemol fir de Block-Auswieler opzemaachen fir de Schnellzougrëffer ze personaliséieren.

source_string: You can create a new Hotbar by clicking the Hotbar Menu button to the right.
translation: Du kanns en neien Schnellzougrëffer erstellen andeem s du de Schnellzougrëffer-Menü-Knäppchen riets klicks.

source_string: To navigate in the Editor, you’ll need a keyboard and mouse. Trackpads or controllers aren’t recommended.
translation: Fir am Editor ze navigéieren, brauchs du eng Tastatur an eng Maus. Trackpads oder Controller ginn net recommandéiert.
Fir dech am Editor ze beweegen:

source_string: Hold down the right mouse button to look around.
translation: Hal de rietsen Maustast gedréckt fir ronderëm ze kucken.

source_string: Use WASD to move horizontally and Q & E to move vertically.
translation: Benotz WASD fir horizontal ze beweegen a Q & E fir vertikal ze beweegen.

source_string: You can find tools on the left rail. Each tool allows you to edit your world in different ways.
translation: Du fënns Tools um lénksen Reider. Jidder Tool erlaabt dir deng Welt op verschiddene Weeër z'änneren.

source_string: Click on the Information button ("i") at the top right corner of each tool to learn more about how it works.
translation: Klick op den Info-Knäppchen ("i") an der Iewescht-Riets-Eck vun all Tool fir méi doriwwer z'erfueren wéi et fonktionéiert.

source_string: Welcome to the Minecraft Editor, a tool designed to help you create stunning worlds in Bedrock with ease.
translation: Wëllkomm bei Minecraft Editor, engem Wierkzeug entworf fir dir ze hëllefen bemierkenswäerte Welten am Bedrock mat Liichtegkeet z'erschafen.

translation: Dës Linken kéinten dir op dénger Rees hëllefräich sinn:

translation: Fir de Schnellstart nei opzemaachen, fëns du en ënnert dem 'Hëllef'-Menü.

translation: Navigéier lénks a riets fir méi Säiten

source_string: Move to the right of this field for additional actions.
translation: Riets vun dësem Feld goen fir zousätzlech Aktiounen.

source_string: This will invalidate the old link and create a new one. Do you wish to continue?

source_string: Want added security for your coins and packs? Sign in to Xbox Live to save your Minecoins, Skins, Texture Packs, Worlds, and Mash-ups. They will be there for you on any device where you play Minecraft.
translation: Wëlls du méi Sécherheet fir deng Coins a Päck? Mell dech mat Xbox Live un fir deng Minecoins, Skins, Texturpäck, Welten a Mash-ups z'späicheren. Si sinn dann op all Gerät disponibel wou s du Minecraft spills.

source_string: Purchases left on your device may be lost if you lose your device or uninstall Minecraft.
translation: Käf déi op dengem Gerät verbleiwen kéinten verluer goen wann s du däin Gerät verléiers oder Minecraft desinstalléiers.

source_string: Transferring purchases to Xbox Live account...
translation: Käf ginn op Xbox Live-Konto transferéiert...

source_string: In addition, you will be able to access them on any device you use to play Minecraft!
translation: Zousätzlech kanns du drop op all Gerät zougräifen, mat deem s du Minecraft spills!

source_string: Content purchased through a partner store will be available as long as your device is signed in to your partner store account.
translation: Inhalt dee bei engem Partnergeschäft kaaft gouf ass verfügbar sou laang wéi däi Gerät bei dengem Partnergeschäft-Konto ugemellt ass.

source_string: This Xbox Live account will not be the primary account for this device if you do not transfer this device's purchases to this account. You will not automatically sign in when you start Minecraft.
translation: Dëst Xbox Live-Konto gëtt net den Haaptkonto fir dëst Gerät wann s du d'Käf vun dësem Gerät net op dëse Konto transferéiers. Du wäerts net automatesch ugemellt ginn wann s du Minecraft startst.

source_string: You can also wear a Pumpkin on your head. This won't give you any :armor: but will make it so Endermen won't get mad when you look at them.
translation: Du kanns och e Kürbis op dengem Kapp droen. Dëst gëtt dir keng :armor: awer mécht et sou dass Endermen net wéiten wann s du si ukuchs.

source_string: Minecraft is a game about placing blocks to build anything you can imagine. At night monsters come out, so make sure to build a shelter before that happens.
translation: Minecraft ass e Spill wou een Bléck placéiert fir alles ze bauen wat s du dir virstelle kanns. Nuets kommen Monster eraus, also stell sécher e Schutz ze bauen ier dat geschitt.

source_string: Use the mouse to look around.
translation: Benotz d'Maus fir ronderëm ze kucken.

source_string: Touch and drag along the screen to look around.
translation: Rühr un a zéi laanscht den Écran fir ronderëm ze kucken.

source_string: Press :_input_key.forward: twice in rapid succession or press :_input_key.sprint: to sprint. While you hold :_input_key.forward:, you will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.
translation: Dréck :_input_key.forward: zweemol séier hannerteneen oder dréck :_input_key.sprint: fir ze spurten. Während s du :_input_key.forward: häls, sprints du weider bis s du manner wéi :shank::shank::shank: hues.

source_string: Push :_gamepad_stick_left: forward twice in rapid succession to sprint. While you hold :_gamepad_stick_left: forward, you will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.
translation: Zéi :_gamepad_stick_left: zweemol séier no vir hannerteneen fir ze spurten. Während s du :_gamepad_stick_left: no vir häls, sprints du weider bis s du manner wéi :shank::shank::shank: hues.

source_string: Press :touch_forward: twice in rapid succession to sprint. While you hold :touch_forward:, you will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.

source_string: Push :rift_left_stick: forward twice in rapid succession to sprint. While you hold :rift_left_stick: forward, you will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.
translation: Zéi :rift_left_stick: zweemol séier no vir hannerteneen fir ze spurten. Während s du :rift_left_stick: no vir häls, sprints du weider bis s du manner wéi :shank::shank::shank: hues.

source_string: Push :windowsmr_left_stick: forward twice in rapid succession to sprint. While you hold :windowsmr_left_stick: forward, you will continue to sprint until you have less than :shank::shank::shank:.
translation: Zéi :windowsmr_left_stick: zweemol séier no vir hannerteneen fir ze spurten. Während s du :windowsmr_left_stick: no vir häls, sprints du weider bis s du manner wéi :shank::shank::shank: hues.

source_string: Hold :_input_key.attack: to mine and chop using your hand or whatever you are holding. You may need to craft a tool to mine some blocks.
translation: Hal :_input_key.attack: fir mat dénger Hand oder wat s du haltst ze grouwen a hauen. Du kéints e Tool brauche fir e puer Bléck ofzebauen.

source_string: Touch and hold the screen on a block to mine and chop using your hand or whatever you are holding. You may need to craft a tool to mine some blocks.
translation: Rühr un a hal den Écran op engem Block fir mat dénger Hand oder wat s du haltst ze grouwen a hauen. Du kéints e Tool brauche fir e puer Bléck ofzebauen.

source_string: Sneaking is incredibly useful in Minecraft, sneaking keeps you from falling off of a block and hides your nametag. To sneak, hold :_input_key.sneak:.
translation: Schläiche ass immens hëllefräich a Minecraft, et verhënnert dass s du vun engem Block fällst a verstoppt däin Numm-Schëld. Fir ze schläichen, hal :_input_key.sneak:.
