source_string: Arrange items from your Inventory or Hotbar in the crafting grid in the shape of an item recipe.
translation: Arrangéier Géigestänn aus dengem Inventar oder Schnellzougrëffer am Handwierksgitter an der Form vun engem Rezept.

source_string: If the recipe is correct the item you are attempting to craft will appear in the Output Slot to the right of the Crafting Grid. Take it from the Output Slot and put it in your Inventory. You can now use the item.
translation: Wann de Rezept richteg ass, erschéngt den Géigestand deen s du hierstelle wëlls am Ausgabslot riets vum Handwierksgitter. Huel en aus dem Ausgabslot a setz en an däin Inventar. Du kanns den Géigestand elo benotzen.

source_string: There are many recipes and for some you will need a larger Crafting Grid than the 2x2 grid that you start with.
translation: Et gëtt vill Rezepter a fir e puer brauchs du e méi groussen Handwierksgitter wéi den 2x2-Gitter mat deem s du unfänks.

source_string: Craft 4 Wooden Planks into a Crafting Table and place it in the world.
translation: Stell 4 Holzplanken zu enger Wierkbänk hier a placéier si an der Welt.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Dréck :_input_key.use: op enger Wierkbänk an der Welt fir Zougang zu engem 3x3-Handwierksgitter ze kréien.

source_string: Press :_input_key.use: on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Dréck :_input_key.use: op enger Wierkbänk an der Welt fir Zougang zu engem 3x3-Handwierksgitter ze kréien.

source_string: Press :rift_right_grab: on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Dréck :rift_right_grab: op enger Wierkbänk an der Welt fir Zougang zu engem 3x3-Handwierksgitter ze kréien.

source_string: Press :windowsmr_left_trigger: on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Dréck :windowsmr_left_trigger: op enger Wierkbänk an der Welt fir Zougang zu engem 3x3-Handwierksgitter ze kréien.

source_string: Tap on a Crafting Table in the world to gain access to a 3x3 Crafting Grid.
translation: Tipp op eng Wierkbänk an der Welt fir Zougang zu engem 3x3-Handwierksgitter ze kréien.

source_string: On the left side of the screen you will see the Recipe Book, which is good if you don't know a recipe or want to quickly craft a recipe that you already know. You will also see the Crafting grid on the right side of the screen above your Inventory.
translation: Op der lénkser Säit vum Écran gesäis du den Rezeptbuch, deen gutt ass wann s du en Rezept net kenns oder séier en Rezept hierstelle wëlls dee s du schonn kenns. Du gesäis och den Handwierksgitter op der rietser Säit vum Écran iwwer dengem Inventar.

source_string: Once you have found the recipe you want to craft, :_input_key.attack: the recipe to load it into the crafting grid, then take it from the Output Slot to the right of the Crafting Grid and put it in your Inventory. :_input_key.use: the recipe to auto-craft, this automatically crafts one set and puts it in your inventory. SHIFT + :_input_key.use: the recipe to auto-craft a whole stack.
translation: Wann s du den Rezept fonnt hues, dee s du hierstelle wëlls, :_input_key.attack: den Rezept fir en an den Handwierksgitter ze lueden, huel en dann aus dem Ausgabslot riets vum Handwierksgitter a setz en an däin Inventar. :_input_key.use: den Rezept fir automatesch hierzestellen, dëst stellt automatesch ee Set hier a setzt en an däin Inventar. SHIFT + :_input_key.use: den Rezept fir e ganzen Stack automatesch hierzestellen.

source_string: Once you have found the recipe you want to craft, press :_gamepad_face_button_down: on the recipe to auto-craft, this automatically crafts one set and puts it in your inventory. Press :_gamepad_face_button_up: on the recipe to auto-craft a whole stack.
translation: Wann s du den Rezept fonnt hues, dee s du hierstelle wëlls, dréck :_gamepad_face_button_down: op den Rezept fir automatesch hierzestellen, dëst stellt automatesch ee Set hier a setzt en an däin Inventar. Dréck :_gamepad_face_button_up: op den Rezept fir e ganzen Stack automatesch hierzestellen.

source_string: Once you have found the recipe you want to craft, tap the recipe to load it into the crafting grid, then tap the item in the output slot to craft it. Press and hold the item in the output slot to craft continuously.
translation: Wann s du den Rezept fonnt hues, dee s du hierstelle wëlls, tipp den Rezept fir en an den Handwierksgitter ze lueden, tipp dann den Géigestand am Ausgabslot fir en hierzestellen. Dréck a hal den Géigestand am Ausgabslot fir kontinuéierlech hierzestellen.

source_string: When the :craftable_toggle_on: is on, the Recipe Book shows all of the recipes that you have ingredients for. When the :craftable_toggle_off: is off, the Recipe Book shows every recipe in the game, even if you can't craft it. Check the tabs or search if you are looking for something specific. In Creative Mode some recipes will be collapsed inside lists. Opening the list will expand it and show you all of the recipes inside.
translation: Wann de :craftable_toggle_on: un ass, weist den Rezeptbuch all d'Rezepter fir déi s du d'Zutaten hues. Wann de :craftable_toggle_off: aus ass, weist den Rezeptbuch all Rezept am Spill, och wann s du en net hierstelle kanns. Kuck d'Reider oder sich wann s du no eppes Bestëmmtem sichs. Am Kreativmodus si e puer Rezepter an Lëschten zesummegeklappt. D'Opmaachen vun der Lëscht kloppt si op a weist dir all d'Rezepter dodran.

source_string: To fly when in Creative Mode, Tap :_input_key.jump: twice quickly. To exit flying, repeat the action. To fly faster, tap :_input_key.forward: twice in rapid succession while flying. When in flying mode, you can press :touch_fly_up: to move up and :touch_fly_down: to move down.
translation: Fir am Kreativmodus ze fléien, tipp :_input_key.jump: zweemol séier. Fir d'Fléien z'ophalen, widderhuel d'Aktioun. Fir méi séier ze fléien, tipp :_input_key.forward: zweemol séier hannerteneen während s du flitts. Am Fluchmodus kanns du :touch_fly_up: dréckem fir opzegoen a :touch_fly_down: fir oofzegoen.

source_string: How to Play : Eye Of Ender
translation: Wéi spillt een : Eye of Ender

source_string: - Old worlds limited in size and height.
translation: - Al Welten begrenzt an Gréisst an Héicht.

source_string: -Mob Loot: Controls whether mobs will drop loot when they die.
translation: -Mob-Beute: Kontrolléiert ob Mobs Beute falen loossen wann si stierwen.

source_string: -Mob Griefing: Prevents mobs from destroying the world.
-Tile Drops: When this setting is turned on, blocks will drop themselves when they break.
translation: -Block-Falen: Wann dës Astellung ugemaach ass, falen Bléck sech selwer wann si ofgebaut ginn.

source_string: -Entities Drop Loot: Controls whether things like minecarts and armor stands will drop themselves when they are broken.
translation: -Entitéiten-Beutefall: Kontrolléiert ob Saachen wéi Minewagen a Rüstungsstänner sech selwer falen loossen wann si zerbrach ginn.

source_string: -Weather Cycle: The weather will not change when this setting is turned off.
translation: -Wiedersyklus: D'Wieder ännert sech net wann dës Astellung ausgemaach ass.

source_string: How to Play : Host and Player Options
translation: Wéi spillt een : Host- a Spilleroptiounen

source_string: The HUD shows information about your status, your health, your remaining oxygen (when you are underwater), your hunger level, and your armor (if you are wearing any).
translation: D'HUD weist Informatioun iwwer däi Status, deng Gesondheet, däi verbleiwende Sauerstoff (wann s du ënner Waasser bass), däi Honger-Level, an deng Rüstung (wann s du eng un hues).

source_string: If you lose some health but have at least nine :shank:, your health will replenish. Eating food will replenish your :shank:.
translation: Wann s du e bësse Gesondheet verléiers, awer nach mindestens néng :shank: hues, füllt sech deng Gesondheet nees op. D'Iessen vu Iessen füllt deng :shank: nees op.

source_string: Press and hold :_input_key.use: while holding a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Dréck a hal :_input_key.use: während s du en Stéck Iessen hals fir et z'iessen.

source_string: Press and hold :_input_key.use: while holding a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Dréck a hal :_input_key.use: während s du en Stéck Iessen hals fir et z'iessen.

source_string: Press and hold :rift_right_grab: while holding a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Dréck a hal :rift_right_grab: während s du en Stéck Iessen hals fir et z'iessen.

source_string: Press and hold :windowsmr_left_trigger: while holding a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Dréck a hal :windowsmr_left_trigger: während s du en Stéck Iessen hals fir et z'iessen.

source_string: Press and hold a piece of food to eat it.
translation: Dréck a hal en Stéck Iessen fir et z'iessen.

source_string: You must watch your hunger level while adventuring, your hunger level is represented on your HUD with :shank:. The hunger level decreases as you explore. Certain activities will decrease hunger level at a faster rate, such as sprinting. You can replenish your hunger level by eating food. Some foods are more nourishing than others and will fill up more :shank:. When you get your hunger level up to maximum, the last food you ate applies a saturation value. Saturation is a hidden number that gives you an extra bonus to your hunger level.
translation: Du muss däin Honger-Level am A halen während s du ënnerwee bass, däi Honger-Level ass op dénger HUD mat :shank: dogestallt. Den Honger-Level fällt während s du entdecks. Bestëmmte Aktivitéiten reduzéieren den Honger-Level méi séier, wéi z.B. Spurten. Du kanns däin Honger-Level widderopfëllen andeem s du Iessen ësst. E puer Iesswueren sinn nährstoffräicher wéi anerer a füllen méi :shank: op. Wann s du däin Honger-Level bis op de Maximum bréngs, applizéiert dat lescht Iessen deen s du giess hues e Saturatiounswäert. Saturatioun ass eng verstoppten Zuel déi dir en extra Bonus op däin Honger-Level gëtt.

source_string: The Experience Bar is also shown on the HUD. The number shows your current Experience Level, and the bar indicates how many Experience Points are required to increase your Experience Level.
translation: Den Erfarungsbalken gëtt och op der HUD gewisen. D'Zuel weist däin aktuellen Erfarungslevel, an de Balken weist wéi vill Erfarungspunkte gebraucht ginn fir däin Erfarungslevel z'erhéijen.

source_string: Experience Points are gained by collecting Experience Orbs. You can get Experience Orbs from activities such as killing mobs, mining certain blocks, and more! Don't leave any Experience Orbs behind, you're going to need them. Move near Experience Orbs to collect them.
translation: Erfarungspunkte kritt een andeem een Erfarungskugelen sammelt. Du kanns Erfarungskugelen vun Aktivitéiten wéi zum Beispill Mobs killen, bestëmmte Bléck ofbauen, a méi kréien! Looss keng Erfarungskugelen hannen, du wäerts si nach brauchen. Beweeg dech no bei Erfarungskugelen fir si ze sammelen.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Scroll the mouse wheel to change the item in your hand.
translation: Den Schnellzougrëffer weist d'Géigestänn déi verfügbar sinn ze benotzen. Scroll d'Mausrad fir den Géigestand an dénger Hand z'änneren.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Use :_input_key.cycleItemLeft: and :_input_key.cycleItemRight: to change the item in your hand.
translation: Den Schnellzougrëffer weist d'Géigestänn déi verfügbar sinn ze benotzen. Benotz :_input_key.cycleItemLeft: an :_input_key.cycleItemRight: fir den Géigestand an dénger Hand z'änneren.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Tap items in your hotbar to change the item in your hand.
translation: Den Schnellzougrëffer weist d'Géigestänn déi verfügbar sinn ze benotzen. Tipp Géigestänn am Schnellzougrëffer fir den Géigestand an dénger Hand z'änneren.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Press :windowsmr_left_touchpad_horizontal: to change the item in your hand.
translation: Den Schnellzougrëffer weist d'Géigestänn déi verfügbar sinn ze benotzen. Dréck :windowsmr_left_touchpad_horizontal: fir den Géigestand an dénger Hand z'änneren.

source_string: The hotbar shows the items that are available to use. Press :rift_left_trigger: or :rift_left_grab: to change the item in your hand.
translation: Den Schnellzougrëffer weist d'Géigestänn déi verfügbar sinn ze benotzen. Dréck :rift_left_trigger: oder :rift_left_grab: fir den Géigestand an dénger Hand z'änneren.
Dréck :_input_key.inventory: fir däin Inventar ze gesinn.
Dréck :_input_key.inventory: fir däin Inventar ze gesinn.
Dréck :rift_B: fir däin Inventar ze gesinn.
Dréck :windowsmr_left_grab: fir däin Inventar ze gesinn.

source_string: This screen shows the items that are available for use in your hand, and all of the other items that you are carrying. Your armor is also shown here.
translation: Dëse Écran weist d'Géigestänn déi verfügbar sinn an dénger Hand ze benotzen, an all déi aner Géigestänn déi s du bei dir hues. Deng Rüstung gëtt hei och gewisen.

source_string: Use :mouse_left_button: to pick up the item that is under the cursor. If there is more than one item here this will pick them all up, or you can use :mouse_right_button: to pick up just half of them.
translation: Benotz :mouse_left_button: fir den Géigestand ze huelen deen ënnert dem Cursor ass. Wa méi wéi ee Géigestand hei ass, huelt dëst si alleguer, oder s du kanns :mouse_right_button: benotzen fir just d'Hallschent ze huelen.

source_string: Use :_gamepad_face_button_down: to pick up the item that is under the cursor. If there is more than one item here this will pick them all up, or you can use :_gamepad_face_button_left: to pick up just half of them.
translation: Benotz :_gamepad_face_button_down: fir den Géigestand ze huelen deen ënnert dem Cursor ass. Wa méi wéi ee Géigestand hei ass, huelt dëst si alleguer, oder s du kanns :_gamepad_face_button_left: benotzen fir just d'Hallschent ze huelen.

source_string: Tap to select an item. If there is more than one item here this will select them all.
translation: Tipp fir en Géigestand auszewielen. Wa méi wéi ee Géigestand hei ass, wielt dëst si alleguer aus.

source_string: You can place items down again by using :mouse_left_button:. With multiple items on the cursor, use :mouse_left_button: to place them all or :mouse_right_button: to place just one.
translation: Du kanns Géigestänn zréck placéieren andeem s du :mouse_left_button: benotz. Mat méi Géigestänn um Cursor, benotz :mouse_left_button: fir si alleguer ze placéieren oder :mouse_right_button: fir just ee ze placéieren.

source_string: You can place items down again by using :_gamepad_face_button_down:. With multiple items on the cursor, use :_gamepad_face_button_down: to place them all or :_gamepad_face_button_left: to place just one.
translation: Du kanns Géigestänn zréck placéieren andeem s du :_gamepad_face_button_down: benotz. Mat méi Géigestänn um Cursor, benotz :_gamepad_face_button_down: fir si alleguer ze placéieren oder :_gamepad_face_button_left: fir just ee ze placéieren.

source_string: Tap another place in the inventory to move the item.
translation: Tipp eng aner Plaz am Inventar fir den Géigestand ze beweegen.

source_string: If the item the cursor is over is armor, you can quick move it to the correct armor slot by pressing SHIFT+:mouse_left_button:.
translation: Wann den Géigestand ënnert dem Cursor Rüstung ass, kanns du en séier an de richtege Rüstungsslot beweegen andeem s du SHIFT+:mouse_left_button: dréckst.

source_string: If the item the cursor is over is armor, you can quick move it to the correct armor slot by pressing :_gamepad_face_button_up:.
translation: Wann den Géigestand ënnert dem Cursor Rüstung ass, kanns du en séier an de richtege Rüstungsslot beweegen andeem s du :_gamepad_face_button_up: dréckst.

source_string: To drop an item, pick up the item and put it down outside of the inventory window.
translation: Fir en Géigestand fale ze loossen, huel den Géigestand a setz en ausserhalb vum Inventarfenster.

source_string: To drop an item, pick up the item and press :_gamepad_face_button_up:.
translation: Fir en Géigestand fale ze loossen, huel den Géigestand a dréck :_gamepad_face_button_up:.

source_string: To drop an item, tap the item and then tap outside of the inventory window.
translation: Fir en Géigestand fale ze loossen, tipp den Géigestand a tipp dann ausserhalb vum Inventarfenster.

source_string: Minecraft is a multiplayer game by default.
You can have local players join your game by connecting controllers and pressing any button on their controller at any point during the game.
translation: Du kanns lokal Spiller bäifügen andeem s du Controller verbënns a knapps drécks um Controller op iwwerall am Verlaf vum Spill.

source_string: By default, all worlds start with multiplayer enabled. If you would like to make the world private, go to world settings and select the multiplayer option, then toggle multiplayer off.
translation: Standardméisseg fänken all Welten mat aktivéiertem Multispiller un. Wann s du d'Welt privat maache wëlls, gëff op d'Weltastellungen a wiel d'Multispiller-Optioun aus, wiessel dann Multispiller aus.

source_string: By default, all worlds start with multiplayer enabled. If you would like to make the world private, go to world settings and select the multiplayer option, then toggle multiplayer off.
translation: Standardméisseg fänken all Welten mat aktivéiertem Multispiller un. Wann s du d'Welt privat maache wëlls, gëff op d'Weltastellungen a wiel d'Multispiller-Optioun aus, wiessel dann Multispiller aus.

source_string: To join a multiplayer game, go to the friends tab. All joinable Realms, Friends, and LAN Games will be shown here. Pick a game and select it to join.
translation: Fir engem Multispiller-Spill bäizetrieden, gëff op de Frënn-Reider. All bäitrieds-fäheg Realms, Frënn a LAN-Spiller ginn hei gewisen. Wiel e Spill an wiel en aus fir bäizetrieden.

source_string: To join a multiplayer game, go to the friends tab. All joinable Realms, Friends, and LAN Games will be shown here. Pick a game and select it to join.
translation: Fir engem Multispiller-Spill bäizetrieden, gëff op de Frënn-Reider. All bäitrieds-fäheg Realms, Frënn a LAN-Spiller ginn hei gewisen. Wiel e Spill an wiel en aus fir bäizetrieden.

source_string: When you start or join an online game, it will be visible to people in your friends tab. Once your friends join, the game will now be visible to friends of these friends.
translation: Wann s du en Online-Spill start oder bäitritts, gëtt et fir Leit an dengem Frënn-Reider siichtbar. Wa deng Frënn bäitrieden, gëtt de Spill dann och fir d'Frënn vun dësen Frënn siichtbar.

source_string: Note: You must have an internet connection and be signed into Xbox Live to play multiplayer.
translation: Notiz: Du muss eng Internetverbindung hunn a bei Xbox Live ugemellt sinn fir Multispiller ze spillen.

source_string: If you would like to manage the permissions of individual players, player permissions makes it easy. Open the pause menu and on the right, you will see a list of players currently in the world. Select their permission icon to adjust that player's permissions.
translation: Wann s du d'Berechtegungen vun eenzelen Spiller verwalte wëlls, maachen Spillerberechtegunge dat einfach. Mëcht de Pausen-Menü op a riets gesäis du eng Lëscht vun de Spiller déi aktuell an der Welt sinn. Wiel hier Berechtegungsikon aus fir dee Spiller senger Berechtegungen unzepassen.

source_string: Realms is an awesome place to host a multiplayer game that is always running. Even when you aren't playing, your Realm will be up and running for your friends to explore!
translation: Realms ass eng super Plaz fir en Multispiller-Spill ze host deen ëmmer leeft. Och wann s du net spills, wäert däi Realm fir deng Frënn lafen fir z'entdecken!

source_string: To set up a Realm, select Create New from the Worlds tab. Then select the New Realm button, then the Create New World button. Here you can name your Realm, and set the number of players. Then you will be able to add friends to your Realm.
translation: Fir e Realm opzestellen, wiel Nei erstellen aus dem Welten-Reider aus. Wiel dann de Neien Realm-Knäppchen aus, dann de Nei Welt erstellen-Knäppchen. Hei kanns du däi Realm nennen an d'Zuel vu Spiller festleeën. Duerno kanns du Frënn zu dengem Realm bäifügen.

source_string: Once you have a Realm created, select the Pencil button to change the Realm settings.
translation: Wa s du en Realm erstallt hues, wiel de Bläistëft-Knäppchen aus fir d'Realm-Astellungen z'änneren.

source_string: Under the Game button, you can rename the Realm, set the difficulty and gamemode, turn on cheats, and download/upload the world.
translation: Ënnert dem Spill-Knäppchen kanns du den Realm ëmbenennen, de Schwieregkeetsgrad a Spillmodus festleeën, Cheats ugestellen an d'Welt eroflueden/eroplueden.

source_string: Under the Members button you can manage all of the friends you've invited to your Realm, add/remove members, and set their permissions.
translation: Ënnert dem Memberen-Knäppchen kanns du all d'Frënn verwalten déi s du zu dengem Realm invitéiert hues, Memberen bäifügen/ewechhuelen, an hier Berechtegungen festleeën.

source_string: Under the Subscription button you can see when the Realm will expire, extend the time until expiration, and open/close the Realm.
translation: Ënnert dem Abonnement-Knäppchen kanns du gesinn wann den Realm ausleeft, d'Zäit erweideren bis en ausleeft, an den Realm op-/zoumaachen.

source_string: How to Play : Resource And Behavior Packs
translation: Wéi spillt een : Ressourcen- a Behavior-Päck

source_string: You can change the way that Minecraft looks and behaves using Resource and Behavior Packs.
translation: Du kanns d'Aussiicht a d'Verhalen vu Minecraft mat Ressourcen- a Behavior-Päck änneren.

source_string: In the Settings Menu, choose a pack from the available packs list and select the plus sign next to it. Now your pack will apply its changes to the default Minecraft pack.
translation: Am Astellungsmenü, wiel e Pak aus der Lëscht vun verfügbare Päck a wiel d'Pluszeeche daneban aus. Elo appliquéiert däi Pak seng Ännerungen op de Standard-Minecraft-Pak.

source_string: The Server Tab will show popular Minecraft servers.
The Minecraft Marketplace is a place to find new skins, worlds, textures, and mash-up packs by various talented creators.
translation: Den Minecraft Marketplace ass eng Plaz fir nei Skins, Welten, Texturen a Mash-up-Päck vu verschiddene talentéierten Kreateuren ze fannen.

source_string: Try a new skin for a fresh new look!
translation: Probéier en neien Skin fir en neien Look!

source_string: Check out worlds to unlock new maps and challenges that you will want to play again and again!
translation: Kuck Welten fir nei Kaarten a Erausfuerderungen fräizeschalten déi s du ëmmer widder spille wëlls!

source_string: Give your old game a new look with texture packs that can be layered over your current worlds and Realms!
translation: Gëff dengem alen Spill en neien Look mat Texturpäck déi iwwer deng aktuell Welten a Realms geluecht ginn kënnen!

source_string: Give your old game a new look with texture packs that can be layered over your current worlds and Realms!
translation: Gëff dengem alen Spill en neien Look mat Texturpäck déi iwwer deng aktuell Welten a Realms geluecht ginn kënnen!

source_string: Or try them all with mash-up packs which are curated collections of skins, worlds, and textures that, when combined, will transform your worlds and Realms!
translation: Oder probéier si all mat Mash-up-Päck, dat sinn kuratéiert Kollektiounen vu Skins, Welten a Texturen déi, wa kombinéiert, deng Welten a Realms transforméieren!

source_string: Or try them all with mash-up packs which are curated collections of skins, worlds, and textures that, when combined, will transform your worlds and Realms!
translation: Oder probéier si all mat Mash-up-Päck, dat sinn kuratéiert Kollektiounen vu Skins, Welten a Texturen déi, wa kombinéiert, deng Welten a Realms transforméieren!
Wéi spillt een : Handel mat Duerfbewunner

source_string: Tap the Ride button while near a Minecart to hop in and ride. Press :_input_key.forward: to roll forward. Tap :_input_key.jump: to get out.
translation: Tipp de Rittknäppchen wann s du bei engem Minewagen bass fir eranzespréngen a mat him ze fueren. Dréck :_input_key.forward: fir no vir ze rollen. Tipp :_input_key.jump: fir eraus ze kommen.

source_string: Tap the board button while near a Boat to board it. Press :_input_key.left: or :_input_key.right: to turn left or right. Press them both to move forward. Tap the leave boat button to get out.
translation: Tipp de Bordknäppchen wann s du bei engem Boot bass fir mat him ze fueren. Dréck :_input_key.left: oder :_input_key.right: fir lénks oder riets z'wenden. Dréck béid fir no vir ze fueren. Tipp de Boot-Verloossen-Knäppchen fir eraus ze kommen.

source_string: The Sword, Bow, and Trident have specific enchantments that you can get from the Enchanting Table or Anvil that will improve damage, durability and even light mobs on fire!
translation: D'Schwäert, de Bou an den Trident hunn spezifesch Verzauberungen déi s du vum Verzauberungstesch oder Amboss kréis déi de Schued, d'Widderstandsfäegkeet verbesseren a souguer Mobs a Feier setzen!

source_string: The Trident is a dual-purpose melee and ranged weapon. Press :_input_key.attack: to attack. Press and hold :_input_key.use: to draw the trident back. Release :_input_key.use: to throw the trident. The Trident is the best weapon underwater.
translation: Den Trident ass eng Waff mat duebeltem Zweck fir Noh- an Feirkampf. Dréck :_input_key.attack: fir z'attackéieren. Dréck a hal :_input_key.use: fir den Trident zréckzezéien. Loosslass :_input_key.use: fir den Trident ze werfen. Den Trident ass déi bescht Waff ënner Waasser.

source_string: The Trident is a dual-purpose melee and ranged weapon. Tap mobs to attack them. Press and hold the Screen to draw the trident back. Release the press to throw the trident. The Trident is the best weapon underwater.
translation: Den Trident ass eng Waff mat duebeltem Zweck fir Noh- an Feirkampf. Tipp Mobs fir si z'attackéieren. Dréck a hal den Écran fir den Trident zréckzezéien. Loosslass den Dréck fir den Trident ze werfen. Den Trident ass déi bescht Waff ënner Waasser.

source_string: %s has changed from %s skin to %s skin.
translation: %s huet vum %s Skin op de %s Skin gewiesselt.

source_string: Want to broadcast your game? You need to have a compatible broadcasting app installed. We recommend Mixer Create as it allows you to broadcast with sub-second latency, co-stream with friends and lets your viewers interact in fun ways. Certain features like Chat and Viewer Count only work with Mixer Create.
translation: Wëlls du däi Spill iwwerdroen? Du muss eng kompatibel Iwwerdroungsapp installéiert hunn. Mir empfehlen Mixer Create well et dir erlaabt mat Latenz ënner enger Sekonn z'iwwerdroen, mat Frënn zesumme ze streamen a deng Zuschauer op flott Weeër interagéiere loossen. Bestëmmte Funktiounen wéi Chat a Zuschauerzuel fonktionéieren nëmme mat Mixer Create.

source_string: You do not have permission to use this feature. Please go to xbox.com and sign in to your account to fix this
translation: Du hues keng Berechtegung fir dës Funktioun ze benotzen. Gëff op xbox.com a mell dech bei dengem Konto un fir dëst z'ubesseren

source_string: We need you to sign in before you can start broadcasting your game.
translation: Mir brauchen dass s du dech umells ier s du deng Iwwerdroung ufänke kanns.

source_string: Xforge Requests Wait for Sign In

translation: Behavior- a Ressourcepäck vun der Welt eroflueden?

source_string: This world has Behavior Packs applied to it that you must download to join. Would you like to download them and join?
translation: Dës Welt huet Behavior-Päck ugewisen déi s du eroflueden muss fir bäizetrieden. Wëlls du si eroflueden a bäitrieden?

source_string: This world has Behavior Packs applied to it that you must download to join and Resource Packs that you may optionally download before joining. What would you like to download before joining?
translation: Dës Welt huet Behavior-Päck ugewisen déi s du eroflueden muss fir bäizetrieden, a Ressourcepäck déi s du optional eroflueden kanns ier du bäitrëts. Wat wëlls du eroflueden ier s du bäitrëts?

source_string: This world has Behavior and Resource Packs applied to it that you must download to join. Would you like to download them and join?
translation: Dës Welt huet Behavior- a Ressourcepäck ugewisen déi s du eroflueden muss fir bäizetrieden. Wëlls du si eroflueden a bäitrieden?

source_string: This world has Resource Packs applied to it. Would you like to download them before you join?
translation: Dës Welt huet Ressourcepäck ugewisen. Wëlls du si eroflueden ier du bäitrëts?

source_string: This world has Resource Packs applied to it that you must download to join. Would you like to download them and join?
translation: Dës Welt huet Ressourcepäck ugewisen déi s du eroflueden muss fir bäizetrieden. Wëlls du si eroflueden a bäitrieden?

source_string: Adding or removing Behavior Packs after playing a world might break the world and cause you to lose what you created.
translation: Behavior-Päck bäizefügen oder ewechzehuelen nodeems s du eng Welt gespillt hues kéint d'Welt zerbriechen a maachen dass s du verléiers wat s du erschaft hues.

source_string: Removing Behavior Packs with a plugin might break the world and cause you to lose what you created.
translation: Behavior-Päck mat engem Plugin ewechzehuelen kéint d'Welt zerbriechen a maachen dass s du verléiers wat s du erschaf hues.

source_string: This resolution is incompatible with your device because your device doesn't have enough memory.
translation: Dës Resolutioun ass net kompatibel mat dengem Gerät well däi Gerät net genuch Späicher huet.

source_string: This pack is incompatible with your device because it doesn't have enough memory.
translation: Dëse Pak ass net kompatibel mat dengem Gerät well et net genuch Späicher huet.

source_string: Unlock all %s Skins, Texture Pack, and World for %s:minecoin:
translation: All %s Skins, Texturpak, a Welt fräischalten fir %s:minecoin:

source_string: Tell the creator and the community about your experience with this item!
translation: Deel dem Kreateur an der Gemeinschaft deng Erfarung mat dësem Element mat!

source_string: Before we can let you rate an item, you will need to sign in with Xbox Live.
translation: Ier mir dech en Element bewäerte loossen, muss du dech mat Xbox Live umellen.
Probéier méi spéit nach eng Kéier.

source_string: Write a description of your structure.
translation: Schreif eng Beschreiwung vun dénger Konstruktioun.

source_string: Your awesome creation has been uploaded to Remix3D.com using your Remix 3D profile. You can update your profile name and image on Remix3D.com anytime.
translation: Deng flott Kreatioun gouf op Remix3D.com mat dengem Remix 3D-Profil erop gelueden. Du kanns däin Profilnumm a Bild op Remix3D.com jidderzäit aktualiséieren.

source_string: New! Your Remix 3D profile is no longer linked to your Xbox Live gamertag. If you’ve already got a Remix 3D profile, we reserved your current gamertag as your name. If you’re new, we will autogenerate a Remix 3D profile for you. (You can edit it later on Remix3D.com.) Hit Agree to acknowledge this change and upload your creation to Remix3D.com. Microsoft Services Agreement and Privacy Statements apply.
translation: Neit! Däi Remix 3D-Profil ass net méi mat dengem Xbox Live-Gamertag verbonnen. Wa s du schonn e Remix 3D-Profil hues, hu mir däin aktuellen Gamertag als däin Numm gehalen. Wa s du neien bass, generéieren mir automatesch en Remix 3D-Profil fir dech. (Du kanns en méi spéit op Remix3D.com änneren.) Dréck Averstan fir dës Ännerung z'unerkennen a deng Kreatioun op Remix3D.com erop ze lueden. D'Microsoft Services Agreement an d'Privatsphärepolitik gëllen.

source_string: You must be signed in to Xbox Live to upload to Remix3D.com.
translation: Du muss bei Xbox Live ugemellt sinn fir op Remix3D.com erop ze lueden.

source_string: Oh no! You don't have permission to join Remix3D.com.
translation: Oh nee! Du hues keng Berechtegung fir Remix3D.com bäizetrieden.

source_string: Uh oh! Your model is too large. Please try uploading a smaller file.
translation: Uh oh! Däin Modell ass ze grouss. Probéier eng méi kleng Datei erop ze lueden.

source_string: Oops! Your model failed to upload to Remix3D.com.
translation: Oups! Däin Modell konnt net op Remix3D.com eropgelueden ginn.

source_string: Something went wrong. We weren't able to convert your world. You can send us your world later by going to your old world and pressing Y. Or send us your world now so we can investigate further.
translation: Eppes ass schifgelaf. Mir konnten deng Welt net konvertéieren. Du kanns eis deng Welt méi spéit schécken andeem s du op deng al Welt gëss a Y dréckst. Oder schéck eis deng Welt elo sou dass mir dat méi genau ënnersichen kënnen.

source_string: Lost my items, creations, and/or player stats
translation: Meng Géigestänn, Kreatiounen a/oder Spillerstatistike verluer

source_string: By hitting Agree, you are uploading your world to the Minecraft Team. The Microsoft Services Agreement and Privacy Statement apply.
translation: Andeem s du op Averstan dréckst, lueds du deng Welt beim Minecraft-Team erop. D'Microsoft Services Agreement an d'Privatsphärepolitik gëllen.

source_string: By uploading your World you hereby authorize Microsoft to test, reproduce, modify, distribute and publicly display your World in support of transferring your World to Minecraft.
translation: Andeem s du deng Welt eroplueds, autoriséiers du hei Microsoft fir deng Welt ze testen, ze reproduzéieren, z'änneren, ze verdeelen a ëffentlech unzeweisen zur Ënnerstëtzung fir deng Welt an Minecraft z'transferéieren.
Al Welt gëtt un Minecraft geschéckt...

source_string: Thank you! We are hard at work fixing things and won't be able to get back to you about this specific world. Here's your receipt confirming that we received it:
translation: Merci! Mir schaffen haart drun d'Saachen z'ubesseren a kënnen dech net wéinst dëser spezifescher Welt zréckmellen. Hei ass deng Bestätegung dass mir se kritt hunn:

source_string: It appears you don't have a license for Minecraft. Make sure you have downloaded and installed Minecraft from the store
translation: Et gesäit aus wéi ob du keng Lizenz fir Minecraft hues. Iwwerpréif dass s du Minecraft vum Geschäft eroflueden an installéiert hues

source_string: When you see this icon, we are saving your game. Do not turn off your Nintendo Switch while this icon is on screen.
translation: Wann s du dëst Ikon gesäis, späichere mir däi Spill. Maach däin Nintendo Switch net aus während dëst Ikon um Écran ass.

source_string: Xbox Live has arrived in Minecraft! It's a gaming community for phones, PCs, and Xbox. And the best part?
translation: Xbox Live ass an Minecraft ukomm! Et ass eng Gaming-Gemeinschaft fir Telefonen, PCen an Xbox. An de beschte Deel?

source_string: Don't have a Gamertag? Create one to earn achievements, play online with friends and join Realms!
translation: Keen Gamertag? Erstell ee fir Erfolleger z'verdéngen, online mat Frënn ze spillen a Realms bäizetrieden!

source_string: Don't have a Gamertag? Create one to earn achievements, play online with friends and join Realms!
translation: Keen Gamertag? Erstell ee fir Erfolleger z'verdéngen, online mat Frënn ze spillen a Realms bäizetrieden!

source_string: We tried to sign you in to your Xbox Live account, but something went wrong.
translation: Mir hunn probéiert dech bei dengem Xbox Live-Konto z'umellen, awer eppes ass schifgelaf.

source_string: If you play without signing in you won't be able to see your friends list, earn achievements, join Realms, or play online on Xbox Live.
translation: Wann s du ouni z'umellen spills, kanns du deng Frënnlëscht net gesinn, Erfolleger verdéngen, Realms bäitrieden, oder op Xbox Live online spillen.

source_string: Achievements and Gamerscore mark your progress through Minecraft.
translation: Erfolleger a Gamerscore markéieren däin Fortschrëtt duerch Minecraft.

source_string: Sign in to Xbox Live to start earning them!
translation: Mell dech bei Xbox Live un fir si z'verdéngen!

source_string: Add a friend to see when they are online and to play online multiplayer without the hassle of IP addresses and ports.
translation: Füg e Frënd bäi fir ze gesinn wann si online sinn an fir online Multispiller ze spillen ouni d'Ennuen vun IP-Adressen a Ports.

source_string: Sign in to Xbox Live to start adding friends!
translation: Mell dech bei Xbox Live un fir Frënn bäizefügen!

source_string: Invite your friends to play online multiplayer with you without the hassle of IP address and ports.
translation: Invitéier deng Frënn fir mat dir online Multispiller ze spillen ouni d'Ennuen vun IP-Adressen a Ports.

source_string: Sign in to Xbox Live to start inviting friends!
translation: Mell dech bei Xbox Live un fir Frënn z'invitéieren!

source_string: Servers offer some of the most creative ways to play Minecraft! We just need you to sign in so that we can make sure you have permission to play online with new people.
translation: Serveren bidden e puer vun de kreativsten Weeër fir Minecraft ze spillen! Mir brauchen just dass s du dech ummells sou datt mir sécher stellen kënnen dass s du d'Berechtegung hues online mat neie Leit ze spillen.

source_string: Thank you for sending us a copy of your world and helping us find bugs! We are hard at work fixing things and won't be able to get back to you about this specific world. Here's your receipt confirming that we received it: %s
translation: Merci datt du eis eng Kopie vun dénger Welt geschéckt hues an eis hëls Bugs ze fannen! Mir schaffen haart drun d'Saachen z'ubesseren a kënnen dech net wéinst dëser spezifescher Welt zréckmellen. Hei ass deng Bestätegung dass mir se kritt hunn: %s

source_string: Oops! We weren't able to receive your world. Try checking your internet connection or sending it again later.
translation: Oups! Mir konnten deng Welt net empfänken. Probéier deng Internetverbindung z'iwwerpréiwen oder se méi spéit nach eng Kéier ze schécken.

source_string: Did your old world not look or work the way it should have? Send us your world and help us find the bugs!
translation: Huet deng al Welt net ausgesin oder fonktionéiert wéi si sollt? Schéck eis deng Welt an hëllef eis d'Bugs ze fannen!

source_string: You can change the look of your character with a Skin Pack from the Store. Select 'Store' on the Main Menu to see what's available.
translation: Du kanns d'Aussiicht vun dengem Charakter mat engem Skin-Pak vum Geschäft änneren. Wiel 'Geschäft' am Haaptmenü fir ze gesinn wat verfügbar ass.

source_string: Iron golems will fight for you!
Alter the brightness setting to make the game brighter or darker.
translation: Änner d'Helligkeetsastellung fir d'Spill méi hell oder donkel ze maachen.

source_string: If you set the game difficulty to Peaceful, your health will automatically regenerate, and no monsters will come out at night!
translation: Wann s du de Schwieregkeetsgrad op Fridd setz, regeneréiert deng Gesondheet sech automatesch a keng Monster kommen nuets eraus!

source_string: Feed a bone to a wolf to tame it. You can then make it sit or follow you.
translation: Fidder en Wollef e Schankel fir en z'zameifen. Du kanns en dann sëtze loossen oder dir no goen loossen.

source_string: Wearing a pumpkin on your head will keep Endermen from attacking you.
translation: E Kürbis um Kapp droen hält Endermen dovun of dech z'attackéieren.

source_string: Sleeping in a bed at night will fast forward the game to dawn, but all players in a multiplayer game need to sleep in beds at the same time.
translation: An engem Better ze schlofen nuets fänkt d'Spill séier bis fir op de Sonnenopgang, awer all Spiller an engem Multispiller-Spill mussen zur selwechter Zäit an de Better schlofen.

source_string: Harvest food from pigs, cows, sheep, rabbit, and chickens. Cook and eat it to regain health!
translation: Sammel Iessen vu Schwäin, Kéi, Schof, Kanéngchen a Hénger. Kach et an ëss et fir Gesondheet zréckzekréien!

source_string: Harvest leather from cows, and use it to make armor and books.
translation: Sammel Lieder vu Kéi, an benotz et fir Rüstung a Bicher hierzestellen.

source_string: If you have an empty bucket, you can fill it with water, lava, or milk from a cow!
translation: Wann s du en eidelen Eemer hues, kanns du en mat Waasser, Lava, oder Mëllech vun enger Kou fëllen!

source_string: Use a hoe to prepare areas of ground for planting.
translation: Benotz eng Hoë fir Beräicher vum Buedem fir d'Planzen ze preparéieren.

source_string: Spiders won't attack you during the day - unless you attack them.
translation: Spannen attackéieren dech net am Dagesliicht - ausser du attackéiers si.

source_string: Feeding an animal will keep it from despawning. Build a pen to keep your animals safe.
translation: E Véierchen ze fidderen hält et dovun of z'despawnen. Bau en Gehäg fir deng Déieren sécher ze halen.

source_string: Eating cooked food reduces hunger better than eating raw food.
translation: Gekachten Iessen z'iessen reduzéiert den Honger besser wéi rou Iessen z'iessen.

source_string: Craft torches to light up dark areas. Monsters lurk in the darkness!
translation: Stell Fakelen hier fir donkel Beräicher opzeliichten. Monster laueren an der Däischtert!

source_string: Get to destinations faster with a minecart and rail!
translation: Kommt méi séier zu Zieler mat engem Minewagen a Schinne!

source_string: Plant some saplings and they'll grow into trees.
translation: Planz e puer Setzlinge a si wuessen zu Beem.

source_string: Pigmen won't attack you - unless you attack them.
translation: Schwäinmënsche attackéieren dech net - ausser du attackéiers si.

source_string: You can change your game spawn point, and skip to dawn by sleeping in a bed.
translation: Du kanns däin Spawnpunkt änneren, an bis fir de Sonnenopgang sprangen andeem s du an engem Better schléifs.

source_string: Hit those fireballs back at the Ghast!
translation: Schléi déi Feierbaalen zréck op den Ghast!

source_string: Building a portal will allow you to travel to another dimension - The Nether.
translation: E Portal ze bauen erlaabt dir an eng aner Dimensioun ze reesen - The Nether.

source_string: Use the right tool for the job! Digging dirt with a shovel is much faster than using a pickaxe!
translation: Benotz d'richteg Tool fir d'Aarbecht! Buedem mat enger Schëpp z'ausgruewen ass vill méi séier wéi mat enger Pickel!

source_string: If you can't find any coal for your torches, you can always make charcoal from trees in a furnace.
translation: Wann s du kee Kuel fir deng Fakelen fënns, kanns du ëmmer Kuelkuel aus Beem an engem Uewen hierstellen.

source_string: Digging straight down or straight up is not a great idea.
translation: Direkt no ënnen oder no uewen ze ausgruewen ass keng gutt Iddi.

source_string: Bonemeal (crafted from a Skeleton bone) can be used as a fertilizer and can make things grow instantly!
translation: Knéngmiel (hiergestallt aus engem Schankelett-Schankel) kann als Dünger benotzt ginn a kann d'Wuesse vun Saachen direkt beschleunegen!

source_string: Creepers explode when they get close to you!
translation: Creepers explodéieren wann si sech dir noneechen!

source_string: Obsidian is created when water hits a lava source block.
translation: Obsidian gëtt erschaf wann Waasser op eng Lava-Quellblock hifft.

source_string: If the source block for water or lava is removed, it will stop the flow completely.
translation: Wann de Quellblock fir Waasser oder Lava ewechgeholl gëtt, stoppt de Fluss komplett.

source_string: Cobblestone is resistant to Ghast fireballs, making it useful for guarding portals.
translation: Kobblestein ass resistent géint Ghast-Feierbaalen, wat en hëllefräich mécht fir Portaler ze beschützen.

source_string: Blocks that can be used as a light source will melt snow and ice. This includes torches, glowstones, and Jack-O-Lanterns.
translation: Bléck déi als Liichtquell benotzt ginn kënnen, verschmëltzen Schnéi an Äis. Dat schléisst Fakelen, Glowstone a Jack-O-Lanternen mat an.

source_string: Take caution when building structures made of wool out in the open, as lightning from thunderstorms can set wool on fire.
translation: Sief virsiichteg beim Bauen vu Konstruktiounen aus Woll am Fräien, well Blëtz vun Donnergewëdderen d'Woll a Feier setze kann.

source_string: A single bucket of lava can be used in a furnace to smelt 100 blocks.
translation: En eenzege Eemer Lava kann an engem Uewen benotzt ginn fir 100 Bléck ze schmëlzen.

source_string: The instrument played by a note block depends on the material beneath it.
translation: D'Instrument dat vun engem Nouteblock gespillt gëtt hänkt vum Material dertënner of.

source_string: Zombies and Skeletons can survive daylight if they are in water or wearing a helmet.
translation: Zombien a Schankeletter kënnen den Dagesliicht iwwerliewen wa si am Waasser sinn oder en Helm droen.

source_string: Attacking a wolf will cause any wolves in the immediate vicinity to turn hostile and attack you. This trait is also shared by Zombie Pigmen.
translation: E Wollef z'attackéieren mécht dass all Wëllef an der direkter Ëmgéigend feindlech ginn a dech attackéieren. Dëst gëllt och fir Zombie-Schwäinmënschen.

source_string: Wolves and Iron Golems won't attack Creepers.
translation: Wëllef an Eisegolemen attackéieren keng Creepers.

source_string: Chickens lay an egg every 5 to 10 minutes.
translation: Hénger leeën all 5 bis 10 Minutten en Ee.

source_string: Obsidian can only be mined with a diamond pickaxe.
translation: Obsidian kann nëmmen mat enger Diamantpickel ofgebaut ginn.

source_string: Creepers are the easiest obtainable source of gunpowder.
translation: Creepers sinn déi einfachst verfügbar Quell fir Schëspulver.

source_string: Placing two chests side by side will make one large chest.
translation: Zwou Käschten niewent-eneen ze placéieren mécht eng grouss Käscht.

source_string: Tame wolves show their health with the position of their tail. Feed them meat to heal them.
translation: Zameiften Wëllef weisen hier Gesondheet mat der Positioun vun hirem Schwanz. Fidder si Fleesch fir si z'heelen.

source_string: Different colored dyes can be made from a variety of materials, cook cactus in a furnace to get green dye!
translation: Verschidde Faarfstoffer kënnen aus enger Villzuel u Materialien hiergestallt ginn, kach Kaktus an engem Uewen fir gréngen Faarfstoff ze kréien!

source_string: On mobile devices, you can download the "Music by Minecraft" pack from the Music Category in the Minecraft Store.
translation: Op Mobil-Geräter kanns du de "Music by Minecraft"-Pak vun der Musek-Kategorie am Minecraft-Geschäft eroflueden.

source_string: Some animals will follow you if you have wheat in your hand.
translation: E puer Déieren goen dir no wa s du Wees an der Hand hues.

source_string: There will be an update to this game eventually!
translation: Et wäert schlussendlech en Update fir dëst Spill sinn!

source_string: Mojang has more awards than staff!
translation: Mojang huet méi Präisser wéi Mataarbechter!
E puer berühmte Leit spillen Minecraft!

source_string: Do not look directly at the bugs.
Creepers were born from a coding bug.
translation: Creepers sinn aus engem Programmiirfehler entstanen.

source_string: Is it a chicken or is it a duck?
translation: Ass et e Poulet oder eng Enten?

source_string: No-one at Mojang has ever seen Junkboy's face.
translation: Kee bei Mojang huet jeemools d'Gesiicht vum Junkboy gesinn.

source_string: Did you know there's a Minecraft Wiki?
translation: Wousst du datt et e Minecraft Wiki gëtt?

source_string: MINECON 2011 was in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA!
translation: D'MINECON 2011 war a Las Vegas, Nevada, USA!

source_string: MINECON 2013 was in Orlando, Florida, USA!
translation: D'MINECON 2013 war an Orlando, Florida, USA!

source_string: No-one can remember where MINECON 2014 was held.
translation: Keen erënnert sech méi, wou d'MINECON 2014 war.

source_string: MINECON 2016 was in Anaheim, California, USA!
translation: D'MINECON 2016 war an Anaheim, Kalifornien, USA!

source_string: Always assume rumors are false, rather than assuming they're true!
translation: Geet ëmmer dovun aus, datt Gerüchter falsch sinn, amplaz ze mengen, si wieren wouer!

source_string: The first version of Minecraft was created in just 6 days!
translation: D'éischt Versioun vu Minecraft gouf a just 6 Deeg gemaach!

source_string: The Enderman language is actually English in reverse.
translation: D'Sprooch vun den Endermen ass tatsächlech Englesch réckelläits.

source_string: The original name for Minecraft was Cave Game.
translation: Den urspréngleche Numm fir Minecraft war Cave Game.

source_string: Pigs that are struck by lightning become Zombie Pigmen!
translation: Schwäin, déi vum Blëtz getraff ginn, ginn zu Zombie-Schwäinemänner!

source_string: Sometimes iron golems give flowers to the villager children!
translation: Heiansdo ginn Eisegolems de Kanner am Duerf Blummen!

source_string: A Spider Jockey is the rare appearance of a spider being ridden by a skeleton!
translation: E Spider Jockey ass déi seelen Erscheinung vun engem Spannen, dee vun engem Skelett gerid gëtt!

source_string: Traveling one block in the Nether is equal to traveling eight blocks in the overworld.
translation: Ee Block am Nether ze reesen entsprécht aacht Bléck an der Overworld ze reesen.

source_string: You need an Agent to code! Get an Agent egg from your creative inventory.
translation: Du brauchs en Agent fir ze coden! Huel en Agent-Ee aus dengem Kreativ-Inventar.

source_string: Sign in to Xbox Live to sync your Skins, Texture Packs, Worlds, and Mash-ups. They will be there for you on any device where you play Minecraft.
translation: Login op Xbox Live fir deng Skins, Textur-Packen, Welten a Mash-ups ze synchroniséieren. Si stinn dir op all Apparat zur Verfügung, op deem s du Minecraft spills.

source_string: Syncing purchases to Xbox Live account...
This Xbox Live account will not be the primary account for this device if you do not sync this device's purchases to this account. You will not automatically sign in when you start Minecraft.
translation: Dëse Xbox-Live-Kont wäert net de primäre Kont fir dëse Apparat sinn, wann s du d'Käf vun dësem Apparat net mat dësem Kont synchroniséiers. Du gëss net automatesch ageloggt, wann s du Minecraft ufänks.

source_string: Your app store purchases will be available wherever you log in with %s. You can only sync these packs to one account, but they will continue to be available to anyone who uses this device.
translation: Deng App-Store-Käf sinn iwwerall verfügbar, wou s du dech mat %s aloggs. Du kanns dës Packe just op ee Kont synchroniséieren, mä si bleiwen fir jiddereen verfügbar, dee dëse Apparat benotzt.

source_string: Is this the account that you would like to use to access your previous purchases?
translation: Ass dëst de Kont, deen s du benotze wëlls fir op deng fréier Käf zouzegräifen?

source_string: You can't extend your Realm right now. We have now introduced subscriptions for Realms on Xbox and you can buy a new subscription as soon as your Realm has expired in %d days. But don't worry! We will give you 14 extra days for free and your Realm will be kept online, so you will have plenty of time to extend it by then.
translation: Du kanns däi Realm elo net verlängeren. Mir hunn elo Abonnementer fir Realms op Xbox agefouert, an du kanns en neit Abonnement kafen, sou bal wéi däi Realm a %d Deeg ofgelaf ass. Mä keng Suerg! Mir schenken dir 14 zousätzlech Deeg gratis, an däi Realm bleift online, sou datt du genuch Zäit hues, fir en bis dohinner ze verlängeren.

source_string: How to Play : Education Edition Blocks
translation: Wéi spillt een : Bléck vun der Education Edition

source_string: Minecraft: Education Edition features several special blocks that make it easier for teachers to create and employ lessons. World Builder ability negates the restrictions of these blocks.
translation: Minecraft: Education Edition huet e puer speziell Bléck, déi et de Léierpersonalen méi einfach maachen, Lektiounen ze kreéieren an anzesetzen. D'Weltbauer-Fäegkeet stellt d'Aschränkungen vun dëse Bléck un d'Säit.

source_string: Allow and Deny blocks focus where players can build in a world.
translation: Erlaben- a Verbidden-Bléck bestëmmen, wou Spiller an enger Welt bauen kënnen.

source_string: Allow blocks let players place or destroy blocks in the area above them.
translation: Erlaben-Bléck loossen Spiller Bléck placéieren oder zerstéieren an der Zone driwwer.

source_string: Deny blocks prohibit users from placing or destroying blocks in the area above them.
translation: Verbidden-Bléck verhënneren, datt Benotzer Bléck an der Zone driwwer placéieren oder zerstéieren.

source_string: Neither block affects the area below them.
translation: Kee vun de béide Bléck beaflosst d'Zone drënner.

source_string: If an Allow block is placed somewhere with a Deny block below it, the space between the two blocks will be protected while the space above the Allow block will permit users to place and destroy blocks.
translation: Wann en Erlaben-Block iergendwou mat engem Verbidden-Block drënner placéiert gëtt, ass de Raum tëscht deenen zwee Bléck geschützt, während de Raum iwwer dem Erlaben-Block d'Placéiere an Zerstéiere vu Bléck erlaabt.

source_string: Border Blocks are bright, red walls that act like a force field, extending upwards and downwards forever!
translation: Grenz-Bléck sinn hell rout Maueren, déi wéi e Kraaftfeld handelen an sech onendlech no uewen an no ënnen ausdehnen!

source_string: Border blocks prevent players from passing through, over, or under them by any means other than being a World Builder.
translation: Grenz-Bléck verhënneren, datt Spiller duerch, driwwer oder ënner hinne passéieren, ausser wa se e Weltbauer sinn.

source_string: Border blocks cannot be destroyed by non-World Builders.
translation: Grenz-Bléck kënnen net vun Net-Weltbauer zerstéiert ginn.

source_string: Structure blocks save existing structures so they can be loaded in a different spot or even exported for later use.
translation: Konstruktiounsbléck späicheren existent Konstruktiounen, sou datt si op eng aner Plaz gelueden oder souguer fir spéider exportéiert ginn kënnen.

source_string: NPCs display their dialog text when interacted with by non-World Builders.
translation: NPCen weisen hire Dialogtext, wa Net-Weltbauer mat hinne interagéieren.

source_string: NPCs can also launch external URLs or execute commands automatically on closing their dialog box, or by assigning actions to buttons for players to interact with. All automatic commands (and URLs) are executed in the order they are added to the NPC.
translation: NPCen kënnen och automatesch extern URLen opruffen oder Befeeler ausféieren, wann hire Dialogfeld zougemaach gëtt, oder duerch d'Zouweisen vun Aktiounen zu Knäppercher fir d'Interaktioun vu Spillern. All automatesch Befeeler (an URLen) ginn an der Uerdnung ausgeführt, an där se dem NPC bäigefüügt goufen.

source_string: Once placed, face the Camera and press the on-screen button labeled "Take Picture".
translation: Nom Placéieren, kuck an d'Kamera a dréck de Knäppchen op de Bildschierm mat der Ausschrëft "Bild maachen".

source_string: The Camera will track you during this time, doing its best to keep you in the shot, even if you move around.
translation: D'Kamera wäert dech während dëser Zäit verfollegen an hiert Bescht maachen, fir dech am Bild ze halen, och wann s du dech beweegs.

source_string: After the five second timer counts down, your picture is taken.
translation: Nodeems den Timer vu fënnef Sekonnen erof geet, gëtt däi Bild gemaach.

source_string: Pictures can be viewed in the Portfolio or inserted into a book using the Book & Quill.
translation: Bidder kënnen am Portfolio ugesi ginn oder mat dem Buch & Fieder an e Buch agefüügt ginn.

source_string: You can caption your pictures by pressing :mouse_left_button: on the caption label.
translation: Du kanns deng Bilder mat Ënnerschrëften versinn, wann s du op d'Etikett dréckst mat :mouse_left_button:.

source_string: You can caption your pictures by selecting the caption label and pressing :_gamepad_face_button_down: .
translation: Du kanns deng Bilder mat Ënnerschrëften versinn, andeems s du d'Etikett auswiels a dann :_gamepad_face_button_down: dréckss.

source_string: You can caption your pictures by tapping the caption label.
translation: Du kanns deng Bilder mat Ënnerschrëften versinn, andeems s du op d'Etikett tippst.

source_string: You can delete your pictures by pressing :mouse_left_button: on the trash icon below the picture.
translation: Du kanns deng Bilder läschen, wann s du mat :mouse_left_button: op d'Poubelle-Symbol ënnert dem Bild dréckss.

source_string: You can delete your pictures by selecting the trash icon below the picture and pressing :_gamepad_face_button_down: .
translation: Du kanns deng Bilder läschen, andeems s du d'Poubelle-Symbol ënnert dem Bild auswiels a dann :_gamepad_face_button_down: dréckss.

source_string: You can delete your pictures by tapping the trash icon below the picture.
translation: Du kanns deng Bilder läschen, andeems s du op d'Poubelle-Symbol ënnert dem Bild tippst.

source_string: You can export your Portfolio as a series of images by pressing :mouse_left_button: on the Export Portfolio button.
translation: Du kanns däin Portfolio als eng Rei vu Biller exportéieren, wann s du mat :mouse_left_button: op de Knäppchen "Portfolio exportéieren" dréckss.

source_string: You can export your Portfolio as a series of images by selecting the Export Portfolio button and pressing :_gamepad_face_button_down: .
translation: Du kanns däin Portfolio als eng Rei vu Biller exportéieren, andeems s du de Knäppchen "Portfolio exportéieren" auswiels a dann :_gamepad_face_button_down: dréckss.

source_string: You can export your Portfolio as a series of images by tapping the Export Portfolio button.
translation: Du kanns däin Portfolio als eng Rei vu Biller exportéieren, andeems s du op de Knäppchen "Portfolio exportéieren" tippst.

source_string: Code Connection is an extension that allows educators and students to explore, create, and play in an immersive Minecraft world... all by writing code!
translation: Code Connection ass eng Erweiderung, déi et Léierpersonalen a Studenten erlaabt, an enger immersiver Minecraft-Welt ze entdecken, ze kreéieren an ze spillen... alles duerch d'Schreiwe vu Code!

source_string: You can launch Code Connection using the command "/code" to get started.
translation: Du kanns Code Connection mam Befeel "/code" starten, fir unzefänken.

source_string: Scaffolding can help you create huge structures safely! You can walk inside scaffolding and stand on it. If you have a column of scaffolding you can go upward by standing in the scaffolding and pressing the :touch_jump: button. If you want to travel downward you can press the :touch_fly_down: button.
translation: Baugerüst kann dir hëllefen, riseg Konstruktiounen sécher ze kreéieren! Du kanns am Baugerüst goen an drop stoen. Wann s du eng Kolonn Baugerüst hues, kanns du op geroden, wann s du am Baugerüst steet an de Knäppchen :touch_jump: dréckss. Wann s du erof wëlls, kanns du de Knäppchen :touch_fly_down: drécken.

source_string: We're unable to connect to the library. Maybe check your internet connection?
translation: Mir kënnen eis net mat der Bibliothéik verbannen. Kuckst du vläicht deng Internetverbindung?

source_string: This will save and quit your current game and any multiplayer connections, are you sure you want to quit?
translation: Dëst wäert dat aktuellt Spill an all Multispiller-Verbindungen späicheren a verloossen. Bass du sécher, datt s du opgeben wëlls?

source_string: Sorry, we weren't able to find that item in the Library.
translation: Entschëllegt, mir konnten dëst Element net an der Bibliothéik fannen.

source_string: Welcome to the Minecraft: Education Edition Library!
translation: Wëllkomm an der Bibliothéik vu Minecraft: Education Edition!

source_string: The Library is a new feature we've created to make it easy for teachers and students to find and import educational content directly in the game. In this release, you'll find a list of some of our most popular worlds to import and use, along with a link to the full world library on our website.
translation: D'Bibliothéik ass eng nei Funktioun, déi mir kreéiert hunn, fir et Léierpersonalen a Studenten méi einfach ze maachen, educativen Inhalt direkt am Spill ze fannen an ze importéieren. An dëser Versioun fënns du eng Lëscht vun e puer vun eise populärste Welten fir ze importéieren an ze benotzen, esou wéi e Link zu der ganzer Weltbibliothéik op eiser Websäit.

source_string: We're working on adding support for more types of content and functionality in the coming months. Please let us know what you think by clicking the feedback button.
translation: Mir schaffen drun, an de kommende Méint Ënnerstëtzung fir méi Zorte vun Inhalt a Funktiounalitéit dobäizesetzen. Loosst eis wëssen, wat dir dovun denkt, andeems dir op de Feedback-Knäppchen klickt.

source_string: Preparing to import new world. This could take a few minutes.
translation: Preparéiere fir eng nei Welt ze importéieren. Dëst kéint e puer Minutten daueren.

source_string: with field in rawtext must contain a array. Example: "rawtext":[{"translate": "chat.type.announcement", "with": [ "value1", "value2" ]}]
translation: D'Feld "with" am rawtext muss en Array enthalen. Beispill: "rawtext":[{"translate": "chat.type.announcement", "with": [ "value1", "value2" ]}]

source_string: The world you are trying to enter requires your device to run scripts.  Your device doesn't support scripting at this time, so you can't join from this device.
translation: D'Welt, an déi s du wëlls, erfuerdert, datt däi Apparat Scripten ausféiere kann. Däi Apparat ënnerstëtzt d'Ausféieren vu Scripten momentan net, sou datt s du dech vun dësem Apparat net verbannen kanns.

source_string: Press W, A, S, or D to move
translation: Dréck W, A, S oder D fir dech ze beweegen

source_string: Tap the right button to jump
translation: Tipp op de rietsen Knäppchen fir ze sprangen

source_string: Press W and space at the same time to jump up onto a block
translation: Dréck W an d'Leerdaascht gläichzäiteg fir op e Block ze sprangen

source_string: Touch the up arrow and the right button at the same time to jump up onto a block
translation: Tipp de Pfeil no uewen an de rietsen Knäppchen gläichzäiteg fir op e Block ze sprangen

source_string: Move the left stick up and press A at the same time to jump up onto a block
translation: Beweeg den lénken Stick no uewen an dréck A gläichzäiteg fir op e Block ze sprangen

source_string: Find a tree to gather wood
translation: Fann en Bam fir Holz ze sammelen

source_string: Left click and hold to collect 3 pieces of wood
translation: Lénksklick a halen fir 3 Stécker Holz ze sammelen

source_string: Tap and hold to collect 3 pieces of wood
translation: Tippen a halen fir 3 Stécker Holz ze sammelen

source_string: Hold down right trigger to collect 3 pieces of wood
translation: Rietsen Trigger halen fir 3 Stécker Holz ze sammelen

source_string: Have an idea to improve Minecraft? Find a bug that you want fixed? Or encounter an issue you need help with?  Let us know!
translation: Hues du eng Iddi, wéi een Minecraft verbesseren kann? Fënns du e Bug, deen s du gefléckt gesi wëlls? Oder trëfs du op e Problem, wou s du Hëllef brauchs? Loosst eis wëssen!

source_string: Visit this website on another device. https://aka.ms/minecraftfb
translation: Besicht dës Websäit op engem anere Apparat. https://aka.ms/minecraftfb

source_string: Visit this website on another device. https://aka.ms/mcbugs
translation: Besicht dës Websäit op engem anere Apparat. https://aka.ms/mcbugs

source_string: Visit this website on another device. https://aka.ms/helpMC
translation: Besicht dës Websäit op engem anere Apparat. https://aka.ms/helpMC

source_string: The world you are about to enter contains scripts that run on your device. Would you like to join this world?
translation: D'Welt, an déi s du wëlls, enthält Scripten, déi op dengem Apparat lafen. Wëlls du dëser Welt bäitrieden?

source_string: Gold is more abundant in Mesa biomes!
translation: Gold ass méi heefeg an Mesa-Biomer!

source_string: Diorite, you either love it or hate it.
translation: Diorit, entweder s du gär hues oder haasses.
Sprint am Waasser fir ze schwammen!

source_string: Riptide enchantment will propel you through the air in the rain.
translation: D'Verzauberung Strämung wäert dech duerch d'Loft am Reen dreiwen.

source_string: MINECON Earth is a worldwide interactive live-streaming event. Grab your items and join the party!
translation: MINECON Earth ass en weltwäit interaktiven Livestream-Event. Huel deng Saachen a maach mat bei der Party!

source_string: The Beacon is a powerful item that can only be crafted with a nether star from the Wither!
translation: De Bäächen ass e mächtegt Element, dat nëmmen mat engem Nether-Stär vum Wither hiergestallt ka ginn!
Dëllef keng Delfin ëmbréngen, du Monster!

source_string: Did you know that nether stars can't be destroyed by explosions?
translation: Wousst du, datt Nether-Stären net vun Explosiounen zerstéiert ginn kënnen?

source_string: When digging straight up, place a torch at your feet to break any sand or gravel that could potentially fall down on you.
translation: Wann s du gerued erop grouft, placéier eng Fakel bei dengem Fouss, fir Sand oder Gravel ze zerbriechen, dat kéint op dech fale.

source_string: Attempts to connect to the websocket server to send a video stream.
translation: Probéiert sech mam WebSocket-Server ze verbannen, fir e Videostream ze schécken.

source_string: Walk over items to pick them up
translation: Gees iwwer Géigestänn fir se opzehiewen

source_string: Press E to open your inventory
translation: Dréck E fir däin Inventar opzemaachen

source_string: Tap the ... button to open your inventory
translation: Tipp de ... Knäppchen fir däin Inventar opzemaachen

source_string: Press Y to open your inventory
translation: Dréck Y fir däin Inventar opzemaachen

source_string: Left click to select the wood, then left click in the crafting grid
translation: Lénksklick fir d'Holz auszewielen, dann Lénksklick am Konstruktiounsgitter

source_string: Tap to select the wood, then tap in the crafting grid
translation: Tipp fir d'Holz auszewielen, dann tipp am Konstruktiounsgitter

source_string: Press A to select the wood, then use the left joystick to select the crafting grid
translation: Dréck A fir d'Holz auszewielen, dann benotz den lénken Joystick fir d'Konstruktiounsgitter auszewielen

source_string: Left click on the output slot to craft the item and add it to your inventory
translation: Lénksklick op de Wandel fir dat Element ze bauen an et an däin Inventar bäizesetzen

source_string: Tap on the output slot to craft the item and add it to your inventory
translation: Tipp op de Wandel fir dat Element ze bauen an et an däin Inventar bäizesetzen

source_string: Press A on the output slot to craft the item and add it to your inventory
translation: Dréck A op de Wandel fir dat Element ze bauen an et an däin Inventar bäizesetzen

source_string: Continue to craft until you have 12 planks
translation: Fuert weider mat bauen bis s du 12 Breeder hues

source_string: Open the recipe book to learn how to craft more things
translation: Maach d'Rezeptbuch op fir méi Saachen bauen ze léieren

source_string: Press E or left click the X to close the inventory
translation: Dréck E oder Lénksklick d'X fir den Inventar zouzemaachen

source_string: Tap the X to close the inventory
translation: Tipp op d'X fir den Inventar zouzemaachen

source_string: Press B to close the inventory
translation: Dréck B fir den Inventar zouzemaachen

source_string: The Shield will block incoming damage. The Shield can be equipped in the offhand slot as well as the hotbar. Tap :touch_sneak: to toggle block with the Shield.
translation: D'Schëld blockéiert erakommenden Schued. D'Schëld kann souwuel an der Offhand-Plaz wéi och an der Hotbar equipéiert ginn. Tipp :touch_sneak: fir Blockéieren mam Schëld ze wiesselen.

source_string: -Collect Ink Sacs from Squids for Black Dye
translation: -Sammel Tintebeidel vu Tinneffesch fir Schwaarze Farfstoff

source_string: The Crossbow is an alternate ranged weapon. Press and hold the screen to load the crossbow. Once the Crossbow is loaded, it will stay loaded until it is fired, even if you put it in your inventory. Press the hold the screen to fire an arrow. The Crossbow requires arrows to load.
translation: D'Cross-Bow ass eng alternativ Fernwaff. Dréck an halen de Bildschierm fir d'Cross-Bow ze lueden. Wann d'Cross-Bow gelueden ass, bleift si gelueden bis si geschoss gëtt, och wa s du se an däin Inventar leess. Dréck a halen de Bildschierm fir e Pfeil ze schéissen. D'Cross-Bow brauch Pfeile fir gelueden ze ginn.

source_string: Visit this website on another device. %s
translation: Besicht dës Websäit op engem anere Apparat. %s

source_string: There is a new version of the game available, do you want to update to it to get all the new features?
translation: Et gëtt eng nei Versioun vum Spill verfügbar, wëlls du op déi aktualiséieren, fir all déi nei Funktiounen ze kréien?

source_string: Left click to select the wood.
Use left stick and A to select the wood.
translation: Benotz den lénken Stick an A fir d'Holz auszewielen.

source_string: Left click in the crafting grid.
Use left stick and A to place in the crafting grid.
translation: Benotz den lénken Stick an A fir am Konstruktiounsgitter ze placéieren.

source_string: Left click the output slot to craft.
translation: Lénksklick de Wandel fir ze bauen.

source_string: Tap the output slot to craft.
translation: Tipp de Wandel fir ze bauen.

source_string: Press A on the output slot to craft.
translation: Dréck A op de Wandel fir ze bauen.

source_string: Left click an open slot to add to your inventory.
translation: Lénksklick eng oppe Plaz fir se an däin Inventar bäizesetzen.

source_string: Tap an open slot to add to your inventory.
translation: Tipp eng oppe Plaz fir se an däin Inventar bäizesetzen.

source_string: Press A on an open slot below to add it to your inventory.
translation: Dréck A op eng oppe Plaz drënner fir se an däin Inventar bäizesetzen.

source_string: Left click here to open the recipe book.
Tap here to open the search tab.
Press left trigger to open the recipe book.
translation: Dréck den lénken Trigger fir d'Rezeptbuch opzemaachen.

source_string: Press A here to open the search tab.
translation: Dréck A hei fir d'Sichflichtel opzemaachen.

source_string: Left click here to select the crafting table recipe.
translation: Lénksklick hei fir d'Rezept vum Konstruktiounsdësch auszewielen.

source_string: Tap here to select the crafting table recipe.
translation: Tipp hei fir d'Rezept vum Konstruktiounsdësch auszewielen.

source_string: Use left stick to select the crafting table recipe.
translation: Benotz den lénken Stick fir d'Rezept vum Konstruktiounsdësch auszewielen.

source_string: Press A to craft the crafting table.
translation: Dréck A fir de Konstruktiounsdësch ze bauen.

source_string: Put the crafting table in the hotbar to use it.
translation: Setz de Konstruktiounsdësch an d'Hotbar fir en ze benotzen.

source_string: Place the crafting table by looking at the ground and right clicking.
translation: Placéier de Konstruktiounsdësch, andeems s du op de Buedem kucks a rietsklickss.

source_string: Place the crafting table by looking at the ground and tapping.
translation: Placéier de Konstruktiounsdësch, andeems s du op de Buedem kucks an tippss.

source_string: Place the crafting table by looking at the ground and pressing left trigger.
translation: Placéier de Konstruktiounsdësch, andeems s du op de Buedem kucks an den lénken Trigger dréckss.

source_string: Right click a crafting table to use it.
translation: Rietsklick e Konstruktiounsdësch fir en ze benotzen.

source_string: Touch a crafting table to use it.
translation: Tipp en Konstruktiounsdësch fir en ze benotzen.

source_string: Press the left trigger on a crafting table to use it.
translation: Dréck den lénken Trigger op engem Konstruktiounsdësch fir en ze benotzen.

source_string: You need a pickaxe to collect stone. Select the recipe.
translation: Du brauchs eng Hack fir Steen ze sammelen. Wiel d'Rezept aus.

source_string: You need sticks to continue. Select the sticks recipe.
translation: Du brauchs Stécker fir weiderzefueren. Wiel d'Rezept fir Stécker aus.

source_string: The wooden pickaxe can now be made.
You're ready to explore on your own now. Have fun!
translation: Du bass prett fir alleng ze entdecken. Vill Spaass!

translation: Feeler beim Eroplueden vum Inhalt an den ausgewielte Realm!

translation: Du hues nach kee Realm gekaaft!

source_string: You do not have permission to use the kick command.
translation: Du hues keng Erlaabnis fir de Befeel Kick ze benotzen.

source_string: There is an error with your account. You will be unable to use the marketplace until we have resolved the issue. If this issue persists for several days please contact support using the help button.
translation: Et gëtt e Fehler mat dengem Kont. Du kanns de Marketplace net benotzen, bis mir de Problem gelöst hunn. Wann de Problem méi Deeg bleift, kontaktéier de Support iwwer de Hëllefsknäppchen.

source_string: There is an error with your account. You will be unable to use the marketplace until we have resolved the issue. If this issue persists for several days please contact support.
translation: Et gëtt e Fehler mat dengem Kont. Du kanns de Marketplace net benotzen, bis mir de Problem gelöst hunn. Wann de Problem méi Deeg bleift, kontaktéier de Support.

source_string: You need 2 Wood to make a Wooden Pickaxe.
translation: Du brauchs 2 Holz fir eng Holzhack ze bauen.

source_string: Use the :light_mouse_middle_button: or number keys to select items.
translation: Benotz :light_mouse_middle_button: oder d'Zuelentasten fir Elementer auszewielen.

Use :_input_key.cycleItemLeft: and :_input_key.cycleItemRight: to select hotbar items.
translation: Benotz :_input_key.cycleItemLeft: an :_input_key.cycleItemRight: fir Elementer an der Hotbar auszewielen.

:light_mouse_left_button: the output slot to craft a wooden pickaxe.

source_string: Tap the output slot to craft a wooden pickaxe.
translation: Tipp de Wandel fir eng Holzhack ze bauen.

source_string: Press :_gamepad_face_button_down: to craft a wooden pickaxe.

translation: Setz d'Hack an d'Hotbar fir se ze benotzen.

source_string: Press :_input_key.attack: and drag, to rotate the 3D preview.
translation: Dréck :_input_key.attack: a zéien, fir d'3D-Virschau ze dréinen.

source_string: Touch and drag on the preview to rotate the 3D preview.
translation: Touch a zéien op der Virschau fir d'3D-Virschau ze dréinen.

source_string: Redstone can be used to activate a Structure Block. This will cause it to either save a structure out or load a structure into the world, depending on the mode of the block and its settings.
translation: Redstone kann benotzt ginn fir e Konstruktiounsblock ze aktivéieren. Dëst wäert dozou féieren, datt hie entweder eng Konstruktioun eraussave oder eng Konstruktioun an d'Welt lued, jee no dem Modus vum Block a senge Astellungen.

source_string: Share a link to this world.
translation: Deel e Link zu dëser Welt.

source_string: What happens to my Realms and worlds when my subscription to Realms Plus ends?
translation: Wat geschitt mat menge Realms a Welten, wann mäin Abonnement fir Realms Plus ophält?

source_string: If your subscription ends, you and your friends will no longer be able to play online together on Realms, and you will no longer have access to the packs or cloud storage. You will be able to purchase and download any world templates saved to your Realm and cloud storage within 18 months of ending your subscription unless they are no longer offered by Minecraft. If you used Realms Plus worlds, texture packs, or mash-ups, you will need to purchase those packs in the store or, if those packs are still in Realms Plus, re-subscribe, to play those world templates.
translation: Wann däin Abonnement ophält, kënnt du an deng Frënn net méi zesumme online op Realms spillen, an du hues net méi Zougang zu de Packen oder dem Cloud-Späicher. Du kanns all Weltschablonn, déi op dengem Realm an Cloud-Späicher gespäichert ass, bannent 18 Méint no dem Enn vun dengem Abonnement kafen a lueden, ausser wa se net méi vu Minecraft ugebueden ginn. Wann s du Realms-Plus-Welten, Textur-Packen oder Mash-ups benotzt hues, muss du dës Packen am Store kafen oder, wa se nach ëmmer an Realms Plus sinn, dech erëm abonnéieren, fir dës Weltschablonne ze spillen.

source_string: How many world templates can I play with Realms Plus?
translation: Wéi vill Weltschablonne kann ech mat Realms Plus spillen?

source_string: You can play and save ALL the packs included in the Realms Plus on your local device.  As well, you can host one of your world templates on a Realm for your friends to play with you for free!  You can change which world you load on your Realm anytime.
translation: Du kanns ALL déi an Realms Plus abegraffene Packen op dengem lokalen Apparat spillen a späicheren. Zousätzlech kanns du eng vun dengen Weltschablonnen op engem Realm hosten, fir datt deng Frënn mat dir gratis spillen kënnen! Du kanns d'Welt, déi s du op dengem Realm luedes, jidderzäit änneren.

source_string: If you lose health but have at least nine :shank:, your health will automatically replenish. Eating food will also replenish your :shank:.

source_string: Your health will automatically replenish if you have at least nine :shank:. Your :shank: will slowly decrease as you explore and get hungry, but eating food will replenish your :shank:.

translation: Fir eppes z'iessen, tipp d'Iessen an denger Hotbar, an tipp a halen dann de Bildschierm fir z'iessen.
